articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.

Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.

Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.

Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”

The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.

The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.

When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.

Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.

Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.

To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.

Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.

Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.

Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.

After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.

Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.

In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.

Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.

Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.

Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.

Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.

As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.

The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.

Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.

Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.

Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.

Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.

articles.title: Man admits to dismembering ex-girlfriend, keeping severed head in suitcase after she played him 'like a fool'

paras.en: A New York man pleaded guilty to murdering and dismembering his ex-girlfriend and putting her severed head in a suitcase with a flower after she ended their relationship, later telling investigators she had "played me like a sucker," according to authorities.
Damon Foy, 50, of Kerhonkson, pleaded guilty last week to second-degree murder in the 2024 death of Alberta Dale, 44, of Pennsylvania, according to the Ulster County District Attorney's Office.
Between March 31 and April 1, 2024, Foy killed and dismembered Dale and was in the process of disposing of her body when law enforcement intervened, according to the district attorney's office.

The Ulster County Sheriff's Office began investigating on April 1, 2024, after Dale's family members in Pennsylvania contacted law enforcement because they were concerned about her well-being, the district attorney's office said. Deputies first conducted a welfare check before launching a missing person investigation.

Deputies first went to Foy’s apartment on April 1, 2024, and found Dale’s car, according to the New York Post. The next day, deputies returned to question Foy after a member of the public found Dale’s phone on the side of the road and turned it in to authorities, leading investigators to suspect potential foul play.

"She’s in there," Foy whispered to investigators, when they arrived at his home during the missing person investigation. "I killed her," he added, according to court documents cited by the New York Post.
Investigators obtained a search warrant for Foy's home and found a suitcase in a closet that contained the victim's remains. Foy was then arrested and charged in connection with Dale's death.
After shining a flashlight on the suitcase, investigators "immediately noticed what appeared to be dried blood," according to the documents.
"Officers opened the defendant’s suitcase and found Alberta Dale’s partial dismembered remains, including her severed head," the court documents read, according to the New York Post.
"The remaining portions of her dismembered body were not located during the execution of the search warrant," the documents add.
When he was later interviewed, Foy told investigators he "loved her," according to the documents.

"The only thing she kept doing after the time throughout the whole relationship was just play me, play me like a fool, play me like a sucker, and just took advantage of the whole f–king system," he said.

"That’s it. I was told to leave my own home. I was told to leave my own f–king home, not a bill in her name, and I was told to leave my own f–king home. Get out. Then it all started coming clearer to me," he added.
When asked about the flower in the suitcase, Foy only said he was thinking about "what still happened last night to take s— over the top."
Foy had a history of domestic violence against Dale, according to court documents cited by the New York Post.
A previous domestic incident involved a gun, and investigators had also observed an axe at Foy’s property when they were searching for Dale.
Dale had previously warned authorities that "if she went missing it was because [Foy] killed her," according to the court documents.
Under a plea agreement, Foy is expected to receive 23 years to life behind bars, with a minimum term two years shorter than the maximum of 25 years to life, according to the Daily Freeman.
Chief Assistant District Attorney Liz Culmone-Mills told the outlet that the agreement was backed by Dale’s family.
"The District Attorney’s Office would not be making this recommendation were it not for Alberta Dale’s family," Culmone-Mills told the outlet.
Foy is scheduled to be sentenced Dec. 16.

"The total selfish disregard for the life and dignity of another person is at the heart of domestic violence; Damon Foy has shown that to us," District Attorney Emmanuel C. Nneji said in a statement. "We must recognize in our laws the rights of victims of domestic violence to be physically, psychologically, and emotionally safe from their tormentors and the dangers specifically targeted for them, and demand procedures that actually protect victims for real, not just on paper."

articles.title: Former Eagles CB Asante Samuel calls out coach Nick Sirianni after brutal London loss: 'You lost the game'

paras.en: The Philadelphia Eagles flew all the way across the Atlantic Ocean just to hand a victory to the Jacksonville Jaguars. Unsurprisingly, former All-Pro cornerback Asante Samuel has seen enough.
Eight seconds left, a one-point lead, and a squib kick sealed it. Instead, Nick Sirianni gifted Jacksonville a live return, setting up an improbable walk-off win.
Speaking on the "Say What Needs To Be Said" show, Samuel put Sunday's 19-17 collapse squarely on Philadelphia's head coach.

"You lost the game for your team," Samuel said. "Of course, the team was going to have his back and say, 'No, coach, it's not on you. It's on us.' But all the coach had to do was call a squib kick. A squib kick at the end of the game is normal and done all the freaking time."
Samuel torched Sirianni for his lack of awareness in crunch time.

"Nick Sirianni must have had a lapse in his brain or something and wasn't paying attention for him to miss out on that situation," Samuel said. "There's no way your team fights that hard for that long, and you let your team down by not making sure the right call is being made."

The blunder erased what should have been a gritty road win. Down Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith to hamstring injuries, Philadelphia took a 17-16 lead with eight seconds left on Jake Elliott's 48-yard field goal.
Jacksonville's Ameer Abdullah responded by fielding a clean kickoff, ripping off a 53-yard return, and setting up Cam Little's walk-off 57-yarder as time expired.
The loss dropped Philadelphia to 2-3 while pushing the Jags to their third-straight victory.
Sirianni fell on his sword Sunday right after the final whistle.

"I didn't make the right decision and I lost us that game," Sirianni told reporters. "And that's what I said to our guys. What hurts there is that the guys fought so hard, and then I don't make the decision that I should make at the end of the game and I cost us that game and I put that fully on me."
When asked why Philadelphia left eight seconds on the board before Elliott's kick, Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts made it clear game management was outside his control.

"It’s not my place, and we’re prepared, I’m prepared as a quarterback to not worry about those things," Hurts told reporters Monday. "So I’m honoring a play call, honoring the things that are coming in the game. When I’m up at night, yeah, I think about, 'Man, should I have said something, or should I have took a step back and said, "Wait"?' But ultimately, there’s a commitment to that and going out there and executing. And so this was one where it did not work in our favor."
Sirianni doubled down Monday, shutting down any idea that Hurts should have overruled the sideline.

"Jalen’s playing," Sirianni told reporters. "We’re coaching and calling the plays, and Jalen’s got to go execute what we call in that moment, 100 percent. We’re not asking him to make play calls in that scenario. He’s already got enough to worry about to go out and execute. That’s where we were there in that situation."
Sirianni can preach staying in your lane all day, but Hurts is losing sleep over brain-dead strategy, and Samuel wants the head coach held to the fire.
Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela

articles.title: Rays bullpen suffers embarrassing late meltdown as Cleveland bullies Tampa Bay in Game 1

paras.en: The Tampa Bay bullpen ran out of gas late Monday night. After seven innings of grind-it-out baseball in St. Petersburg, the Cleveland Guardians broke loose with five runs over the final two frames to take Game 1 of the ALCS, 7-3.

With two outs in the opening frame, Junior Caminero and Jonny DeLuca ripped consecutive RBI knocks to put Tampa Bay up 2-0. Rays starter Drew Rasmussen kept that lead strong through five innings, punching out seven.
Cleveland finally cracked Rasmussen in the sixth when Chase DeLauter jumped on a heater and launched an opposite-field solo shot over the right-center wall.
Patrick Bailey pulled Cleveland even leading off the seventh, hooking a solo blast down the right-field line to end Rasmussen's night at 2-2.

The Guardians kept the heat on in the eighth against Tyler Wells and Ian Seymour. Ramirez started the fire with a hustle infield single, DeLauter ripped a double down the line, and Nathaniel Lowe laced a go-ahead, two-run single to make it 4-2.
Tampa Bay answered in the bottom of the eighth when pinch-hitter Cedric Mullins ambushed Erik Sabrowski with a solo shot to right, trimming the deficit to 4-3.
Then Jose Ramirez delivered the knockout blow.

Capping a 3-for-5 night with two runs scored, Cleveland's veteran third baseman stepped in with two outs in the ninth and lined an RBI single into right off Cole Sulser to make it 5-3. After Sulser walked DeLauter, Kevin Kelly entered to face Jo Adell. The mid-season acquisition stepped up to the big moment, ripping a two-run double down the third-base line to put the contest on ice at 7-3.
Cleveland pounded out 14 hits against six Tampa Bay arms, with Ramirez and DeLauter combining for six knocks before Cade Smith slammed the door on six pitches.
The Rays entered Monday riding high after sweeping the Yankees, but they left the yard with all the pressure.
Game 2 is Tuesday night at Tropicana Field.
Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela

articles.title: Bullet hole in door and DNA evidence scrutinised in Beau Lamarre-Condon double murder trial
articles.author: Kat Wong

paras.en: A bullet hole left in a bedroom door and DNA found in the barrel of the firearm have been scrutinised in court as Beau Lamarre-Condon’s double murder trial continues in Sydney.
Lamarre-Condon, 31, has been accused of fatally shooting Jesse Baird and Luke Davies with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in on 19 February 2024.
He has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder and one charge of aggravated break and enter.

The prosecution argues the policeman disguised himself as an UberEats rider before entering Baird’s home, shooting him twice – in the base of the neck and the right temple – and then shooting Davies through the bedroom door.

But the defence alleges they were killed in two separate incidents when Lamarre-Condon was acting in “self-defence”. During the tussle with Baird, the firearm was flung across the room where it was picked up by Davies, who later shot himself in a struggle with the policeman, the defence argues.
Defence lawyer John Stratton SC cross-examined crime scene officer Greg Moon on Tuesday, questioning the prosecution’s version of events.

Stratton pointed to a swab taken from the barrel of the alleged murder weapon, which returned a DNA profile that partially matched Davies. He then noted the hole in the bedroom door, through which the prosecution alleges Davies was shot, tested negative for blood.

Stratton suggested: “The possibility or likelihood of biological material finding its way from a wound of the deceased through a hole in the door less than a centimetre in width and into the barrel of a gun … approaches zero.”
But Moon told the New South Wales supreme court he disagreed.
“I believe it can still happen,” he said.
The defence does not dispute the couple were shot.
A diagram from Dr Kendall Bailey, who conducted the postmortem examinations of both men, suggested a bullet entered Baird’s body at the base of his neck and exited just below his lip.
Asked by crown prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC about the effect of this wound, Bailey told the jury it did not pass through any major vessels of the neck or the vertebral column or windpipe.
But that did not mean it was insignificant, the court heard.
“It still would be a very nasty injury and that fracturing of the jaw is a very nasty injury,” she told the court.
While it is potentially survivable, those kinds of injuries can be painful and cause some to pass out, though others may not lose consciousness, Bailey explained.
Hatfield then asked if person with those injuries could speak.
The bullet went through the jaw and the base of the tongue, Bailey said, adding: “I don’t think anyone with that injury would be making any meaningful vocalisations.
“They could make a noise but that would be nothing that would be coherent,” she said.
Bailey then explained the shot that entered the temple would go through the brain, where it would incapacitate a person.

Asked if that person would then be able to fling a gun to the other side of the room, she said the body could make some involuntary movements but “I don’t think that person is making any conscious movements”.
CT scans of Baird and Davies’ skulls showing the damage caused by the bullets were presented to the jury on Thursday.

Forensic radiologist Dr James Raleigh explained to the court there was a hole in the right side of Baird’s head at the temple region and multiple small bone fragments “presumably from that damage were run in a line across the inside of the skull”.
Davies’ wound was located in his face just above the left eyebrow, which Raleigh agreed was consistent with a bullet hole.
Two wounds on Davies’ thigh were consistent with a “single-bladed weapon”, Bailey said.
But she agreed those injuries likely took place after or at the time of death.
The trial before Justice Natalie Adams continues.

articles.title: Vikki Campion, News Corp columnist and wife of Barnaby Joyce, begins role with NSW One Nation
articles.author: Penry Buckley

paras.en: Vikki Campion, the News Corp columnist and wife of the federal One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce, has begun working as an adviser for the party in New South Wales in the lead-up to the March state election.
paras.zh: 新闻集团专栏作家、联邦一国议员巴纳比·乔伊斯（ Barnaby Joyce ）的妻子维基·坎皮恩（ Vikki Campion ）已开始担任新南威尔士州党的顾问，为3月份的州选举做准备。

paras.en: Campion, who helped the NSW One Nation leader and candidate for Cessnock, Mike Newman, with a press conference in the Hunter electorate on Tuesday, told Guardian Australia she had started working for the party’s state executive as a contractor, providing media advice on a part-time basis this week.
paras.zh: Campion周二在Hunter选区举行新闻发布会，帮助新南威尔士州One Nation领导人兼Cessnock候选人Mike Newman ，她告诉澳大利亚卫报，她已开始作为承包商为该党的州行政部门工作，本周提供兼职媒体建议。

paras.en: She said it was “publicly disclosed that I [am] married to Barnaby on my website and the public are aware of my affiliation with One Nation through many media reports”.
paras.zh: 她说， “在我的网站上公开披露我与巴纳比结婚，公众通过许多媒体报道知道我与一个国家的关系”。

paras.en: “I’ve worked as a political contractor for around six years across a range of campaigns and candidates while writing regularly and running a farm,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说： “我在一系列竞选活动和候选人中担任政治承包商约六年，同时定期撰写文章并经营农场。”

paras.en: “I report to the NSW state executive which is a separate entity to the federal One Nation, and I have previously worked for the state Nationals in similar arrangements.”
paras.zh: “我向新南威尔士州行政部门汇报，该部门是联邦“一个民族”的一个独立实体，我以前曾以类似的安排为州国民工作。”

paras.en: Campion writes a weekly column for the Saturday Telegraph, with her latest one published on 9 October.
paras.zh: 坎皮恩为《星期六电讯报》撰写了每周专栏，她的最新专栏于10月9日发表。

paras.en: Asked if she would disclose her work for the party in future columns for the paper, Campion said that “as an opinion writer, I don’t think anyone who has read my column would be shocked that I would want to help One Nation”.
paras.zh: 当被问及她是否会在未来的报纸专栏中披露她为该党所做的工作时， Campion说： “作为一名意见撰稿人，我认为任何读过我的专栏的人都不会因为我想帮助一个国家而感到震惊。”

paras.en: After Guardian Australia put questions to the Daily Telegraph about Campion’s work with One Nation, the paper published an article about her new role in the party, which she told it was a “natural extension” of her career as a conservative commentator.
“Campion will continue to write her weekly column appearing every Saturday as a contributor,” the paper wrote.
After speaking to the Guardian, Campion subsequently posted to social media about her role, saying “the party is a phenomenon and unlike anything Australian politics has seen in a very long time”.

Campion worked as a media adviser to Joyce when he was deputy prime minister. The pair married in 2023. Joyce had announced in late 2017 that he and his first wife had separated and the Daily Telegraph subsequently published a photo of a pregnant Campion on its front page in February 2018.

In an appearance on the ABC’s Australian Story in August, Campion said she felt “suicidal” during a press conference called by the then prime minister, Malcolm Turnbull, after the story broke. The ABC issued an apology to Campion after the ABC News Instagram account published a clip from the episode with Campion discussing her experience of postpartum depression without disabling comments under the video.
Joyce, the federal MP for New England, defected from the Nationals to One Nation last December.

The revelation about Campion’s work for the party came after News24 reported that another high-profile former Coalition figure, the 2022 Liberal candidate for Warringah, Katherine Deves, would run as an upper house candidate in the NSW election. Deves had previously announced that she joined One Nation in September.

But after News24 reported that Deves – who said she had received death threats after comments she had made about transgender people surfaced during the 2022 campaign – would run as an upper house candidate, One Nation put out a statement saying it had only confirmed three candidates – Newman and the upper house candidates Stuart Bonds and Jeff Bacon, a firearms manufacturer based in Tamworth.

“We have received more than 800 [candidate] applications from community leaders, advocates and business people,” a spokesperson said. Campion told Guardian Australia she had no plans to run as a candidate for the party.
One Nation and the Saturday Telegraph were contacted for comment.

articles.title: Argentina temporarily closes Iguazu Falls after El Niño-fuelled surge in water levels
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: Heavy rainfall fuelled by a supersized El Niño weather pattern briefly forced Argentinian authorities to close tourist access to the famed Iguazu Falls, amid fears that rapidly rising water levels would cause the river to burst its banks.
paras.zh: 由超大厄尔尼诺天气模式引发的暴雨迫使阿根廷当局暂时关闭了前往着名的伊瓜苏瀑布的游客通道，因为人们担心快速上升的水位会导致河流冲破河岸。

paras.en: National park officials took the precautionary measure on Monday when the Iguazu River’s flow exceeded 12,000 cubic metres per second – more than six times its average rate.
paras.zh: 国家公园官员周一采取了预防措施，当时伊瓜苏河的流量超过每秒12,000立方米，是平均水平的六倍多。

paras.en: It later said the area would reopen to tourists on Tuesday, citing a “gradual decline” in the river’s flow.
paras.zh: 它后来表示，该地区将于周二重新向游客开放，理由是河流流量“逐渐减少”。

paras.en: José María Hervás, the director of the Iguazu national park, said access was closed because “it just keeps raining” and the volume of water being released from dams upstream on the Iguazu River was not falling, reported the Buenos Aires Times.
paras.zh: 据《布宜诺斯艾利斯时报》报道，伊瓜苏国家公园主任何塞·玛丽亚·埃尔瓦斯（ José María Hervás ）表示，由于“持续下雨” ，伊瓜苏河上游水坝释放的水量没有下降。

paras.en: The Iguazu Falls, recognised by Unesco as one of the world’s largest and most impressive waterfalls, sits on the border of Argenina and Brazil and spans approximately 2,700 metres.
paras.zh: 伊瓜苏瀑布被联合国教科文组织认为是世界上最大、最令人印象深刻的瀑布之一，位于Argenina和巴西的边界，跨度约为2,700米。

paras.en: In 2023 and 2024, Argentinian officials closed the park on its side of the border over flooding caused by a previous El Niño cycle.
paras.zh: 2023年和2024年，阿根廷官员因上一次厄尔尼诺现象造成的洪水而关闭了边境一侧的公园。

paras.en: Meteorologists say the 2026-2027 El Niño, which causes global changes in winds and rainfall as well as erratic weather conditions, is certain to be the biggest ever recorded. Scientists now also think human-caused global heating is making El Niño’s more intense.
paras.zh: 气象学家表示， 2026-2027年的厄尔尼诺现象会导致全球风力和降雨量的变化以及不稳定的天气条件，这肯定是有史以来最大的厄尔尼诺现象。科学家现在还认为，人为造成的全球加热正在使厄尔尼诺现象更加剧烈。

paras.en: El Niño begins in the equatorial Pacific where changes in winds allow huge amounts of heat to escape the oceans and heat the atmosphere. It grows in the northern hemisphere autumn and peaks in December but has impacts well into the following year.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象始于赤道太平洋，在那里风的变化使大量的热量逃离海洋并加热大气。它生长在北半球的秋季，在12月达到高峰，但会影响到下一年。

paras.en: Last month, Argentina’s coastal region experienced above-average rainfall “similar to that seen during strong El Niño events,” the national meteorological service said.
paras.zh: 国家气象局表示，上个月，阿根廷沿海地区的降雨量高于平均水平， “类似于强厄尔尼诺现象期间的降雨量”。

articles.title: Fridges in French supermarkets hit by cyber attack

paras.en: Hundreds of French supermarkets have been hit by a cyber attack that caused their fridges and freezers to heat up, spoiling fresh and frozen food estimated to be worth millions of euros.
paras.zh: 数百家法国超市遭到网络攻击，导致冰箱和冰柜升温，损坏了估计价值数百万欧元的新鲜和冷冻食品。

paras.en: Hackers gained control of the software that regulates the temperatures of the refrigeration units, forcing some to warm to 50C (120F) overnight, according to one supermarket chain affected.
paras.zh: 据一家受影响的超市连锁店称，黑客控制了调节制冷机组温度的软件，迫使一些制冷机组在一夜之间升温到50摄氏度（ 120华氏度）。

paras.en: The chief executive of CoopÃ©rative U said several of its supermarkets had been hit by the "extremely serious and unprecedented" attack.
paras.zh: Coopé rative U的首席执行官表示，其几家超市遭到了“极其严重和前所未有的”袭击。

paras.en: More than 100 of the chain's supermarkets were targeted, while 180 stores from IntermarchÃ© and its Netto brand were affected, with a spokesman saying that another 100 shops were urgently disconnected from the internet to prevent the same thing happening to them.
paras.zh: 该连锁店的100多家超市成为攻击目标，而Intermarché及其Netto品牌的180家商店受到影响，一位发言人表示，另有100家商店紧急与互联网断开连接，以防止同样的事情发生在他们身上。

paras.en: Other major food retailers including Carrefour, Monoprix and E.Leclerc were also hit by the attack, which targeted software provided by Danish engineering firm Danfoss.
paras.zh: 包括家乐福、Monoprix和E.Leclerc在内的其他主要食品零售商也受到了此次攻击的打击，该攻击针对的是丹麦工程公司丹佛斯提供的软件。

paras.en: The software allows retailers to manage their cold units remotely.
paras.zh: 该软件允许零售商远程管理其冷库。

paras.en: Normally, supermarket freezers go through a short period of defrosting overnight, in which temperatures rise slightly. But the hackers ordered the units to heat up and stay hot, although Danfoss did not confirm any reports about just how warm the fridges and freezers could become in that process.
paras.zh: 通常情况下，超市的冰箱会经历一夜之间的短时间除霜，其中温度略有上升。但黑客命令这些设备升温并保持高温，尽管丹佛斯没有证实任何关于在这个过程中冰箱和冰柜会变暖的报道。

paras.en: Danfoss said the affected cold units were older models whose security software could not be updated to ward off a risk they had identified.
paras.zh: 丹佛斯表示，受影响的冷水机组是较旧的型号，其安全软件无法更新以防范他们发现的风险。

paras.en: The firm added in s statement that it had "long advised" businesses to keep supported systems up to date.
paras.zh: 该公司在声明中补充说，它“长期建议”企业保持支持系统的最新状态。

paras.en: "Reliable refrigeration is critical to our customers' operations, and we remain committed to supporting our customers and helping them maintain secure and reliable systems they are used to."
paras.zh: “可靠的制冷对我们客户的运营至关重要，我们仍然致力于为客户提供支持，并帮助他们维护他们习惯使用的安全可靠的系统。”

paras.en: The full scale of the attack is unclear, but figures supplied by individual chains suggest about 400 stores were affected out of 15,000 or so overall in France.
paras.zh: 这次袭击的全面规模尚不清楚，但个别连锁店提供的数据显示，法国总共有15,000家左右的商店受到影响，其中约有400家商店受到影响。

paras.en: Carrefour said fridges in 80 of its 6,000 stores were hacked, while Monoprix said 5% of its 400-plus stores had been hit, with food removed from sale if its condition could not be guaranteed.
paras.zh: 家乐福表示，其6000家商店中有80家商店的冰箱遭到黑客攻击，而Monoprix表示，其400多家商店中有5%的商店遭到黑客攻击，如果无法保证其状况，食品将从销售中移除。

paras.en: In a statement to the BBC, Mousquetaires Group - which owns IntermarchÃ© and Netto - said some fresh and frozen food display units remained out of service on Monday afternoon.
paras.zh: 在向英国广播公司发表的一份声明中，拥有Intermarché和Netto的Mousquetaires集团表示，一些新鲜和冷冻食品展示单位周一下午仍处于停用状态。

paras.en: The stores had "taken all necessary precautions to remove the products from these units", it said, adding that staff were working to restock the shelves "as soon as possible".
paras.zh: 它说，商店“采取了一切必要的预防措施，从这些单位取出产品” ，并补充说，工作人员正在努力“尽快”补充货架。

paras.en: IntermarchÃ© said its fridges had heated up to 50C for six hours overnight into Monday, and the retailer had thrown away all the affected food to avoid health risks, the Reuters news agency reported.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道， Intermarché表示，到周一晚上，其冰箱已升温至50摄氏度，持续6个小时，该零售商已扔掉所有受影响的食品，以避免健康风险。

paras.en: As a result of the attack, managers arriving at branches of several supermarket chains on Monday morning were hit by a wave of hot air from the freezers. In some places there were even small fires.
paras.zh: 由于这次袭击，周一早上抵达几家连锁超市分店的管理人员被来自冰箱的热空气击中。有些地方甚至发生了小火灾。

paras.en: French broadcaster BFMTV published an image showing a freezer in an ice cream aisle displaying a temperature of 26.5C.
paras.zh: 法国广播公司BFMTV发布了一张图片，显示冰淇淋通道中的冰柜显示温度为26.5摄氏度。

paras.en: Two supermarkets in the Alsace region reported losses of â¬270,000 (Â£228,000) between them, the broadcaster added, meaning the nationwide total could run into the millions.
paras.zh: 该广播公司补充说，阿尔萨斯地区的两家超市报告它们之间的损失为270,000欧元（ 228,000 £ ） ，这意味着全国总数可能达到数百万美元。

paras.en: French prosecutors have opened a specific cyber-crime investigation into the incident, which the Paris prosecutor's office called a "large-scale cyber-attack affecting the refrigerators of several major food retail chains across France".
paras.zh: 法国检察官对这一事件展开了具体的网络犯罪调查，巴黎检察官办公室称其为“影响法国几家主要食品零售连锁店冰箱的大规模网络攻击”。

paras.en: European Food Commissioner Christophe Hansen condemned the hack in a post on X and added: "Food security requires more attention at all levels. Because the weaponisation of food has become a reality."
paras.zh: 欧洲食品专员克里斯托夫·汉森（ Christophe Hansen ）在X的帖子中谴责了这次黑客攻击，并补充说： “粮食安全需要各级更多的关注。因为食物的武器化已经成为现实。”

paras.en: In a post on X, CoopÃ©rative chief executive Dominique Schelcher said staff were "fully mobilised, in co-ordination with refrigeration specialists, to restore the situation as quickly as possible".
paras.zh: 合作社首席执行官多米尼克·谢尔彻（ Dominique Schelcher ）在X上的一篇文章中表示，工作人员“与制冷专家协调，充分动员起来，尽快恢复局面”。

paras.en: He called for an investigation into the hack and said targeting equipment essential to the French food supply was "unacceptable".
paras.zh: 他呼吁对黑客行为进行调查，并表示法国食品供应必不可少的目标设备是“不可接受的”。

paras.en: Have you been affected by this cyber attack? Share your experience.
paras.zh: 您是否受到此次网络攻击的影响？分享您的体验。

articles.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire

paras.en: On Sunday, US President Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine had agreed a ceasefire on strikes on energy infrastructure "effective immediately". Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggested it was "news for me", while Russia has not commented publicly.
paras.zh: 周日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布，俄罗斯和乌克兰已就“立即生效”的能源基础设施罢工达成停火协议。乌克兰的沃洛季米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）表示，这对我来说是“新闻” ，而俄罗斯尚未公开发表评论。

paras.en: Donald Trump says an energy ceasefire has been agreed.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，能源停火已经达成协议。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin's spokesman Dmitry Peskov was asked whether such a ceasefire had been agreed during his daily conference call with journalists.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京（ Vladimir Putin ）的发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（ Dmitry Peskov ）在与记者的每日电话会议上被问及是否已经同意这种停火。

paras.en: "Contacts are continuing," Peskov replied.
paras.zh: “联系还在继续，”佩斯科夫回答。

paras.en: "As soon as we have anything to say about this, we will definitely inform you."
paras.zh: “一旦我们有什么要说的，我们一定会通知你。”

paras.en: Peskov may not have had much to say on the matter, but the pro-Kremlin media has.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫对此事可能没有太多话要说，但亲克里姆林宫的媒体却有。

paras.en: It has dubbed President Trump's announcement of an energy ceasefire "a gift" for Moscow.
paras.zh: 它称特朗普总统宣布能源停火是给莫斯科的“礼物”。

paras.en: "Of course we benefit," pro-government news outlet Moskovsky Komsomolets concluded.
paras.zh: “我们当然受益，”亲政府新闻媒体Moskovsky Komsomolets总结道。

paras.en: "It means that all Russia has to do is not destroy Ukraine's last remaining oil refinery.
paras.zh: “这意味着俄罗斯所要做的并不是摧毁乌克兰最后剩下的炼油厂。

paras.en: "That has already been attacked several times. It's barely functioning anyway.
paras.zh: “这已经被攻击了好几次。反正它几乎不起作用。

paras.en: "But Kyiv won't be allowed to hit the multitude of refineries we have.
paras.zh: “但基辅不会被允许击中我们拥有的众多炼油厂。

paras.en: "In effect it's a one-way deal that benefits us. That's why no one here has officially rejected it."
paras.zh: “实际上，这是一笔使我们受益的单向交易。这就是为什么这里没有人正式拒绝它。”

paras.en: In other words, Moscow believes Trump's announcement ties Ukraine's hands, not Russia's.
paras.zh: 换句话说，莫斯科认为特朗普的声明束缚了乌克兰的手脚，而不是俄罗斯的手脚。

paras.en: In recent months, long-range Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil facilities have caused extensive damage, as well as fuel shortages across the country.
paras.zh: 最近几个月，乌克兰对俄罗斯石油设施的远程无人机袭击造成了广泛的破坏，以及全国各地的燃料短缺。

paras.en: Should such attacks continue, expect the Russians to claim that Kyiv is harming US economic interests â as well as the Republican Party's chances in the midterm elections in November.
paras.zh: 如果这种攻击继续下去，预计俄罗斯人会声称基辅正在损害美国的经济利益--以及共和党在11月中期选举中的机会。

paras.en: Russian officials will argue that the strikes undermine the recent Trump-Putin fuel deal for the US to import Russian diesel.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员将辩称，罢工破坏了特朗普-普京最近达成的美国进口俄罗斯柴油的燃料协议。

paras.en: Trump has claimed the agreement will benefit US consumers, although there is widespread scepticism that the volumes involved will do much to lower fuel prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普声称该协议将使美国消费者受益，尽管人们普遍怀疑所涉及的数量将大大降低燃油价格。

paras.en: Still, the Kremlin will be only too happy if Ukrainian drone strikes on oil facilities spark fury in the White House and curtail US support for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，如果乌克兰无人机袭击石油设施引发白宫的愤怒，并削弱美国对基辅的支持，克里姆林宫将非常高兴。

paras.en: Moscow would welcome Washington cutting off intelligence sharing to Ukraine and weapons sales to Europe that are destined for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 莫斯科欢迎华盛顿切断对乌克兰的情报共享，切断对运往基辅的欧洲武器销售。

paras.en: It has already delighted to hear Trump declaring: "I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president."
paras.zh: 它已经高兴地听到特朗普宣称： “我认为乌克兰是时候选出一位新总统了。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has called for a 60-day Russian ceasefire to allow for presidential elections in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（ Volodymyr Zelensky ）呼吁俄罗斯停火60天，以便在乌克兰举行总统选举。

paras.en: "The Kremlin, the president, has said many times before, we don't want a ceasefire, we want a lasting peace, and we're willing to do whatever's possible for that," Peskov said.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫说： “总统克里姆林宫此前曾多次表示，我们不希望停火，我们希望实现持久和平，我们愿意为此尽一切可能。”

paras.en: "Whatever's possible" does not include a 60-day ceasefire, or a 30-day ceasefire, or anything close to that.
paras.zh: “一切可能”不包括60天的停火，或30天的停火，或任何接近的停火。

paras.en: On Monday, the Kremlin proposed a one-day cessation of hostilities for Ukraine to hold elections.
paras.zh: 周一，克里姆林宫提议乌克兰停止为期一天的敌对行动，以举行选举。

paras.en: That will not be seen in Ukraine, or in the West, as a serious offer.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰或西方，这不会被视为一个严肃的提议。

paras.en: Putin has shown little desire to halt the fighting.
paras.zh: 普京几乎没有表现出停止战斗的愿望。

paras.en: Recent statements, speeches and signals from Russia's leader suggest that, with winter approaching, the Kremlin is counting on a continued campaign of Russian strikes to significantly increase the pressure on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯领导人最近的声明、演讲和信号表明，随着冬季的临近，克里姆林宫指望俄罗斯继续罢工，以大幅增加对乌克兰的压力。

paras.en: On Monday, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Ukraine does not deserve the "respite" a ceasefire would bring.
paras.zh: 周一，俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（ Sergei Lavrov ）表示，乌克兰不应该得到停火带来的“喘息”机会。

paras.en: The Kremlin has claimed to seek "lasting peace" but right now it is continuing the fighting.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫声称寻求“持久和平” ，但目前仍在继续战斗。

paras.en: On Monday, Zelensky claimed that Russia had hit several energy targets across Ukraine during the night and into the morning.
paras.zh: 周一，泽伦斯基声称，俄罗斯在夜间和早上击中了乌克兰各地的几个能源目标。

paras.en: "This window of opportunity should be used to knock Ukraine back to the Stone Age and force it to accept peace on Russia's terms," the pro-government Moskovsky Komsomolets has written.
paras.zh: 亲政府莫斯科夫斯基·科姆索莫列茨（ Moskovsky Komsomolets ）写道： “应该利用这个机会之窗将乌克兰打回到石器时代，迫使它按照俄罗斯的条件接受和平。”

paras.en: The Kremlin's objective hasn't changed: Ukraine's capitulation.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫的目标没有改变：乌克兰投降。

paras.en: Moscow seems to believe that the diesel deal with Trump and the US president's growing impatience with Zelensky will help Russia secure its goal.
paras.zh: 莫斯科似乎认为，与特朗普达成的柴油协议以及美国总统对泽伦斯基越来越不耐烦，将有助于俄罗斯实现其目标。

articles.title: Six Ukrainian energy sites hit by Russia since Trump announced ceasefire, Zelensky says

paras.en: Russia struck six Ukrainian energy facilities hours after US President Donald Trump announced the two countries had agreed to an energy ceasefire, Volodymyr Zelensky has said.
paras.zh: Volodymyr Zelensky表示，在美国总统唐纳德特朗普宣布两国同意能源停火数小时后，俄罗斯袭击了六个乌克兰能源设施。

paras.en: Despite Trump stating on Sunday the truce would be "effective immediately", the Ukrainian president said Russia had hit "our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities".
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普周日表示停火协议将“立即生效” ，但乌克兰总统表示，俄罗斯已经袭击了“我们的加油站，能源基础设施和其他设施”。

paras.en: There were blackouts in the city of Izyum after a Russian strike destroyed power grids, Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform said, while energy and railway infrastructure in western Ukraine was also targeted overnight.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家通讯社Ukrinform表示，在俄罗斯罢工摧毁电网后， Izyum市停电，而乌克兰西部的能源和铁路基础设施也在一夜之间成为目标。

paras.en: On Monday, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Ukraine does not deserve the "respite" a ceasefire would bring.
paras.zh: 周一，俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫（ Sergei Lavrov ）表示，乌克兰不应该得到停火带来的“喘息”机会。

paras.en: Zelensky said 33 people had been injured in the strikes on energy facilities across the country.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，在全国各地能源设施的罢工中，有33人受伤。

paras.en: He told Fox News: "We did not attack, while Russia attacked our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities."
paras.zh: 他告诉福克斯新闻： “我们没有发动袭击，而俄罗斯袭击了我们的加油站、能源基础设施和其他设施。”

paras.en: "I think it was Putin's answer to President Trump," he added.
paras.zh: “我认为这是普京对特朗普总统的回答，”他补充说。

paras.en: Global conflicts have pushed fuel prices higher ahead of the US midterm elections and on Friday Trump announced a plan to import Russian diesel into the US on Friday.
paras.zh: 全球冲突推高了美国中期选举前的燃油价格，特朗普周五宣布了向美国进口俄罗斯柴油的计划。

paras.en: On Monday, Ukraine's state-owned grid operator Ukrenergo reported "new power cuts" in Kharkiv, Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia due to damage caused to energy equipment by Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 周一，乌克兰国有电网运营商Ukrenergo报告称，由于俄罗斯袭击造成能源设备损坏，哈尔科夫、顿涅茨克和扎波罗热的“新停电”。

paras.en: Electricity rationing has been introduced in parts of Ukraine to avoid overloading damaged equipment, Ukrenergo said.
paras.zh: Ukrenergo说，乌克兰部分地区已引入电力配给，以避免损坏的设备超载。

paras.en: Zelensky said on X the strikes were proof Russia was "unwilling to accept an energy ceasefire".
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，这次罢工证明了俄罗斯“不愿意接受能源停火”。

paras.en: On Monday evening, Kyiv's mayor Vitali Klitschko posted on Telegram that a drone hit a 25-story residential building in the Darnytskyi district.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科（ Vitali Klitschko ）在电报上发布消息称，一架无人机击中了达尔尼茨基区一栋25层的住宅楼。

paras.en: Several cars in the building's courtyard were also on fire, he said, with one person dead and 11 injured.
paras.zh: 他说，大楼院子里的几辆汽车也着火了，一人死亡， 11人受伤。

paras.en: When Trump first announced the ceasefire on Sunday, Zelensky said it was "news to him" that a truce was in effect, but he backed the proposed ceasefire as a "major step toward ending the war, if the Americans truly step in now and make sure Russians respect the energy ceasefire".
paras.zh: 当特朗普周日首次宣布停火时，泽伦斯基表示，停火协议生效对他来说是“新闻” ，但他支持拟议的停火，认为这是“结束战争的重要一步，如果美国人现在真正介入并确保俄罗斯人尊重能源停火”。

paras.en: Asked about the ceasefire on Monday, Trump said they agreed "because I said you agree", adding that the war "has to get settled".
paras.zh: 当被问及周一的停火时，特朗普表示他们同意“因为我说你同意” ，并补充说战争“必须得到解决”。

paras.en: "That war is a disaster if you see the numbers," he said.
paras.zh: “如果你看到数字，那场战争就是一场灾难，”他说。

paras.en: For months, Ukraine and Russia have been exchanging strikes on energy infrastructure, disrupting energy supplies on both sides.
paras.zh: 几个月来，乌克兰和俄罗斯一直在对能源基础设施进行罢工，扰乱了双方的能源供应。

paras.en: Moscow has said the installations it hits are legitimate targets as they support Ukraine's military operation, while Zelensky has characterised Ukrainian attacks deep inside Russian territory as part of an effort to "reduce Russia's ability to finance the war".
paras.zh: 莫斯科表示，它袭击的设施是合法的目标，因为它们支持乌克兰的军事行动，而泽伦斯基则将乌克兰在俄罗斯领土内的袭击描述为“降低俄罗斯资助战争的能力”的一部分。

paras.en: Analysis by BBC Verify on both Ukrainian and Russian strikes during the war have found both sides have increased their attacks in the lead up to the next winter.
paras.zh: BBC Verify对乌克兰和俄罗斯在战争期间的罢工进行的分析发现，双方都在明年冬天之前加大了攻击力度。

paras.en: In 2026, BBC Verify has recorded 273 strikes on Russian-controlled oil and gas facilities, more than double the 124 recorded over the same period in 2025.
paras.zh: 2026年， BBC Verify记录了273次对俄罗斯控制的石油和天然气设施的罢工，是2025年同期记录的124次的两倍多。

paras.en: Separately, analysis of data aggregated by global conflict monitor, the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data project (Acled), recorded 2.4 times as many reported Russian attacks affecting Ukraine's energy network so far this year.
paras.zh: 另外，全球冲突监测机构武装冲突地点和事件数据项目（ ACLED ）汇总的数据分析显示，今年迄今为止，俄罗斯报告的影响乌克兰能源网络的袭击事件是其2.4倍。

paras.en: Trump has been urging Ukraine to stop strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, so Russia can fulfil the recently struck deal to release diesel to the US and the global market.
paras.zh: 特朗普一直在敦促乌克兰停止对俄罗斯石油基础设施的罢工，以便俄罗斯能够履行最近达成的协议，向美国和全球市场发布柴油。

paras.en: The deal temporarily undoes US sanctions on energy imports, which Zelensky described as a "gift" to Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 该协议暂时解除了美国对能源进口的制裁，泽伦斯基称这是给俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的“礼物”。

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Britain "strongly supports President Trump's call today for a sustained energy ceasefire to start now", while France, Canada and the EU also expressed support.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆（ Andy Burnham ）表示，英国“强烈支持特朗普总统今天呼吁从现在开始实施持续的能源停火” ，而法国、加拿大和欧盟也表示支持。

paras.en: However, there has been a mixed response among European officials.
paras.zh: 然而，欧洲官员的反应喜忧参半。

paras.en: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said the bloc would welcome an energy ceasefire "when it holds". Kallas said at a meeting of EU foreign ministers on Monday: "We haven't yet seen that also Russia will stick to it."
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯（ Kaja Kallas ）表示，欧盟将欢迎“一旦达成”能源停火。卡拉斯周一在欧盟外交部长会议上表示： “我们还没有看到俄罗斯也会坚持下去。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Estonia's foreign minister said the ceasefire was "not working".
paras.zh: 与此同时，爱沙尼亚外交部长表示，停火“不起作用”。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Benedict Garman, BBC Verify
paras.zh: BBC Verify的本尼迪克特·加曼（ Benedict Garman ）补充报

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.

The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.

articles.title: SCRS Launches Skillveri Simulator Rental Program to Help Members Upskill Technicians
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) has introduced a member benefit that gives collision repair businesses access to the Skillveri Chroma Mixed Reality (MR) spray painting simulator through an exclusive rental program.

The Skillveri Chroma features real spray gun integration, allowing technicians to practice refinish techniques on virtual workpieces using an industry-grade HVLP refinish gun. The rental model lets SCRS members evaluate new hires, run short-term training workshops and build technician skills without the cost, mess, or material waste of live paint.

“Training time and material costs can present barriers for small businesses, especially when actively working to build skill sets and improve entry-level technician learning curves in-house,” said Aaron Schulenburg, executive director of SCRS. “This program gives our members access to the same enterprise-grade simulator used by major manufacturers and community colleges, on a flexible, short-term basis that fits how their shop actually operates. This also presents fun opportunities to engage with job seekers, or the motoring public, while giving a hands-on look at industry skills. I can see a lot of creative applications!”

articles.title: AASP/NJ’s Russ Robson Scholarship Award Deadline Extended to Oct. 14
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Alliance of Automotive Service Providers of New Jersey (AASP/NJ) announced it has extended the nomination deadline for the Russ Robson Memorial Scholarship to Oct. 14. AASP/NJ will award the scholarship during its annual meeting Oct. 21 at Gran Centurions in Clark, N.J. The scholarship supports up-and-coming collision repair technicians.

Former association president Russ Robson is remembered for his dedication to education and professionalism in the collision repair industry. Each year, AASP/NJ honors his memory by awarding a deserving technician or student with scholarship funds.

“Russ set a great example for this industry through his commitment to training,” said Ken Miller, president of AASP/NJ. “AASP/NJ is proud to carry his legacy by awarding a talented professional in the hopes it inspires them to continue on in the field.”

The award is open to candidates nominated by AASP/NJ members. Eligible nominees include current employees of members or technical school students entering the industry. To nominate a candidate, click here.
For more information about AASP/NJ or to register for the annual meeting, visit aaspnj.org.

articles.title: Honda ready to test technology on public roads that charges EVs wirelessly
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Through a joint venture with two other companies, Honda has developed underlaying technology for a magnetic-coupling wireless power transfer road system (WPT road system), which will enable wireless in-motion charging of EVs, according to a press release.
Honda R&D, Taisei Corp. (Taisei), and Taisei Rotec Corp. (Taisei Rotec) plan to conduct demonstration testing of the system beginning in the Japanese 2027 fiscal year.
The system combines proprietary technology from each of the companies:
- Honda: High-power-density power receiver/transmitter units compatible with DC power distribution
- Taisei: High-response DC power supply system
- Taisei Rotec: Technology for embedding equipment in roads

“With these technologies, the system achieves high-power wireless power transfer (WPT) and excellent ease of installation in road pavement, envisioning applications for a wide range of mobility products, from passenger EVs to large commercial EVs,” the release states.

Honda says it has been working on dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT) technology since 2021. The technology supplies power to vehicles while they are in motion and reduces the frequency of charging needed at home or at a charging station, the release states.

“Initially, Honda will strive to put DWPT technology into practical use in the logistics and transportation sectors, where DWPT technology is expected to deliver significant benefits,” the release states.

Honda, Taisei, and Taisei Rotec have been conducting research and development of the magnetic-coupling WPT road system since 2025, according to the release. This has resulted in the development of the underlaying technology for the system.

This includes conducting experiments and validation testing on a test roadway at the Future Technology Field for Taisei Group/Satte (T-FIELD/SATTE). The tests verified the effectiveness of the technologies for a WPT system, road pavement structures, and road construction methods intended for demonstration testing on public roads with large commercial vehicles, according to the release.
- DC distribution-based ground assembly (GA) systems that connect multiple GA units embedded in the road using a DC connection
- A vehicle assembly (VA) unit installed on the vehicle

Honda says that to achieve the real-world implementation of a WPT road system, it is essential to develop GA units and pavement structures with sufficient strength to withstand the loads of large commercial vehicles and a power transfer system capable of handling high-power transfer to EVs driving at high speeds, while also offering excellent practicality for installation in roads.
Testing at the T-FIELD/SATTE focused on GA units and pavement structures capable of withstanding the traffic of large vehicles with a gross vehicle weight of about 20 tons.
It also tested whether the DC power supply systems can supply high-power electricity to a DC distribution-based GA system with high responsiveness and stability.
The GA units were also tested for highly practical installation and future upgrades.

Next, the companies plan to begin testing long-term durability in late 2026 through a loading test equivalent to 1 million wheel loads using actual vehicles. It will also conduct DWPT performance tests and evaluate measures to address electromagnetic field leakage.
“Through these tests, the three companies will strive to ensure both power transfer performance and the safety of the GA units as structures embedded in the roadway,” the release states.

After this phase, the companies plan to further verify performance at high power output levels of up to 150 kW for potential application to large commercial vehicles, as well as verification of the reliability of WPT performance for vehicles traveling at high speeds.

Honda says that all three companies will participate in the “Tateyama Project” starting during the Japanese 2027 fiscal year. It will include demonstration testing of DWPT technology conducted by East Nippon Expressway Company Limited on the Tateyama Expressway in Chiba, Japan.

“Striving to realize a sustainable mobility society where people can enjoy freedom of mobility well into the future, Honda will continue to pursue co-creation with a diverse range of partners beyond the automotive industry, including road infrastructure-related businesses, government agencies and energy-related businesses,” the release states.

articles.title: Toyota opens new battery center as part of ‘electrification transformation’
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Toyota has opened a new battery center in Saline, Michigan, calling it “the next chapter of its electrification transformation.”

According to a press release from the automaker, the Toyota Battery Center of North America (TBC) gives Toyota Michigan-based battery teams increased capabilities to evaluate and develop technology across the full battery-development cycle, from sourcing raw materials and customer applications to recycling.

“Toyota has long been at the forefront of battery development,” said Keita Moritsu, Toyota Motor North America R&D senior vice president and chief technology officer, in the release. “This center is where that leadership expands to North America — and where we’re building its next chapter.”
On site, teams of engineers and technicians assess battery performance and develop new technologies for use in hybrid, plug-in hybrid, hydrogen, and fully electric vehicles.

Toyota says the 30,000-square-foot facility serves as a central hub for development and evaluation, in partnership with Toyota’s North American manufacturing network, to support battery evaluation for Toyota Battery Manufacturing North Carolina, as well as the OEM’s vehicle manufacturing plants across North America.

“For Toyota customers, this facility means Toyota engineers can detect and resolve field concerns faster and closer to the source,” said Jordan Choby, Group Vice President of Powertrain, in the release. “It also means we can develop longer-lasting batteries designed to perform in the conditions American drivers face every day.”

Toyota says it will share research access at the facility with the University of Michigan Electric Vehicle Center. As a founding member of the center, Toyota says the program is a part of its commitment to developing the next generation of battery engineers and technicians in Michigan.

In 2025, Toyota began production at Toyota Battery Manufacturing North Carolina, its first battery plant opened outside of Japan. Located in Liberty, the $14 billion facility houses lithium-ion battery production lines for hybrid electric, plug-in hybrid electric, and battery electric vehicles.
Featured image: Toyota Battery Center of North America (TBC) in Saline, Michigan. (Provided by Toyota)

articles.title: NHTSA to modernize ‘outdated’ vehicle lighting standards
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) plans to modernize its outdated vehicle lighting standards, saying doing so will make America’s roads safer for all drivers, according to a press release.

NHTSA says an update to Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 108 is “long overdue,” and that it will accelerate the rulemaking process by consulting with industry stakeholders, safety advocates, and technical experts.
The release states the discussions will cover key safety and engineering challenges, including:
- “Addressing headlight glare: Examining the role that modern headlighting technology has on glare for other road users and making appropriate changes.
- “Modernizing lighting technology: Improving rules for LEDs, dusk sensors, automatic high beams, and replaceable light sources.
- “Improving performance: Evaluating how headlamp height and aim affect driver visibility.
- “Updating testing and materials: Streamlining test procedures for plastic optics and replaceable lenses.
- “Aligning global standards: Harmonizing U.S. vehicle lighting regulations with international safety standards.”
The release notes that this is the first time in more than 25 years that NHTSA is using negotiated rulemaking to update its vehicle lighting standards.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy plans to appoint up to 18 stakeholders across vehicle lighting manufacturers, motor vehicle equipment associations, safety organizations, research institutions, and engineering associations.
According to NHTSA’s rulemaking notice, it proposes the following representation:
- “Four representatives from vehicle lighting manufacturers or lighting retailers;
- “Two representatives from national motor vehicle manufacturers;
- “Four representatives from national motor vehicle or motor vehicle equipment manufacturing associations;
- “Two representatives from national motor vehicle or motor vehicle equipment safety organizations;
- “Three representatives from educational institutions or research institutions, or testing organizations within the United States; and
- “Three representatives from national professional engineering associations or standard-setting associations.”
The notice states that the committee will be “tasked with developing a detailed term sheet consisting of consensus recommendations to inform the agency’s rulemaking proposal.”
“NHTSA has long recognized the complexity of FMVSS No. 108 and the need to modernize the standard to facilitate new vehicle designs and emerging technologies,” the notice states.

It notes that NHTSA initiated rulemaking action RIN 2127-AL95 in the Spring 2018 Unified Agenda of Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions. The notice states that the ongoing effort led to a rulemaking petition from Osram Sylvania regarding LED replacement light sources.

“Given the technical challenges of updating these legacy requirements, NHTSA recognizes that the expertise of outside stakeholders is essential in any highly technical discussion of revising FMVSS No. 108,” the notice states.

“The effort will cover various topics of modernization, such as glare caused by headlighting systems, replaceable light sources, dusk sensors, plastic optical materials, semiautomatic beam switching, minimum lamp size requirements, lower beam photometry, upper beam photometry, on-vehicle headlamps performance that considers aim and mounting height, auxiliary lamp requirements, three-wheel motorcycle installation requirements, obsolete physical test requirements for associated equipment, physical test procedures for lamps that use replaceable lenses, and harmonization to international standards.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: NHTSA says an abstract published in the Unified Agenda for RIN 2127-AL95 includes some of the topics.

“Today’s standards do not allow automakers to deploy the latest safety-improving lighting technologies, so we are bringing key experts and stakeholders together to modernize our standards and address potential causes of glare,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in the release. “This collaborative approach will allow us to update outdated regulations, foster innovation, and keep everyone on our roads safer.”

NHTSA has asked for public comments on the rulemaking scope and committee membership. It also requests formal membership nominations. The deadline for comments and membership applications is Nov. 9. Both can be submitted here under Docket No. NHTSA-2026-1981.
In 2022, NHTSA issued a final rule allowing OEMs to install adaptive driving beam (ADB) headlights on new vehicles to increase visibility and reduce headlight glare.

NHTSA ruled that ADBs would improve safety for pedestrians and bicyclists by making them more visible at night and would help prevent crashes by better illuminating animals and objects in and along the road, according to the final rule. However, NHTSA states in the rule that “glare dosage,” or the amount of glare, “has not established, and does not know of, a quantified relationship between glare dosage and crash risk.”

articles.title: Autel In-Shop: How ACC Makes ADAS Calibration Highly Profitable
articles.author: Grace Chrisman

paras.en: Automotive Calibration Centers in Port St. Lucie, FL has built a profitable business around ADAS calibration. In this episode of Autel In-Shop, owner Al Urban explains how his shop uses Autel tools like the IA900 calibration system and MaxiSYS Ultra to streamline diagnostics, calibrations and documentation.

The episode breaks down the shop’s real-world workflow, why diagnostics and scan reports are critical, and how partnering with collision shops has helped grow the business. Viewers will also get insight into additional revenue opportunities like TPMS service and key programming.
Whether you’re already performing ADAS calibrations or looking to get started, this episode offers a practical look at the tools, processes and strategies behind a successful calibration operation.

articles.title: S&S Cycle to Award Engine to Builders Cup Winner
articles.author: Briana Hunt

paras.en: One of the most recognized names in American motorcycle performance is joining the inaugural Builders Cup at AIMExpo 2027. S&S Cycle will award a brand-new engine to the winning builder when selected custom motorcycles compete in The Builders Cup fueled by Drag Specialties, March 3–5 in Orlando, Florida.

Founded in 1958, S&S Cycle has maintained close connections with builders, racers, tuners and innovators in motorcycle performance. As a result, its involvement adds industry credibility to a competition celebrating the creativity and influence of today’s custom builders.
S&S Cycle Engine Joins Builders Cup Prize

During AIMExpo, selected builders will showcase their motorcycles inside The Builders Club. There, custom motorcycle culture will connect with manufacturers, distributors, dealers, media and other powersports leaders attending AIMExpo.
The Builders Cup winner will leave Orlando with bragging rights and a brand-new S&S Cycle engine.

“Builders have been part of the S&S Cycle story from the beginning,” said Howard Kelly, vice president of marketing at S&S Cycle. “They are the people willing to experiment, challenge convention and find new ways to turn performance into something personal and The Builders Cup celebrates exactly that kind of creativity. Putting an S&S engine in the hands of the winner gives us an opportunity to recognize a great build, while helping fuel whatever they create next.”

“A great custom motorcycle makes you stop and look, but the best builds stay with you long after and that’s what The Builders Cup is all about,” said Andre Albert, director of market expansion and events for the Motorcycle Industry Council. “Having S&S Cycle provide an engine for the winner speaks volumes about the caliber of this competition and the builders behind it. S&S has deep roots within the builder community, making this a natural fit, and giving the winner the opportunity to continue their story well beyond Orlando.”

articles.title: Diagnosing GM Super Cruise Systems
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: Super Cruise is GM’s hands-free driver-assistance system, offered on certain 2019-205 GM vehicles. Feature-wise, it combines adaptive cruise control, automatic braking, lane centering, driver monitoring, GPS and high-definition map data.

In the shop, diagnosis starts by separating a component fault or configuration problem from a normal system inhibit. A missing condition or failure in any of the above-mentioned areas can prevent engagement.

On an approved mapped road, Super Cruise uses Adaptive Cruise Control to manage speed and following distance while the lane-control system commands electric power steering to center the vehicle. The forward camera supplies lane information, and Adaptive Cruise Control sensing hardware tracks traffic ahead. The engine and electronic brake control modules carry out acceleration and braking requests. Because these modules exchange network data, a voltage, communication or configuration fault outside the camera can disable the system.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Super Cruise also compares GPS position with its map database. GM service information identifies the K179 Automated Driving Mapping Module and a LiDAR-scanned map database. Map and GPS-enhancement updates are downloaded through the vehicle’s OnStar Wi-Fi connection. The K73 telematics module supplies GPS and connectivity functions. If the vehicle cannot establish its location or does not have usable road data, Super Cruise cannot confirm that the road is eligible.

Before condemning hardware, verify the enabling conditions. Adaptive Cruise Control must be on, the Forward Collision System set to Alert and Brake, the road approved in the map database, lane markings visible, sensors unobstructed and the driver attentive. Teen Driver mode cannot be active. An OnStar plan and accepted terms may also be required. Requirements vary by model year and RPO, so identify the vehicle configuration before testing.

The secondary DIC message is often more useful than the general statement that Super Cruise is unavailable. “No Road Information” may indicate an ineligible road, an interchange, reconstruction, missing map data or lost GPS. The message “Sensors Can’t Find Lane Lines” can result from weak markings, glare or precipitation. “Sensor Blocked” points toward contamination. Other normal inhibits include an exit lane, a sharp curve, failure to center the vehicle or excessive speed. The referenced GM application lists 85 MPH, although limits are calibration-dependent.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “Could Not Recognize Face,” “Can’t See Face Clearly,” “Driver Attention Assist Unavailable,” momentary engagement followed by a takeover warning, and unexplained disengagement can originate in the monitoring system. Check for glare, a dirty lens, obstructions, steering-column position, a hand covering the infrared emitters, a loose B292 camera in the upper shroud, wiring damage or failed emitters. These complaints may occur without a DTC.

First, record the exact messages the customer received, along with road and location, weather, lighting, speed, engagement time and repeatability. Ask them about recent windshield, collision, steering, alignment, suspension, camera, radar or module work. Verify the OnStar account and terms when applicable, plus Wi-Fi and map-update status.

Next, perform GM’s vehicle diagnostic system check. Confirm battery state of charge, 9-16 V operating voltage where specified, clean and tight cables and grounds, intact fuses, seated connectors, correct power modes and the absence of interfering aftermarket equipment. Inspect lenses, radar areas and the steering-column camera before connecting the scan tool.

Run a full vehicle DTC scan and document every non-communicating module, DTC, symptom byte and current or history status. Do not erase evidence first. Diagnose voltage, internal-module, communication, power-mode and serial-data authentication faults before the Super Cruise symptom. Check applicable bulletins and calibrations. On covered 2021-2024 vehicles, intermittent startup U1624 in K124 may be a false loss-of-Ethernet fault caused by K73 telematics software; follow the bulletin and update K73. For other programmable modules, GM directs current software and a retest before replacement. Cruise data can retain the last eight disengagement reasons and the most recent engagement inhibit.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: For “No Road Information” without a related DTC, move the vehicle to an open-sky area and inspect the K73 telematics data, including Number of Satellites Tracked when available. A value that remains at zero, or an incorrect location during an OnStar blue-button check, supports a GPS or telematics fault on vehicles covered by the applicable bulletin. Separate that failure from temporary map, road or reception limits.

For low-light face-recognition complaints, verify all three infrared emitters on each side of the steering-wheel light bar. GDS2 can command them through K124 Image Processing Module 1 Processor 2 under Configuration Reset Functions and Driver Monitoring System Illumination Command. GM recommends a phone camera with a long-exposure function because infrared output may be difficult to see. If one side is dark, follow the VIN-specific circuit diagnostics.

Programming, setup and calibration requirements differ across the 2019-2025 range. Confirm RPO content and follow the exact SI procedure after related components are replaced or disturbed. Some 2022-2023 vehicles with RPO 07Z use an image-processing module only to complete CAN circuits. Installing a functional replacement can create a “Take Steering Wheel” message unless the published configuration procedure is followed.

Complete all required programming, setup and calibrations, then clear the codes only as directed. Road-test the vehicle safely on a known compatible route and reproduce the original conditions. Confirm that the enabling indicators appear, the original DIC message does not return, driver monitoring responds and no faults reset. A successful bay check does not prove the complaint is resolved by itself.

articles.title: Where Steering and Suspension Problems Come From
articles.author: TrakMotive

paras.en: Ever drive a vehicle that just doesn’t feel right anymore? Maybe it wanders down the highway. Maybe there’s a clunk every time you hit a pothole. Maybe the steering wheel isn’t centered, the tires are wearing unevenly, or it just doesn’t inspire the confidence it used to.

The truth is, steering and suspension problems rarely come from a single worn out part. Every control arm, ball joint, tie rod, sway bar link, and bushing work together as one connected system. When one connection starts to wear, it puts added stress on the rest of the system, and before long, that small problem becomes several bigger ones.
That system level approach is exactly how TrakMotive has positioned its Suspensia brand chassis program. Learn more about it in this video, sponsored by TrakMotive.
