paras.zh: 研究人员在报告中解释说：“这些都是恶意人工智能，包括利用人工智能制造新的生物武器，以及核冲突和核饥荒。”他们指出，其他潜在的灭绝级别的危险，例如小行星撞击或超级火山喷发，由于本世纪发生的可能性非常低，因此被忽视了。

paras.en: Another possible event with hypothesized extinction potential for humanity – the creation of 'mirror life' – was similarly left out because it has not yet been developed, and despite the theoretical dangers to human health, it's too early to quantify them.
paras.zh: 另一种可能对人类具有灭绝潜力的事件——“镜子生命”的创造——同样被排除在外，因为它尚未开发出来，尽管理论上对人类健康存在危险，但现在量化它们还为时过早。

paras.en: After the special cases of malicious AI and nuclear conflict, the researchers identified 15 major catastrophic risks, each associated with more than 1 billion potentially avoidable DALYs between now and 2100.
paras.zh: 在恶意人工智能和核冲突的特殊案例之后，研究人员确定了 15 种重大灾难性风险，每一种风险都与从现在到 2100 年期间超过 10 亿个可能可避免的伤残调整生命年 (DALY) 相关。

paras.en: "For reference, 1 billion DALYs is equivalent to two COVID-19 pandemics," the researchers write, "showing that these are critical threats for governments and the global community to address."
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“作为参考，10 亿伤残调整生命年相当于两次 COVID-19 大流行，这表明这些是政府和国际社会需要应对的重大威胁。”

paras.en: Among this category, the researchers identified: air pollution, antimicrobial resistance, childhood malnutrition, climate change, the collapse of international aid funding for health, conventional armed conflict, high alcohol use, high blood pressure, income inequality, low educational attainment, naturally occurring pandemics, obesity, poor mental health, smoking, and unhealthy aging.
paras.zh: 研究人员在这一类别中发现了：空气污染、抗菌素耐药性、儿童营养不良、气候变化、国际卫生援助资金崩溃、常规武装冲突、大量饮酒、高血压、收入不平等、教育程度低、自然发生的流行病、肥胖、心理健康状况不佳、吸烟和不健康的老龄化。

paras.en: Of these, the threat with the largest potentially avoidable burden was obesity (including the health effects of high BMI, poor diet, and low physical activity), with an estimated 23.1 billion DALYs – corresponding to about 46 COVID-19 pandemics – being the difference between the best- and worst-case scenarios by 2100.
paras.zh: 其中，最大的潜在可避免负担的威胁是肥胖（包括高 BMI、不良饮食和低体力活动对健康的影响），预计 231 亿伤残调整生命年（相当于约 46 次 COVID-19 大流行）是到 2100 年最好情况和最坏情况之间的差异。

paras.en: After obesity, the largest potentially avoidable health burdens were low educational attainment and income inequality, with higher rates of education projected to reduce the burden of disease both by improving people's health and slowing population growth.
paras.zh: 除了肥胖之外，最大的可避免的健康负担是教育程度低和收入不平等，预计较高的教育率可以通过改善人们的健康和减缓人口增长来减轻疾病负担。

paras.en: Under the researchers' baseline forecast, the total global burden of disease and injury between 2025 and 2100 amounts to an estimated 246 billion DALYs – equivalent to roughly 500 COVID-19 pandemics.
paras.zh: 根据研究人员的基线预测，2025 年至 2100 年间，全球疾病和伤害总负担估计达 2,460 亿伤残调整生命年，相当于大约 500 次 COVID-19 大流行。

paras.en: Such is the scale of the issues at stake – but it's important to note that, since the burden of each threat was calculated individually, the total burdens can't be added together like that, as it would over-count the overlap in health problems faced by individuals.
paras.zh: 这就是所涉问题的规模，但值得注意的是，由于每个威胁的负担都是单独计算的，因此总负担不能像这样加在一起，因为这会过多计算个人面临的健康问题的重叠部分。

paras.en: On that note, one of the key points the researchers emphasize is just how interconnected many of these health dangers are, and how solving these problems calls for a long-term and multi-faceted approach that doesn't simply combat individual problems in isolation.
paras.zh: 在这一点上，研究人员强调的关键点之一是，许多健康危险是如何相互关联的，以及解决这些问题如何需要采取长期和多方面的方法，而不仅仅是孤立地解决个别问题。

paras.en: Instead, the researchers make three key recommendations, calling for governments to build and fund threat-ready health systems, to dramatically increase investment in breakthrough innovation (in areas like health, climate, and technology), and to create a "Monitor of 21st Century Global Threats to Health" to continually track and update threat assessments.
paras.zh: 相反，研究人员提出了三项关键建议，呼吁各国政府建立并资助应对威胁的卫生系统，大幅增加对突破性创新（在健康、气候和技术等领域）的投资，并创建“21世纪全球健康威胁监测器”以持续跟踪和更新威胁评估。

paras.en: "Perhaps the most important contribution of this Commission is to move global health beyond the consideration of individual harms," The Lancet's editors write in an accompanying editorial perspective.
paras.zh: “也许该委员会最重要的贡献是使全球健康超越对个人危害的考虑，”《柳叶刀》的编辑在随附的社论观点中写道。

paras.en: "The unpleasant reality is that the threats we face are multiple, complex, and difficult… We believe this Commission can catalyze international, regional, and national actions to protect and strengthen the future of health and humanity. Doing so will require all of us to think much more broadly about where the biggest threats lie."
paras.zh: “令人不快的现实是，我们面临的威胁是多重、复杂和困难的……我们相信，该委员会可以促进国际、区域和国家行动，以保护和加强健康和人类的未来。这样做需要我们所有人更广泛地思考最大的威胁在哪里。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in The Lancet.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《柳叶刀》上。

articles.title: NASA captures a stunning transformation in Australia's red outback

paras.en: NASA captures a stunning transformation in Australia's red outback
paras.zh: 美国宇航局 (NASA) 捕捉到澳大利亚红色内陆地区令人惊叹的转变

paras.en: - Australia's normally dry, rust-colored outback has erupted into a spectacular carpet of wildflowers after unusually heavy rains, potentially producing its most impressive bloom in nearly 20 years. NASA satellite images capture the stunning transformation, which has even brought rare flowers to the grounds of a remote deep-space observatory.
paras.zh: - 澳大利亚一向干燥、铁锈色的内陆地区在一场异常大雨之后，突然绽放出壮观的野花地毯，有可能绽放出近 20 年来最令人印象深刻的花朵。美国宇航局的卫星图像捕捉到了这一令人惊叹的转变，甚至为偏远的深空天文台的地面带来了罕见的花朵。

paras.en: A spectacular explosion of wildflowers has transformed the normally dry, rust-colored landscape of Western Australia into a vibrant patchwork of green and colorful blooms. The remarkable display followed months of unusually wet weather, awakening seeds that had been lying dormant beneath the soil.
paras.zh: 壮观的野花绽放，将西澳大利亚通常干燥的铁锈色景观变成了充满活力的绿色和多彩花朵拼凑而成。这次非凡的展示是在几个月异常潮湿的天气之后发生的，唤醒了一直休眠在土壤下的种子。

paras.en: By late winter 2026 in the Southern Hemisphere, large stretches of the region's arid shrubland were covered in flowers. Local experts believe this could be the most impressive wildflower season the area has experienced in nearly 20 years.
paras.zh: 到 2026 年冬末，南半球该地区大片干旱的灌木丛已被鲜花覆盖。当地专家认为，这可能是该地区近 20 年来最令人印象深刻的野花季节。

paras.en: NASA satellite imagery reveals just how dramatically the landscape changed in a single year.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的卫星图像揭示了一年内地貌发生了多么巨大的变化。

paras.en: NASA Satellite Images Reveal a Dramatic Transformation
paras.zh: 美国宇航局卫星图像揭示了巨大的转变

paras.en: The images above were collected by the OLI (Operational Land Imager) aboard the NASA-USGS Landsat 8 satellite. They show the same part of Western Australia in late August 2025 (left) and late August 2026 (right), highlighting the striking increase in vegetation following the unusually wet conditions.
paras.zh: 上面的图像是由 NASA-USGS Landsat 8 卫星上的 OLI（操作陆地成像仪）收集的。它们显示了 2025 年 8 月下旬（左）和 2026 年 8 月下旬（右）西澳大利亚州的同一部分，突出显示了异常潮湿的条件后植被的显着增加。

paras.en: The location is in the Murchison region, approximately 600 kilometers (370 miles) north of Perth. This remote stretch of the Australian outback is an important grazing area for sheep and cattle, with a landscape typically dominated by hardy plants adapted to limited rainfall.
paras.zh: 该地点位于珀斯以北约 600 公里（370 英里）处的默奇森地区。澳大利亚内陆的这片偏远地区是牛羊的重要放牧区，这里的景观通常以适应有限降雨的耐寒植物为主。

paras.en: Much of the region's vegetation consists of grasses, saltbush, and mulga, a slow-growing evergreen tree capable of surviving in dry conditions. Wildflowers also emerge periodically, but their abundance can vary dramatically depending on how much rain falls.
paras.zh: 该地区的大部分植被由草、盐灌木和穆尔加组成，穆尔加是一种生长缓慢的常绿乔木，能够在干燥条件下生存。野花也会定期出现，但它们的丰度会根据降雨量的不同而发生巨大变化。

paras.en: Unusually Heavy Rains Trigger a Wildflower Explosion
paras.zh: 异常大雨引发野花绽放

paras.en: The exceptional display in 2026 was made possible by a series of cold fronts that carried much-needed moisture into the region.
paras.zh: 一系列冷锋为该地区带来了急需的水分，使得 2026 年的奇观得以实现。

paras.en: According to Australia's Bureau of Meteorology, June brought above-average rainfall, while August was much wetter than normal. These favorable conditions allowed seeds that had remained inactive in the dry soil to germinate, producing an extraordinary variety of wildflowers across the landscape.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚气象局称，六月的降雨量高于平均水平，而八月的降雨量则远高于正常水平。这些有利的条件使在干燥土壤中保持不活跃的种子得以发芽，在整个景观中产生了各种各样的野花。

paras.en: The colorful transformation extended into the grounds of a radio astronomy observatory operated by the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO), Australia's national science agency.
paras.zh: 丰富多彩的改造延伸到了由澳大利亚国家科学机构——联邦科学与工业研究组织（CSIRO）运营的射电天文观测站。

paras.en: Among the flowers were several threatened species, adding ecological significance to the seasonal spectacle. The observatory has helped track these vulnerable plants on land that was previously used for livestock grazing.
paras.zh: 这些花朵中有几种受到威胁的物种，为这一季节性景观增添了生态意义。该观测站帮助追踪了以前用于放牧牲畜的土地上的这些脆弱植物。

paras.en: Where Wildflowers Bloom Beneath Deep-Space Telescopes
paras.zh: 深空望远镜下野花盛开的地方

paras.en: While the flowers created an extraordinary scene on the ground, the observatory's usual work takes place far beyond Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 虽然这些花朵在地面上创造了非凡的景象，但天文台的日常工作却远远超出了地球大气层。

paras.en: Known as Inyarrimanha Ilgari Bundara, the CSIRO Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory is a remote research facility dedicated to studying the universe through radio astronomy. Its antenna arrays detect radio signals from celestial objects, allowing scientists to observe and catalog sources across the southern sky.
paras.zh: CSIRO 默奇森射电天文台被称为 Inyarrimanha Ilgari Bundara，是一个致力于通过射电天文学研究宇宙的远程研究设施。它的天线阵列检测来自天体的无线电信号，使科学家能够观察和记录南部天空的源。

paras.en: The observatory's isolated location is particularly important for this work. It sits within a designated "radio quiet" zone, where communication systems and electronic equipment are restricted to reduce interference with sensitive scientific instruments.
paras.zh: 天文台的偏僻位置对于这项工作尤为重要。它位于指定的“无线电安静”区域内，该区域的通信系统和电子设备受到限制，以减少对敏感科学仪器的干扰。

paras.en: Even relatively weak signals generated by human technology can interfere with radio observations, so limiting these disturbances helps astronomers detect faint emissions traveling across space.
paras.zh: 即使人类技术产生的相对微弱的信号也会干扰无线电观测，因此限制这些干扰有助于天文学家检测穿越太空的微弱发射。

paras.en: Australia's Radio Telescopes Have Helped NASA Explore Space
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的射电望远镜帮助美国宇航局探索太空

paras.en: Australia's radio astronomy facilities have a long history of supporting some of NASA's most important space missions.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的射电天文学设施在支持美国宇航局一些最重要的太空任务方面有着悠久的历史。

paras.en: The Murriyang radio telescope, located in Parkes, New South Wales, helped track Mariner 2 in 1962. That spacecraft became the first successful planetary science mission, marking a major milestone in the exploration of other worlds.
paras.zh: 位于新南威尔士州帕克斯的穆里扬射电望远镜于 1962 年帮助追踪​​了水手 2 号。该航天器成为第一个成功的行星科学任务，标志着探索其他世界的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: The telescope also played a significant role during the Apollo 11 Moon landing in 1969, serving as an important receiving station for communications from the historic mission.
paras.zh: 该望远镜还在 1969 年阿波罗 11 号登月期间发挥了重要作用，作为历史性任务通信的重要接收站。

paras.en: CSIRO additionally manages the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex, one of three major facilities that make up NASA's worldwide Deep Space Network.
paras.zh: 联邦科学与工业研究组织还管理堪培拉深空通信综合体，这是构成美国宇航局全球深空网络的三大设施之一。

paras.en: This global system maintains communications with spacecraft traveling throughout the solar system and beyond, while also supporting radar measurements and radio astronomy research.
paras.zh: 这个全球系统与穿梭于太阳系内外的航天器保持通信，同时还支持雷达测量和射电天文学研究。

paras.en: Both the Murriyang telescope and the Canberra complex contributed to NASA's Artemis II mission in April 2026, continuing Australia's decades-long involvement in space exploration.
paras.zh: Murriyang 望远镜和堪培拉综合体都为 NASA 2026 年 4 月的阿耳忒弥斯二号任务做出了贡献，延续了澳大利亚数十年来对太空探索的参与。

paras.en: For a brief period in 2026, however, one of Australia's most remote astronomical research regions offered a remarkable spectacle much closer to home. While its telescopes continued scanning the distant universe, unusually generous winter rains brought the surrounding outback to life in a brilliant display of wildflowers.
paras.zh: 然而，在 2026 年的一段短暂时间内，澳大利亚最偏远的天文研究区域之一在离家更近的地方呈现出了惊人的奇观。当它的望远镜继续扫描遥远的宇宙时，异常慷慨的冬雨让周围的内陆地区生机勃勃，绽放出绚丽的野花。

paras.en: Materials provided by NASA Earth Observatory. Original written by Lindsey Doermann. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 NASA 地球观测站提供。原创作者：林赛·杜尔曼。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists find hidden driver of aging and a simple amino acid that fights memory loss in mice

paras.en: Scientists find hidden driver of aging and a simple amino acid that fights memory loss in mice
paras.zh: 科学家发现了衰老的隐藏驱动因素和一种可以对抗小鼠记忆丧失的简单氨基酸

paras.en: - Scientists discovered that declining levels of a protein called Menin may help drive aging, and restoring it in older mice reversed several age-related changes in just 30 days. Even more surprisingly, supplementing with a simple amino acid called D-serine improved memory and learning, offering a potential new approach to age-related cognitive decline.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，一种名为 Menin 的蛋白质水平下降可能有助于促进衰老，而在年老小鼠中恢复这种蛋白质水平，可以在短短 30 天内逆转一些与年龄相关的变化。更令人惊讶的是，补充一种名为 D-丝氨酸的简单氨基酸可以改善记忆和学习，为与年龄相关的认知衰退提供一种潜在的新方法。

paras.en: What if some of the changes we associate with aging begin with the loss of a single protein deep inside the brain? Scientists investigating that possibility found that restoring a protein called Menin in older mice improved memory, balance, bone mass, and skin thickness in just 30 days. Even more surprisingly, supplementing the animals with a naturally occurring amino acid improved their learning and memory in only three weeks.
paras.zh: 如果我们与衰老相关的一些变化始于大脑深处单一蛋白质的丢失，该怎么办？研究这种可能性的科学家发现，恢复老年小鼠体内一种名为 Menin 的蛋白质，在短短 30 天内就可以改善记忆力、平衡性、骨量和皮肤厚度。更令人惊讶的是，给动物补充天然氨基酸仅在三周内就改善了它们的学习和记忆能力。

paras.en: The findings, originally published in March 2023 in PLOS Biology, came from researchers led by Lige Leng of Xiamen University in China. Their experiments identified a previously overlooked connection between inflammation, brain chemistry, and aging throughout the body. Although the results were obtained in mice, they raised an intriguing possibility: Some effects of aging may be influenced by biological processes in the brain that scientists could eventually learn to modify.
paras.zh: 该研究结果最初于 2023 年 3 月发表在 PLOS Biology 上，由中国厦门大学冷立格领导的研究人员领导。他们的实验发现了炎症、大脑化学物质和全身衰老之间以前被忽视的联系。尽管这些结果是在小鼠身上获得的，但它们提出了一个有趣的可能性：衰老的某些影响可能受到大脑中生物过程的影响，而科学家最终可以学会修改这些生物过程。

paras.en: Research published since then has added evidence that the brain plays an important role in regulating aging. It has also revealed why the seemingly simple supplement findings deserve careful interpretation.
paras.zh: 此后发表的研究进一步证明大脑在调节衰老方面发挥着重要作用。它还揭示了为什么看似简单的补充剂研究结果值得仔细解释。

paras.en: How a Hidden Brain Protein May Influence Aging
paras.zh: 隐藏的大脑蛋白质如何影响衰老

paras.en: At the center of the discovery is the hypothalamus, a small but powerful region near the base of the brain. It helps regulate essential functions such as body temperature, hunger, metabolism, sleep, and hormone production. Because these systems affect nearly every organ, changes in the hypothalamus can have consequences throughout the body.
paras.zh: 这一发现的核心是下丘脑，这是一个靠近大脑底部的小而强大的区域。它有助于调节体温、饥饿、新陈代谢、睡眠和激素产生等基本功能。由于这些系统几乎影响每个器官，因此下丘脑的变化会对整个身体产生影响。

paras.en: Scientists have increasingly recognized the hypothalamus as an important player in aging. One possible reason involves neuroinflammation, the brain's inflammatory response. Although inflammation helps protect against infections and injuries, persistent inflammation can interfere with normal cellular function and contribute to age-related deterioration.
paras.zh: 科学家们越来越认识到下丘脑在衰老过程中发挥着重要作用。一个可能的原因涉及神经炎症，即大脑的炎症反应。虽然炎症有助于防止感染和损伤，但持续的炎症会干扰正常的细胞功能，并导致与年龄相关的恶化。

paras.en: Earlier work by Leng and colleagues had identified Menin as a protein that helps restrain inflammation in the hypothalamus. Menin also participates in regulating gene activity, allowing it to influence multiple biological pathways.
paras.zh: Leng 和同事的早期研究发现 Menin 是一种有助于抑制下丘脑炎症的蛋白质。 Menin 还参与调节基因活性，使其能够影响多种生物途径。

paras.en: The researchers wanted to understand what happens when this protective protein begins to disappear with age.
paras.zh: 研究人员想了解当这种保护性蛋白质随着年龄的增长开始消失时会发生什么。

paras.en: They discovered that Menin levels gradually declined in certain hypothalamic neurons as mice grew older. Interestingly, the same decrease was not observed in astrocytes or microglia, two other important types of brain cells involved in supporting neurons and managing immune responses.
paras.zh: 他们发现，随着小鼠年龄的增长，某些下丘脑神经元中的 Menin 水平逐渐下降。有趣的是，在星形胶质细胞或小胶质细胞（参与支持神经元和管理免疫反应的另外两种重要脑细胞类型）中没有观察到同样的减少。

paras.en: To investigate whether this decline actually contributed to aging, the team developed genetically modified mice in which Menin could be selectively disabled.
paras.zh: 为了调查这种衰退是否真的导致衰老，研究小组开发了转基因小鼠，其中梅宁可以选择性地丧失功能。

paras.en: The results were striking. Mice with reduced Menin activity developed greater inflammation in the hypothalamus, thinner skin, reduced bone mass, and worsening cognitive performance. Their lifespans were also modestly shortened.
paras.zh: 结果是惊人的。 Menin 活性降低的小鼠下丘脑炎症加剧、皮肤变薄、骨量减少以及认知能力恶化。他们的寿命也略有缩短。

paras.en: Rather than simply accompanying aging, the loss of Menin appeared capable of helping drive several of its characteristic changes.
paras.zh: 梅宁的丧失似乎不仅仅伴随着衰老，还有助于推动其一些特征性的变化。

paras.en: Restoring Menin Reversed Several Signs of Aging in 30 Days
paras.zh: 恢复 Menin 在 30 天内逆转了多种衰老迹象

paras.en: The researchers then asked an even more interesting question: If declining Menin contributes to aging, could restoring the protein reverse some of the damage?
paras.zh: 研究人员随后提出了一个更有趣的问题：如果梅宁的减少会导致衰老，那么恢复这种蛋白质是否可以逆转一些损害？

paras.en: To find out, they used a gene delivery technique to increase Menin production in a specific part of the hypothalamus in older (20-month-old) mice. This region, called the ventromedial hypothalamus, helps coordinate metabolism, energy balance, and other bodily functions.
paras.zh: 为了找到答案，他们使用基因传递技术来增加老年（20 个月大）小鼠下丘脑特定部位的 Menin 产量。这个区域被称为下丘脑腹内侧区，有助于协调新陈代谢、能量平衡和其他身体功能。

paras.en: Just 30 days after treatment, the animals showed measurable improvements.
paras.zh: 治疗后仅 30 天，动物就表现出明显的改善。

paras.en: Their skin became thicker, bone mass increased, and performance improved on tests measuring learning, memory, and balance. Researchers also observed reductions in inflammation and improvements in certain metabolic changes associated with aging.
paras.zh: 他们的皮肤变得更厚，骨质增加，学习、记忆和平衡测试的表现也得到改善。研究人员还观察到炎症的减少以及与衰老相关的某些代谢变化的改善。

paras.en: In a separate survival analysis, mice receiving the Menin treatment also lived longer than untreated controls.
paras.zh: 在另一项生存分析中，接受 Menin 治疗的小鼠也比未治疗的对照组小鼠寿命更长。

paras.en: These findings suggested that some biological changes associated with old age could be at least partially reversed by restoring Menin activity in a specific group of brain cells.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，通过恢复特定脑细胞群中的 Menin 活性，可以至少部分逆转与老年相关的一些生物变化。

paras.en: But the researchers also uncovered an important clue about how Menin produced these effects.
paras.zh: 但研究人员还发现了关于梅宁如何产生这些效应的重要线索。

paras.en: A Simple Amino Acid Offers a Surprising Clue
paras.zh: 一个简单的氨基酸提供了令人惊讶的线索

paras.en: When Menin levels declined, the researchers noticed that concentrations of D-serine, an amino acid involved in brain signaling, also fell.
paras.zh: 当 Menin 水平下降时，研究人员注意到 D-丝氨酸（一种参与大脑信号传导的氨基酸）的浓度也会下降。

paras.en: Amino acids are best known as the building blocks of proteins, but some perform other important functions. D-serine helps regulate NMDA receptors, specialized proteins on nerve cells that are essential for communication between neurons, learning, and the formation of memories.
paras.zh: 氨基酸最著名的是蛋白质的组成部分，但有些氨基酸还具有其他重要功能。 D-丝氨酸有助于调节 NMDA 受体，这是神经细胞上的特殊蛋白质，对于神经元之间的交流、学习和记忆的形成至关重要。

paras.en: D-serine is closely related to L-serine, an amino acid commonly found in foods such as soybeans, eggs, fish, and nuts. The two forms have different biological roles. Although D-serine is also available as a dietary supplement, consuming ordinary serine-rich foods is not equivalent to taking the form used in the experiments.
paras.zh: D-丝氨酸与 L-丝氨酸密切相关，L-丝氨酸是大豆、鸡蛋、鱼和坚果等食物中常见的氨基酸。这两种形式具有不同的生物学作用。尽管 D-丝氨酸也可作为膳食补充剂，但食用普通富含丝氨酸的食物并不等同于服用实验中使用的形式。

paras.en: Further investigation revealed that Menin helps control the production of PHGDH, an enzyme involved in the biochemical pathway that generates serine (which was in turn regulated by Menin). When Menin activity decreased, this pathway became less active, reducing the amount of D-serine available to the brain.
paras.zh: 进一步的研究表明，Menin 有助于控制 PHGDH 的产生，PHGDH 是一种参与生成丝氨酸的生化途径的酶（丝氨酸反过来又受 Menin 调节）。当 Menin 活性降低时，该通路变得不那么活跃，从而减少了大脑可用的 D-丝氨酸的量。

paras.en: Restoring Menin increased D-serine levels in the hippocampus, a region especially important for learning and memory.
paras.zh: 恢复 Menin 会增加海马体中的 D-丝氨酸水平，海马体是一个对于学习和记忆特别重要的区域。

paras.en: This connection suggested that the cognitive effects of declining Menin might be partly explained by disruptions in D-serine signaling.
paras.zh: 这种联系表明，Menin 下降对认知的影响可能部分是由 D-丝氨酸信号传导的破坏来解释的。

paras.en: To test the idea directly, the scientists gave older mice D-serine in their drinking water for three weeks.
paras.zh: 为了直接测试这个想法，科学家们在老年小鼠的饮用水中添加了 D-丝氨酸，为期三周。

paras.en: The supplementation improved their performance on learning and memory tests, even without directly restoring Menin.
paras.zh: 即使没有直接恢复梅宁，这种补充剂也提高了他们在学习和记忆测试中的表现。

paras.en: However, there was an important distinction. While increasing Menin improved both cognitive function and physical signs of aging, D-serine supplementation primarily improved cognition. It did not restore the age-related losses in bone mass and skin thickness.
paras.zh: 然而，有一个重要的区别。虽然增加 Menin 可以改善认知功能和衰老的身体迹象，但补充 D-丝氨酸主要改善认知。它不能恢复与年龄相关的骨量和皮肤厚度的损失。

paras.en: That difference suggests Menin influences aging through several biological mechanisms, with D-serine accounting for only part of its effects.
paras.zh: 这种差异表明 Menin 通过多种生物机制影响衰老，其中 D-丝氨酸仅占其影响的一部分。

paras.en: Later Research Strengthens the Link Between the Brain and Aging
paras.zh: 后来的研究加强了大脑与衰老之间的联系

paras.en: Since the original 2023 discovery, additional studies have provided evidence that the hypothalamus helps coordinate aging across the body.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年最初的发现以来，更多的研究提供了证据表明下丘脑有助于协调全身的衰老。

paras.en: In a 2024 study published in Cell Metabolism, researchers at Washington University School of Medicine identified a different group of hypothalamic neurons that communicates with fat tissue. By maintaining or stimulating this communication pathway, they increased physical activity, improved age-related metabolic function, and extended lifespan in mice.
paras.zh: 在《细胞代谢》杂志上发表的 2024 年研究中，华盛顿大学医学院的研究人员发现了一组不同的下丘脑神经元，它们与脂肪组织进行交流。通过维持或刺激这种通讯途径，他们增加了体力活动，改善了与年龄相关的代谢功能，并延长了小鼠的寿命。

paras.en: That work involved a different protein and neural circuit from Menin, but supported the broader idea that signals originating in the hypothalamus can influence how the rest of the body ages.
paras.zh: 这项工作涉及与梅宁不同的蛋白质和神经回路，但支持了更广泛的观点，即源自下丘脑的信号可以影响身体其他部分的衰老方式。

paras.en: Another 2024 study in the Journal of Physiology and Biochemistry provided additional insight into Menin itself. Researchers found that increasing Menin helped protect cultured hippocampal cells against inflammation and a form of programmed cell death triggered by exposure to the stress hormone corticosterone. Although these laboratory experiments did not establish an anti-aging effect, they supported the idea that Menin has important protective functions in brain cells.
paras.zh: 《生理学与生物化学杂志》上的另一项 2024 年研究提供了对 Menin 本身的更多见解。研究人员发现，增加梅宁有助于保护培养的海马细胞免受炎症和因暴露于应激激素皮质酮而引发的程序性细胞死亡的影响。尽管这些实验室实验并未证实梅宁具有抗衰老作用，但它们支持了梅宁对脑细胞具有重要保护功能的观点。

paras.en: An even larger picture emerged in January 2025, when scientists published a detailed analysis of approximately 1.2 million mouse brain cells in Nature.
paras.zh: 2025 年 1 月，科学家们在《自然》杂志上发表了对大约 120 万个小鼠脑细胞的详细分析，一幅更大的图景出现了。

paras.en: The researchers discovered that some of the brain cells most sensitive to aging were concentrated around the third ventricle, a fluid-filled cavity in the hypothalamus. Many aging cells showed reduced activity in genes involved in normal neuronal function and increased activity in genes associated with inflammation and immune responses.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，一些对衰老最敏感的脑细胞集中在第三脑室周围，第三脑室是下丘脑中充满液体的腔室。许多衰老细胞中涉及正常神经元功能的基因活性降低，而与炎症和免疫反应相关的基因活性增加。

paras.en: These findings highlighted the hypothalamus as a potential center of vulnerability during brain aging, although they did not directly test the Menin pathway.
paras.zh: 这些发现强调了下丘脑在大脑衰老过程中是一个潜在的脆弱中心，尽管他们没有直接测试梅宁通路。

paras.en: New Findings in 2026 Reveal More Aging Pathways
paras.zh: 2026 年的新发现揭示了更多衰老途径

paras.en: Research published in 2026 has further strengthened the connection between hypothalamic activity and longevity.
paras.zh: 2026 年发表的研究进一步强化了下丘脑活动与长寿之间的联系。

paras.en: In a study published in Cell, scientists found that strengthening daily biological rhythms in a specific hypothalamic region improved several aging-related measurements and extended lifespan in male mice. The intervention also reduced estimates of biological age based on DNA methylation, chemical modifications to DNA that change with age.
paras.zh: 在《细胞》杂志上发表的一项研究中，科学家发现，加强特定下丘脑区域的日常生物节律可以改善一些与衰老相关的测量结果，并延长雄性小鼠的寿命。干预措施还减少了基于 DNA 甲基化（即随年龄变化的 DNA 化学修饰）对生物年龄的估计。

paras.en: Another 2026 study in Cell Metabolism identified a protein called Mimecan that helps skeletal muscles communicate with the hypothalamus and brown fat, a specialized tissue involved in generating body heat. Restoring circulating Mimecan levels in older mice improved this communication and extended lifespan.
paras.zh: 2026 年《细胞代谢》杂志上的另一项研究发现了一种名为 Mimecan 的蛋白质，它可以帮助骨骼肌与下丘脑和棕色脂肪（一种参与产生身体热量的特殊组织）进行沟通。恢复老年小鼠的循环 Mimecan 水平可以改善这种交流并延长寿命。

paras.en: Together, these discoveries suggest that aging involves complex communication between the brain and the rest of the body. Rather than depending on one master switch, multiple neural circuits, hormones, and metabolic signals appear to help determine how age-related changes unfold.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明衰老涉及大脑和身体其他部位之间复杂的沟通。多种神经回路、激素和代谢信号似乎有助于确定与年龄相关的变化如何展开，而不是依赖于一个主开关。

paras.en: Could D-Serine Supplements Protect the Human Brain?
paras.zh: D-丝氨酸补充剂可以保护人脑吗？

paras.en: The possibility of improving memory with a relatively simple amino acid is especially appealing. However, evidence that D-serine can reverse age-related cognitive decline in humans remains limited.
paras.zh: 用相对简单的氨基酸改善记忆的可能性尤其有吸引力。然而，D-丝氨酸可以逆转人类与年龄相关的认知能力下降的证据仍然有限。

paras.en: A small randomized clinical trial published in 2016 tested D-serine in 50 healthy older adults. Participants performed better on one assessment of spatial learning and problem-solving after receiving the amino acid, but researchers did not find significant improvements across the other cognitive tests or mood measurements.
paras.zh: 2016 年发表的一项小型随机临床试验在 50 名健康老年人中测试了 D-丝氨酸。参与者在接受氨基酸后在空间学习和解决问题的一项评估中表现更好，但研究人员没有发现其他认知测试或情绪测量有显着改善。

paras.en: More importantly, later research suggests that the effects of D-serine depend on the biological circumstances.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，后来的研究表明，D-丝氨酸的作用取决于生物环境。

paras.en: In an April 2025 study published in Cellular and Molecular Life Sciences, scientists investigated D-serine in mice genetically engineered to develop features of Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年 4 月发表在《细胞与分子生命科学》杂志上的一项研究中，科学家们研究了经过基因改造以产生阿尔茨海默病特征的小鼠中的 D-丝氨酸。

paras.en: Unlike the Menin experiments, which associated reduced D-serine with age-related memory impairment, this study found that an early increase in D-serine accompanied disruptions in brain signaling. Removing the enzyme responsible for producing D-serine prevented or reduced several later cognitive impairments in those mice.
paras.zh: 与 Menin 实验不同的是，D-丝氨酸减少与年龄相关的记忆障碍有关，但这项研究发现，D-丝氨酸的早期增加伴随着大脑信号传导的破坏。去除负责产生 D-丝氨酸的酶可以预防或减少这些小鼠后来出现的几种认知障碍。

paras.en: These findings do not invalidate the earlier results. Instead, they suggest that D-serine signaling is more complicated than simply having too little or too much. Its effects may depend on the condition being studied, the timing of treatment, and how the brain's signaling systems are functioning.
paras.zh: 这些发现并不会使早期的结果无效。相反，他们认为 D-丝氨酸信号传导比简单的丝氨酸太少或太多更复杂。其效果可能取决于所研究的病情、治疗时间以及大脑信号系统的运作方式。

paras.en: There are also unanswered questions about the long-term safety of D-serine supplementation. High doses have raised kidney safety concerns in animal experiments, and research has not established whether prolonged supplementation is a safe or effective way to prevent age-related memory loss in otherwise healthy people.
paras.zh: 关于 D-丝氨酸补充剂的长期安全性也存在悬而未决的问题。高剂量在动物实验中引起了肾脏安全问题，研究尚未确定长期补充是否是预防其他健康人群与年龄相关的记忆丧失的安全或有效方法。

paras.en: For now, D-serine should be considered an experimental approach rather than a proven treatment for brain aging.
paras.zh: 目前，D-丝氨酸应被视为一种实验方法，而不是经过验证的大脑衰老治疗方法。

paras.en: Can Scientists Eventually Slow Aging by Targeting the Brain?
paras.zh: 科学家最终能否通过针对大脑来延缓衰老？

paras.en: Despite the encouraging mouse experiments, researchers still need to answer several fundamental questions.
paras.zh: 尽管小鼠实验令人鼓舞，但研究人员仍然需要回答几个基本问​​题。

paras.en: Why does Menin decline in the hypothalamus as animals age? How many of its effects could be reversed by treatment, and how long would those improvements last? Could restoring Menin influence other biological systems in unexpected ways?
paras.zh: 为什么随着动物年龄的增长，下丘脑中的 Menin 会下降？有多少影响可以通过治疗逆转，这些改善能持续多久？恢复 Menin 是否会以意想不到的方式影响其他生物系统？

paras.en: It is also unclear whether treatments targeting Menin or D-serine could reproduce similar results in humans.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚针对 Menin 或 D-丝氨酸的治疗是否可以在人类身上产生类似的结果。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the original researchers believe the pathway deserves further investigation.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，最初的研究人员认为该途径值得进一步研究。

paras.en: "We speculate that the decline of Menin expression in the hypothalamus with age may be one of the driving factors of aging, and Menin may be the key protein connecting the genetic, inflammatory, and metabolic factors of aging. D-serine is a potentially promising therapeutic for cognitive decline," said Leng.
paras.zh: Leng 说：“我们推测，下丘脑中 Menin 表达随着年龄的增长而下降可能是衰老的驱动因素之一，而 Menin 可能是连接衰老的遗传、炎症和代谢因素的关键蛋白质。D-丝氨酸是一种潜在有前途的认知衰退治疗方法。”

paras.en: Leng adds, "Ventromedial hypothalamus (VMH) Menin signaling diminished in aged mice, which contributes to systemic aging phenotypes and cognitive deficits. The effects of Menin on aging are mediated by neuroinflammatory changes and metabolic pathway signaling, accompanied by serine deficiency in VMH, while restoration of Menin in VMH reversed aging-related phenotypes."
paras.zh: Leng 补充道，“老年小鼠的下丘脑腹内侧 (VMH) Menin 信号减弱，导致全身衰老表型和认知缺陷。Menin 对衰老的影响是由神经炎症变化和代谢途径信号传导介导的，伴随着 VMH 中的丝氨酸缺陷，而 VMH 中 Menin 的恢复则逆转了衰老相关表型。”

paras.en: The growing body of evidence points toward a potentially important shift in how scientists understand aging. Instead of viewing it only as the gradual deterioration of individual organs, researchers are investigating how specific brain pathways may actively shape the process.
paras.zh: 越来越多的证据表明，科学家对衰老的理解方式可能发生重要转变。研究人员并没有仅仅将其视为单个器官的逐渐恶化，而是正在研究特定的大脑通路如何积极地塑造这一过程。

paras.en: The possibility that restoring those pathways could improve memory, physical function, or longevity remains experimental. But the Menin discovery, together with subsequent findings, offers a compelling reason to explore whether some of the biological changes associated with aging are more reversible than previously thought.
paras.zh: 恢复这些通路可以改善记忆、身体机能或长寿的可能性仍然处于实验阶段。但梅宁的发现以及随后的发现为探索与衰老相关的一些生物变化是否比之前认为的更可逆提供了令人信服的理由。

articles.title: Popular weight loss drugs linked to a surprising fingernail problem

paras.en: Popular weight loss drugs linked to a surprising fingernail problem
paras.zh: 流行的减肥药与令人惊讶的指甲问题有关

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a surprising link between popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs and nail detachment, hair loss, and scalp inflammation.
paras.zh: 科学家发现流行的 GLP-1 减肥药与指甲脱落、脱发和头皮炎症之间存在令人惊讶的联系。

paras.en: - Popular GLP-1 weight loss drugs, such as Ozempic and Wegovy, have been linked to unexpectedly high rates of nail detachment, hair loss, and scalp inflammation, with some problems occurring several times more frequently among users. Researchers found that weight loss alone could not fully explain the differences, suggesting there may be more to these overlooked symptoms.
paras.zh: - 流行的 GLP-1 减肥药物，如 Ozempic 和 Wegovy，与指甲脱落、脱发和头皮炎症的高发生率有关，其中一些问题在使用者中发生的频率是其数倍。研究人员发现，体重减轻本身并不能完全解释这些差异，这表明这些被忽视的症状可能还有更多原因。

paras.en: Popular GLP-1 medications used for weight loss and type 2 diabetes (such as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, Victoza, and Trulicity) have been linked to an unexpected problem involving fingernails. A multinational study found that people taking these drugs were more than four times as likely to report nail detachment, a condition in which the nail separates from the skin underneath it.
paras.zh: 用于减肥和 2 型糖尿病的流行 GLP-1 药物（例如 Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro、Zepbound、Victoza 和 Trulicity）与意外的指甲问题有关。一项跨国研究发现，服用这些药物的人出现指甲脱落的可能性是其他人的四倍多，指甲脱落是指指甲与其下面的皮肤分离的情况。

paras.en: Researchers found that 39% of GLP-1 users experienced nail detachment, compared with just 9% of people who had never taken the medications. Nail discoloration was also considerably more common, and two-thirds (66%) of users reported at least one nail disorder.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，39% 的 GLP-1 使用者经历过指甲脱落，而从未服用过该药物的人中只有 9% 经历过指甲脱落。指甲变色也更为常见，三分之二 (66%) 的用户报告至少有一种指甲疾病。

paras.en: The findings, presented at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (EADV) Congress 2026, come from the first controlled study to investigate the possible relationship between GLP-1 medications and nail health.
paras.zh: 该研究结果在 2026 年欧洲皮肤病学和性病学会 (EADV) 大会上公布，来自第一项旨在调查 GLP-1 药物与指甲健康之间可能关系的对照研究。

paras.en: Unexpected Nail Problems Among GLP-1 Users
paras.zh: GLP-1 用户出现意外的指甲问题

paras.en: GLP-1 receptor agonists have become increasingly popular for managing obesity and type 2 diabetes. These medications act on a hormone signaling system that helps regulate blood sugar and appetite, making them effective tools for improving metabolic health and supporting weight loss.
paras.zh: GLP-1 受体激动剂在治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病方面越来越受欢迎。这些药物作用于激素信号系统，有助于调节血糖和食欲，使其成为改善代谢健康和支持减肥的有效工具。

paras.en: However, scientists are still investigating their potential effects on other parts of the body. Until recently, information about nail changes during GLP-1 treatment came primarily from individual reports of possible adverse reactions, rather than controlled comparisons.
paras.zh: 然而，科学家仍在研究它们对身体其他部位的潜在影响。直到最近，有关 GLP-1 治疗期间指甲变化的信息主要来自可能不良反应的个体报告，而不是对照比较。

paras.en: To investigate the connection, researchers examined 575 people using GLP-1 medications and compared them with 1,329 individuals who had type 2 diabetes and/or obesity but had never used the drugs. Participants were recruited from France, the United States, Brazil, and Mexico.
paras.zh: 为了调查这种联系，研究人员对 575 名使用 GLP-1 药物的人进行了检查，并将他们与 1,329 名患有 2 型糖尿病和/或肥胖但从未使用过这些药物的人进行了比较。参与者来自法国、美国、巴西和墨西哥。

paras.en: The results revealed a consistent pattern. Overall, 66% of GLP-1 users reported at least one nail disorder, compared with 53% of the control group. Nail discoloration showed an especially large difference, affecting 46% of users versus 17% of nonusers.
paras.zh: 结果显示出一致的模式。总体而言，66% 的 GLP-1 使用者报告至少一种指甲疾病，而对照组的这一比例为 53%。指甲变色表现出特别大的差异，影响了 46% 的使用者和 17% 的非使用者。

paras.en: Nail detachment was even more striking, with reports more than four times as common among those taking GLP-1 medications.
paras.zh: 指甲脱落的情况更为惊人，据报告，服用 GLP-1 药物的患者发生指甲脱落的几率是其四倍多。

paras.en: Weight Loss Alone May Not Explain the Nail Changes
paras.zh: 仅靠减肥可能无法解释指甲的变化

paras.en: One important question was whether the nail problems might simply be related to weight loss, rather than to the medications themselves. Rapid changes in body weight can affect nutrition and other physiological processes, potentially influencing nail and hair health.
paras.zh: 一个重要的问题是指甲问题是否可能仅仅与减肥有关，而不是与药物本身有关。体重的快速变化会影响营养和其他生理过程，可能影响指甲和头发的健康。

paras.en: However, the researchers found that weight loss did not fully account for the differences. Even when they limited their analysis to participants who had lost weight, GLP-1 users continued to report significantly more nail problems than those who had not used the medications.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员发现减肥并不能完全解释这种差异。即使他们将分析仅限于减肥的参与者，GLP-1 使用者仍然报告比未使用药物的参与者明显更多的指甲问题。

paras.en: "Until now, nail changes associated with GLP-1 therapies had essentially been anecdotal," said study author Dr. Charles Taïeb. "Our findings show a clear association, but they also underline an important point: not everything that happens during GLP-1 treatment is necessarily caused by the treatment itself."
paras.zh: “到目前为止，与 GLP-1 疗法相关的指甲变化基本上都是传闻，”研究作者 Charles Taïeb 博士说。 “我们的研究结果显示出明显的关联，但它们也强调了一个重要的一点：GLP-1 治疗期间发生的所有情况并不一定都是由治疗本身引起的。”

paras.en: The researchers emphasized that their findings do not prove that GLP-1 drugs cause nail disorders. Approximately half of the medication users said they had experienced nail problems even before beginning treatment.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，他们的发现并不能证明 GLP-1 药物会导致指甲疾病。大约一半的药物使用者表示，他们在开始治疗之前就遇到过指甲问题。

paras.en: When the researchers accounted for existing skin conditions and nutritional deficiencies, some of the differences between the groups became smaller. Nevertheless, nail detachment and discoloration remained approximately two to three times more common among GLP-1 users after these adjustments.
paras.zh: 当研究人员考虑到现有的皮肤状况和营养缺乏时，各组之间的一些差异变得更小。尽管如此，在这些调整后，GLP-1 使用者的指甲脱落和变色的发生率仍然是原来的大约两到三倍。

paras.en: Scientists Also Find Higher Rates of Hair Loss and Scalp Problems
paras.zh: 科学家还发现脱发和头皮问题的发生率更高

paras.en: The unexpected findings were not limited to fingernails.
paras.zh: 意想不到的发现不仅限于指甲。

paras.en: A companion study examining the same participants identified significant differences in hair and scalp health among people taking GLP-1 medications.
paras.zh: 一项对相同参与者进行的配套研究发现，服用 GLP-1 药物的人在头发和头皮健康方面存在显着差异。

paras.en: Half of GLP-1 users reported unusual hair loss, compared with 34% of nonusers. Reduced hair volume or density was also substantially more common, affecting 42% of users versus 19% of the control group.
paras.zh: 一半的 GLP-1 使用者报告有异常脱发，而未使用者的比例为 34%。头发体积或密度减少也更为常见，影响到 42% 的使用者，而对照组为 19%。

paras.en: Researchers additionally examined hair loss that began after treatment started. This was reported by 26% of GLP-1 users, compared with 12% of nonusers, making it more than twice as common in the medication group.
paras.zh: 研究人员还检查了治疗开始后开始的脱发情况。 26% 的 GLP-1 使用者报告了这一情况，而未使用者的这一比例为 12%，这使得该现象在药物组中的发生率是药物组的两倍多。

paras.en: Scalp redness was approximately three times more frequent among GLP-1 users.
paras.zh: GLP-1 使用者头皮发红的频率大约是其三倍。

paras.en: A particularly interesting finding was that hair loss rarely appeared by itself. Most users who reported shedding also experienced other scalp symptoms, including itching, redness or flaking skin.
paras.zh: 一个特别有趣的发现是，脱发很少单独出现。大多数报告脱发的用户还经历过其他头皮症状，包括瘙痒、发红或皮肤剥落。

paras.en: These accompanying symptoms raised the possibility that inflammation could be contributing to the changes, rather than the hair loss being explained entirely by rapid weight reduction.
paras.zh: 这些伴随症状提出了炎症可能导致这些变化的可能性，而不是脱发完全由体重快速减轻来解释。

paras.en: "This suggests that what is happening on the scalp may go beyond the classical shedding seen after rapid weight loss and involve an inflammatory component," explained study author Dr. Bruno Halioua. "Scalp inflammation was the rule rather than the exception, which clinicians do not currently look for and which may be treatable. Taken together, our findings suggest that factors beyond weight loss alone may contribute to the hair, scalp and nail changes observed among GLP-1 users."
paras.zh: 研究作者 Bruno Halioua 博士解释说：“这表明头皮上发生的情况可能超出了快速减肥后看到的经典脱落，并且涉及炎症成分。” “头皮炎症是一种规律，而不是例外，临床医生目前不会寻找这种情况，但这种情况可能是可以治疗的。总之，我们的研究结果表明，除了体重减轻之外，其他因素也可能导致 GLP-1 使用者观察到的头发、头皮和指甲变化。”

paras.en: What the Findings Mean for People Taking GLP-1 Drugs
paras.zh: 研究结果对服用 GLP-1 药物的人意味着什么

paras.en: Despite the relatively high frequency of reported symptoms, the researchers stressed that the findings should encourage awareness rather than alarm.
paras.zh: 尽管报告的症状频率相对较高，但研究人员强调，这些发现应该鼓励人们提高认识，而不是惊慌。

paras.en: "These changes are frequent, usually benign, and are not a reason to stop an effective treatment on one's own initiative," he said. "Anyone who notices hair shedding, an itchy or red scalp or nail changes should mention it to their doctor rather than discontinue therapy."
paras.zh: “这些变化是频繁的，通常是良性的，并不是主动停止有效治疗的理由，”他说。 “任何注意到脱发、头皮发痒或发红或指甲变化的人都应该向医生提及，而不是停止治疗。”

paras.en: There are also important limitations to consider. Both investigations were cross-sectional studies, meaning they examined participants' experiences without following them over time to establish how symptoms developed. The findings also relied on symptoms reported by participants rather than standardized clinical examinations.
paras.zh: 还有一些重要的限制需要考虑。这两项调查都是横断面研究，这意味着他们检查了参与者的经历，但没有随着时间的推移跟踪他们以确定症状是如何发展的。研究结果还依赖于参与者报告的症状，而不是标准化的临床检查。

paras.en: As a result, the studies can reveal patterns and associations, but they cannot determine whether GLP-1 medications directly caused the reported nail, hair, or scalp problems.
paras.zh: 因此，这些研究可以揭示模式和关联，但无法确定 GLP-1 药物是否直接导致所报告的指甲、头发或头皮问题。

paras.en: To investigate these questions more thoroughly, the research team plans to conduct prospective studies that follow patients from the beginning of treatment. These investigations will include standardized skin, hair and nail examinations along with biological monitoring.
paras.zh: 为了更彻底地研究这些问题，研究小组计划进行前瞻性研究，从治疗开始就跟踪患者。这些调查将包括标准化的皮肤、头发和指甲检查以及生物监测。

paras.en: The goal is to establish when the changes first appear, identify the mechanisms behind them, and determine whether they improve or disappear over time.
paras.zh: 目标是确定变化首次出现的时间，确定其背后的机制，并确定它们是随着时间的推移而改善还是消失。

paras.en: The research received institutional support from DUCRAY Laboratories (Pierre Fabre Group), a company specializing in dermatological and hair care products developed to help manage skin and scalp conditions and improve quality of life.
paras.zh: 该研究得到了 DUCRAY Laboratories（皮尔法伯集团）的机构支持，该公司专门生产皮肤科和护发产品，旨在帮助管理皮肤和头皮状况并提高生活质量。

paras.en: Materials provided by Beyond. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 Beyond 提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: The moon could turn astronauts into 'walking, high voltage capacitors' that accidentally zap spacecraft
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: NASA is asking for ideas to stop static electricity from zapping astronauts or critical hardware during moon missions.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在寻求想法，以阻止静电在月球任务期间伤害宇航员或关键硬件。

paras.en: The agency opened a "Lunar Grounding Challenge" to avoid situations where an astronaut on the moon could become "a walking, high voltage capacitor." Submissions for the $150,000 competition are due Jan. 15 and you can see the requirements here.
paras.zh: 该机构发起了“月球接地挑战”，以避免月球上的宇航员成为“行走的高压电容器”。 150,000 美元竞赛的提交截止日期为 1 月 15 日，您可以在此处查看要求。

paras.en: NASA is hoping to put astronaut boots at the lunar south pole in 2028 during the Artemis 4 or 5 missions, on the first landing mission since NASA's Apollo 17 in 1972. But simulations suggest that both "tribocharging" (electric-charge transfer between two objects) and plasma charging (from ambient gas in the region) could build up electric charge on spacesuits. "This problem is severely compounded when entering lunar shadows and permanently shadowed regions," the agency wrote, referring to deeply cratered areas where the sun does not touch the lunar surface.
paras.zh: NASA 希望在 2028 年阿耳忒弥斯 4 号或 5 号任务期间将宇航员靴子放在月球南极，这是自 1972 年 NASA 的阿波罗 17 号以来的首次着陆任务。但模拟表明，“摩擦充电”（两个物体之间的电荷转移）和等离子充电（来自该区域的环境气体）都可能在宇航服上积聚电荷。该机构写道：“当进入月球阴影和永久阴影区域时，这个问题会变得更加复杂。”这里指的是太阳无法接触到月球表面的深坑区域。

paras.en: The concern is that astronauts' spacesuits could become electrically charged, as there would be an excess of electrons (negatively charged particles) compared with ions (positively charged) in these areas.
paras.zh: 令人担忧的是，宇航员的宇航服可能会带电，因为这些区域中的电子（带负电的粒子）比离子（带正电的）多。

paras.en: "The risk occurs when an astronaut returns to the spacecraft," the agency added. The lander would have a slight positive charge, producing an issue once the "highly negatively-charged astronaut approaches the vehicle."
paras.zh: 该机构补充说：“当宇航员返回航天器时，就会出现这种风险。”着陆器将带有轻微的正电荷，一旦“带高负电荷的宇航员接近着陆器”就会产生问题。

paras.en: NASA has asked industry partners for ideas that can help an astronaut avoid "becoming a walking, high voltage capacitor", including issues such as an electrical arc that could damage spacesuits, spark fires in the oxygen atmosphere of a spacecraft, or create electrical shocks. (A Mars simulation in 2018 was reportedly derailed due to a crew experiencing electrical issues, so this problem is not unprecedented.)
paras.zh: 美国宇航局已向行业合作伙伴征求意见，以帮助宇航员避免“成为行走的高压电容器”，包括可能损坏宇航服、在航天器的氧气气氛中引发火灾或造成电击等问题。 （据报道，2018 年的一次火星模拟由于机组人员遇到电气问题而脱轨，因此这个问题并非史无前例。）

paras.en: The challenge aims to create designs that would safely discharge the astronaut and their spacesuit before an astronaut touches the lander. Among the technical requirements, NASA is looking for something small (in terms of mass, volume and power) that would be able to operate even in the extreme temperature swings of the lunar surface. The technology must also be able to help as many as four extra-vehicular activities (moonwalks) that take place over as long as 10 days.
paras.zh: 该挑战旨在创造出能够在宇航员接触着陆器之前安全释放宇航员及其宇航服的设计。在技​​术要求中，美国宇航局正在寻找一种小型的东西（在质量、体积和功率方面），即使在月球表面的极端温度波动下也能运行。该技术还必须能够帮助进行多达四次长达 10 天的舱外活动（月球漫步）。

paras.en: "In addition, the suspended lunar dust and heavy dust buildup on a suit in these environments significantly increases arcing lengths, allowing sparks to jump across larger gaps than they would in a clean vacuum. Therefore, the solution must aim to avoid a sudden arc that may come into contact with the outer pressure garment — suit — or the lander," NASA wrote in the challenge description.
paras.zh: “此外，在这些环境中，悬浮的月球尘埃和宇航服上积聚的大量灰尘显着增加了电弧长度，使火花能够比在干净的真空中跳跃更大的间隙。因此，解决方案必须旨在避免可能与外部压力服（宇航服）或着陆器接触的突然电弧，”美国宇航局在挑战描述中写道。

paras.en: The challenge will include multiple phases, including a concept design, concept refinement after chatting with reviewers, and then a final selection. NASA did not release a target date in its press release for when the tech would be available for astronauts, but the agency is planning on a long-term moon base for astronaut missions that would be largely ready to go in the 2030s if schedules hold.
paras.zh: 挑战将包括多个阶段，包括概念设计、与评审员交谈后的概念细化，以及最终选择。 NASA 没有在其新闻稿中公布该技术何时可供宇航员使用的目标日期，但该机构正在计划为宇航员任务建立一个长期月球基地，如果时间表不变，该基地将在 2030 年代基本准备就绪。

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell (she/her), Ph.D., was a staff writer in the spaceflight channel between 2022 and 2024 specializing in Canadian space news. She was contributing writer for Space.com for 10 years from 2012 to 2024. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, leading world coverage about a lost-and-found space tomato on the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪厄尔（Elizabeth Howell）（她/她）博士于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任太空飞行频道的特约撰稿人，专门报道加拿大太空新闻。从 2012 年到 2024 年，她在 Space.com 担任特约撰稿人长达 10 年。伊丽莎白的报道内容包括多份白宫独家报道、主导国际空间站失物招领太空番茄的全球报道、见证五次载人航天在两大洲的发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: Astronomers witness supermassive black hole gorge on a cosmic meal before 'burping' radio jets 300 days later
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Using the NASA X-ray spacecraft Swift combined with radio observations, astronomers have observed a supermassive black hole burping radio jets 300 days after a heavy cosmic meal. The team was also able to roughly estimate the mass of this feeding cosmic titan, which sits at the heart of the Perseus Cluster, a massive collection of thousands of galaxies.
paras.zh: 天文学家利用 NASA X 射线航天器 Swift 与射电观测相结合，观测到超大质量黑洞在饱受宇宙大餐 300 天后喷出射电喷流。该团队还能够粗略估计这个正在进食的宇宙泰坦的质量，它位于英仙座星团的中心，英仙座星团是数千个星系的巨大集合。

paras.en: The black hole sits at the center of the galaxy NGC 1275, located around 225 light-years away, and is the brightest galaxy of the Perseus Cluster. The supermassive black hole first flared in X-rays, which indicated an increase in the rate at which it was accreting matter. Actively feeding supermassive black holes sit in regions called active galactic nuclei (AGNs), with their immense gravity heating surrounding matter, causing them to glow brightly. These emissions are boosted by material channeled to the poles of the central black hole, from where it is blasted out as powerful twin jets that shine across the electromagnetic spectrum, particularly in radio waves.
paras.zh: 该黑洞位于 NGC 1275 星系的中心，距离我们约 225 光年，是英仙座星系团中最亮的星系。超大质量黑洞首先在X射线中爆发，这表明它吸积物质的速度有所增加。活跃的超大质量黑洞位于被称为活动星系核（AGN）的区域，它们巨大的重力加热周围的物质，使它们发出明亮的光芒。这些排放物受到引导到中心黑洞两极的物质的推动，从那里物质以强大的双射流的形式喷出，照射整个电磁波谱，特别是无线电波。

paras.en: The observation of the following radio jet from the AGN at the heart of NGC 1275 via flaring in radio waves is crucial for understanding the relationship between the disk of matter that surrounds and feeds the black hole, called an accretion disk, and the jets it launches. This so-called disk-jet coupling is key to developing a better picture of how black holes influence star formation in the galaxies in which they sit, and thus the growth of those galaxies.
paras.zh: 通过无线电波耀斑观测来自 NGC 1275 中心 AGN 的后续射电喷流对于理解围绕并供给黑洞的物质盘（称为吸积盘）与其发射的喷流之间的关系至关重要。这种所谓的盘射流耦合是更好地了解黑洞如何影响其所在星系中恒星形成以及这些星系生长的关键。

paras.en: Making these observations is no mean feat. The ideal spacecraft for observing X-ray emissions is Chandra, but it doesn't observe NGC 1275 frequently enough to observe its long-term behaviour. NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory may lack the power of Chandra, but having launched in 2004, it has collected a vast amount of data regarding NGC 1275 and its central supermassive black hole.
paras.zh: 做出这些观察绝非易事。观测 X 射线发射的理想航天器是钱德拉号，但它观测 NGC 1275 的频率不够高，无法观察其长期行为。 NASA 的尼尔·盖瑞斯·斯威夫特天文台可能缺乏钱德拉的力量，但自 2004 年发射以来，它已经收集了有关 NGC 1275 及其中心超大质量黑洞的大量数据。

paras.en: "It is fairly difficult to see the inner region of this AGN because NGC 1275 is at the center of the massive Perseus cluster of galaxies, which adds additional light to our observations," team leader Sarah Ketchum of the University of Michigan told Space.com. "We developed a model that allowed us to remove the cluster emission from archival Swift data, and in doing so, we were able to see the changes in the X-ray flux from gas accreting onto the black hole in NGC 1275, from 2007 to 2025."
paras.zh: 密歇根大学的团队负责人莎拉·凯彻姆 (Sarah Ketchum) 告诉 Space.com：“观测活动星系核的内部区域相当困难，因为 NGC 1275 位于巨大的英仙座星系团的中心，这为我们的观测增加了额外的光线。” “我们开发了一个模型，使我们能够从档案 Swift 数据中消除星团发射，这样，我们就能够看到从 2007 年到 2025 年，NGC 1275 中吸积到黑洞的气体所产生的 X 射线通量的变化。”

paras.en: Ketchum added that the capabilities of Swift were key to this investigation of NGC 1275, which is the ideal laboratory for the study of disk-jet coupling.
paras.zh: Ketchum 补充说，Swift 的功能对于 NGC 1275 的研究至关重要，NGC 1275 是研究盘射流耦合的理想实验室。

paras.en: "There have been studies on other galaxies with AGN that show evidence of coupling between gas accretion traced in X-ray light and gas ejection in jets, traced in radio light. But NGC 1275 reveals the impact of black hole jets on large spatial scales better than any other system," the University of Michigan researcher continued.
paras.zh: “对其他具有 AGN 的星系进行的研究表明，X 射线追踪的气体吸积与射电光追踪的喷流中的气体喷射之间存在耦合。但 NGC 1275 比任何其他系统都更好地揭示了黑洞喷流对大空间尺度的影响，”密歇根大学研究人员继续说道。

paras.en: Ketchum and colleagues saw the strongest ever X-ray flare from NGC 1275 in Feb. 2023. Lasting less than 60 days and consisting of two 5-day blasts, this episode saw a doubling of the X-ray brightness of the AGN at the heart of NGC 1275.
paras.zh: Ketchum 和同事在 2023 年 2 月看到了 NGC 1275 有史以来最强的 X 射线耀斑。这一事件持续了不到 60 天，由两次为期 5 天的爆炸组成，这一事件见证了 NGC 1275 中心活动星系核的 X 射线亮度翻倍。

paras.en: The flaring was so extreme that the team had to rule out a tidal disruption event (TDE) as the cause. These occur when an unfortunate star's orbit brings it too close to the immense gravitational influence of a supermassive black hole. This influence generates intense tidal forces that simultaneously squash and squeeze the star, "speghettifying" it and allowing the black hole to snack on some plasma pasta.
paras.zh: 耀斑非常严重，以至于团队不得不排除潮汐破坏事件（TDE）的可能性。当不幸的恒星的轨道使其太接近超大质量黑洞的巨大引力影响时，就会发生这种情况。这种影响会产生强烈的潮汐力，同时挤压和挤压恒星，将其“球化”，并让黑洞吃掉一些等离子面食。

paras.en: "We were able to rule out TDEs as a cause," Ketchum said. "Thus, the flaring was likely caused by a spike in the rate at which matter accreted onto the black hole."
paras.zh: “我们能够排除 TDE 的可能性，”凯彻姆说。 “因此，耀斑很可能是由物质吸积到黑洞的速度激增引起的。”

paras.en: Using Swift data, the team was able to infer the radius over which the AGN emits radiation. Because the size of a black hole is directly correlated with its mass, this meant that the researchers were able to constrain the mass of the black hole at the heart of NGC 1275. They determined that this supermassive black hole has a mass somewhere between 100 million times the mass of the sun and 1 billion solar masses.
paras.zh: 利用 Swift 数据，该团队能够推断出活动星系核发射辐射的半径。由于黑洞的大小与其质量直接相关，这意味着研究人员能够限制 NGC 1275 中心黑洞的质量。他们确定，这个超大质量黑洞的质量介于太阳质量的 1 亿倍到 10 亿倍太阳质量之间。

paras.en: The team then compared their data to known radio data to better understand the relationship between the X-ray emission and the radio jets that disrupt gas in NGC 1275.
paras.zh: 然后，该团队将他们的数据与已知的无线电数据进行比较，以更好地了解 X 射线发射与破坏 NGC 1275 中气体的无线电射流之间的关系。

paras.en: Ketchum added that she and her colleagues found tentative evidence of around a 300-day delay between the X-ray flaring and the radio wave emission. This indicates the time it takes plasma to travel from the base of the jet to a knot or shock created when it hits surrounding gas or dust.
paras.zh: Ketchum 补充说，她和她的同事发现了初步证据，表明 X 射线耀斑和无线电波发射之间存在大约 300 天的延迟。这表示等离子体从射流底部行进到撞击周围气体或灰尘时产生的结或冲击所需的时间。

paras.en: "This should be tested further in the future. Our X-ray data only sparsely sample the changes in NGC 1275," Ketchum said. "This makes it difficult to determine an exact relationship between the X-ray and radio radiation for large portions of our light curve, so we would need more X-ray data to further study this connection."
paras.zh: “这应该在未来进行进一步测试。我们的 X 射线数据仅对 NGC 1275 的变化进行了稀疏采样，”Ketchum 说。 “这使得我们很难确定光变曲线大部分的 X 射线和无线电辐射之间的确切关系，因此我们需要更多的 X 射线数据来进一步研究这种联系。”

paras.en: The researcher added that if the X-ray flares are produced close to the black hole, an echo of these flares should be seen coming from the accretion disk.
paras.zh: 研究人员补充说，如果X射线耀斑是在黑洞附近产生的，那么应该可以从吸积盘中看到这些耀斑的回声。

paras.en: "An emission line from neutral iron is seen in data from NGC 1275, and this may be the echo. However, we likely need many observations with XMM-Newton and XRISM ( X-Ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission) to really establish that connection," Ketchum concluded.
paras.zh: “NGC 1275 的数据中可以看到中性铁的发射线，这可能是回声。然而，我们可能需要使用 XMM-Newton 和 XRISM（X 射线成像和光谱任务）进行大量观察才能真正建立这种联系，”Ketchum 总结道。

paras.en: The team's research has been accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal Letters, with a pre-peer-review version available on the repository site arXiv.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究已被《天体物理学杂志快报》接受发表，并在存储库网站 arXiv 上提供了预同行评审版本。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: SpaceX launching 6,300 pounds of cargo to the ISS on Oct. 13: Watch it live
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: SpaceX will launch its latest cargo mission to the International Space Station on Tuesday morning (Oct. 13), and you can watch the action live.
paras.zh: SpaceX 将于周二上午（10 月 13 日）向国际空间站发射最新的货运任务，您可以现场观看这一行动。

paras.en: A Falcon 9 rocket is scheduled to launch a robotic Dragon capsule to the orbiting lab from Florida's Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on Tuesday at 6:33 a.m. EDT (1033 GMT).
paras.zh: 猎鹰 9 号火箭计划于美国东部时间周二上午 6:33（格林尼治标准时间 1033）从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站向轨道实验室发射机器人龙太空舱。

paras.en: You can watch the action live here at Space.com, courtesy of NASA, starting at 6:15 a.m. EDT (1015 GMT).
paras.zh: 您可以在 Space.com 上观看由 NASA 提供的现场直播，时间为美国东部时间上午 6:15（格林尼治标准时间 1015）。

paras.en: The launch will kick off the CRS-35 mission, so named because it will be the 35th that SpaceX flies under a Commercial Resupply Services contract with NASA.
paras.zh: 此次发射将拉开 CRS-35 任务的序幕，之所以如此命名，是因为这将是 SpaceX 根据与 NASA 签订的商业补给服务合同进行的第 35 次飞行。

paras.en: If all goes according to plan, Dragon will reach the International Space Station (ISS) on Thursday (Oct. 15), docking autonomously to the space-facing port of its Harmony module at around 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT). You can watch the arrival here at Space.com as well; coverage will start at 9:15 a.m. EDT (1315 GMT).
paras.zh: 如果一切按计划进行，“龙”号将于周四（10 月 15 日）抵达国际空间站 (ISS)，并于美国东部时间上午 11 点（格林尼治标准时间 1500）自动对接至其 Harmony 模块面向太空的端口。您也可以在 Space.com 上观看到达情况；报道将于美国东部时间上午 9:15（格林尼治标准时间 1315）开始。

paras.en: CRS-35 will deliver 6,300 pounds (2,860 kilograms) of supplies to the astronauts aboard the orbiting lab, including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays (iROSAs), which will boost the orbiting lab's energy budget.
paras.zh: CRS-35 将为轨道实验室上的宇航员提供 6,300 磅（2,860 公斤）的物资，包括最后一组国际空间站滚出式太阳能电池阵列 (iROSA)，这将提高轨道实验室的能源预算。

paras.en: There's also quite a bit of scientific gear heading up on the flight.
paras.zh: 这次飞行中还有相当多的科学装备。

paras.en: Dragon "will deliver hardware to manufacture artificial retinas in microgravity to help restore vision on Earth and 3D heart tissue models to advance large‑scale drug testing on future missions," NASA officials wrote in a CRS-35 launch preview on Oct. 7.
paras.zh: NASA 官员在 10 月 7 日的 CRS-35 发射预览中写道，Dragon“将提供硬件来制造微重力下的人造视网膜，以帮助恢复地球上的视力，并提供 3D 心脏组织模型，以推进未来任务中的大规模药物测试”。

paras.en: "The spacecraft will carry materials to study how a new type of glass forms in microgravity and brain organoids that could reveal treatment targets for neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's and multiple sclerosis," they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“该航天器将携带材料来研究新型玻璃在微重力和大脑类器官中如何形成，从而揭示神经退行性疾病的治疗目标，例如阿尔茨海默氏症、帕金森氏症和多发性硬化症。”

paras.en: Dragon will stay attached to the ISS for about a month, then head back down to Earth with scientific experiments and other hardware. It will splash down safely under parachutes in the Pacific Ocean off the California coast.
paras.zh: 龙将在国际空间站停留大约一个月，然后带着科学实验和其他硬件返回地球。它将通过降落伞安全地降落在加利福尼亚海岸附近的太平洋上。

paras.en: Dragon is the only currently operational freighter that can carry cargo in the downward direction. The other three — Russia's Progress, Japan's HTV-X and Northrop Grumman's Cygnus XL — are all expendable, burning up in Earth's atmosphere after their time at the ISS is done.
paras.zh: Dragon 是目前唯一运营的能够向下运输货物的货机。另外三架——俄罗斯的进步号、日本的 HTV-X 和诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司的天鹅座 XL——都是消耗品，在国际空间站结束后会在地球大气层中燃烧殆尽。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: World Space Week 2026 Celebrates the “Rocket Revolution”
articles.author: World Space Week Association

paras.en: HOUSTON, Texas (September 30, 2026)— World Space Week events, beginning October 4 in 100 nations, will celebrate how launch innovation has stimulated the rapidly-growing space economy and enabled new uses of space to help the world.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州休斯顿（2026 年 9 月 30 日）——世界太空周活动将于 10 月 4 日在 100 个国家开始，庆祝发射创新如何刺激快速增长的太空经济，并实现太空的新用途来帮助世界。

paras.en: “This year’s theme is the Rocket Revolution,” said Dennis Stone, World Space Week Association President. “It recognizes how increased space access and falling launch prices have stimulated the space ecosystem and exciting new space applications,” he said. The rocketry theme will also be used to inspire student interest in STEM, he added.
paras.zh: “今年的主题是火箭革命，”世界太空周协会主席丹尼斯·斯通说。他说：“它认识到太空准入的增加和发射价格的下降如何刺激了太空生态系统并令人兴奋的新太空应用。”他补充说，火箭主题还将用于激发学生对 STEM 的兴趣。

paras.en: Planned World Space Week 2026 activities include:
paras.zh: 2026 年世界空间周计划活动包括：

paras.en: ESA and The Pokémon Company International will celebrate World Space Week 2026 with a Europe-wide family exhibition combining real space science with Pokémon, alongside special Pokémon GO activities at participating museums.
paras.zh: ESA 和 Pokémon Company International 将为庆祝 2026 年世界太空周举办一场欧洲范围内的家庭展览，将真实的太空科学与 Pokémon 相结合，并在参与的博物馆举办特别的 Pokémon GO 活动。

paras.en: NASA Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will host a World Space Week Expo featuring Space Shuttle Atlantis, highlighting the Rocket Revolution and its impact on space exploration and access.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心将举办世界航天周博览会，以亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机为主题，突出火箭革命及其对太空探索和进入的影响。

paras.en: Students and rocket clubs around the world will put the Rocket Revolution into action by launching model rockets. In the U.S., enthusiasts will launch Vulcan model rockets provided by United Launch Alliance and Estes.
paras.zh: 世界各地的学生和火箭俱乐部将通过发射模型火箭将火箭革命付诸实践。在美国，爱好者将发射由联合发射联盟和 Estes 提供的 Vulcan 模型火箭。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Education and SUPARCO, Pakistan’s national space agency, will lead large-scale national celebrations, with thousands of schools and events engaging students and the public in World Space Week.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部和巴基斯坦国家航天局 SUPARCO 将领导大规模的全国庆祝活动，数千所学校和活动将吸引学生和公众参与世界空间周。

paras.en: UN-declared World Space Week, the largest space event on Earth, last year was celebrated by 50,000 events held by space agencies, schools, aerospace companies, and others according to the Association. World Space Week is held each October 4-10.
paras.zh: 据该协会称，联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，去年由太空机构、学校、航空航天公司和其他机构举办了 50,000 场活动来庆祝。世界空间周于每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行。

paras.en: John Elbon, former ULA Interim CEO, serves as Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2026 to help showcase the launch industry. Tory Bruno, President of Blue Origin National Security, will serve as Honorary Chair in 2027 with the theme “To the Moon.”
paras.zh: ULA 前临时首席执行官 John Elbon 担任 2026 年世界太空周名誉主席，帮助展示发射行业。蓝色起源国家安全总裁托里·布鲁诺 (Tory Bruno) 将担任 2027 年名誉主席，主题为“To the Moon”。

paras.en: “We encourage students and the public to celebrate space in their own way next week as part of the biggest space event in the world,” Stone said. The public can see what’s planned in their area at worldspaceweek.org.
paras.zh: 斯通说：“我们鼓励学生和公众下周以自己的方式庆祝太空，作为世界上最大的太空活动的一部分。”公众可以在 worldspaceweek.org 上查看他们所在地区的计划。

paras.en: The largest space event on Earth, UN-declared World Space Week is celebrated October 4–10 annually. It is an international celebration of the contribution of space science and technology to the betterment of the human condition. World Space Week consists of numerous space-related events held by space agencies, aerospace companies, schools, planetaria, museums, astronomy clubs, and others in a common timeframe to achieve greater student and public impact through synchronization. In 2025, 50,000 events were reported in 102 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行庆祝活动。这是一次国际性庆祝空间科学技术对改善人类状况所做贡献的活动。世界空间周由航天机构、航空航天公司、学校、天文馆、博物馆、天文学俱乐部和其他机构在同一时间范围内举办的众多与太空相关的活动组成，以通过同步实现更大的学生和公众影响。 2025 年，102 个国家报告了 50,000 起事件。

paras.en: World Space Week Association is the global coordinator of World Space Week. As an international non-government, non-profit organization, it serves as a permanent observer on the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space and is supported by voluntary contributions from sponsors including Blue Origin, United Launch Alliance, Texas Instruments, Firefly Aerospace, L3 Harris, BAE Systems, Black Sky, Airbus, Club for the Future, Cesium Astro, Space Foundation, Gaia Horizons, and Space News. The Association was founded in 1982 and is one of the world’s oldest space advocacy organizations.
paras.zh: 世界空间周协会是世界空间周的全球协调机构。作为一个国际非政府、非营利组织，它是联合国和平利用外层空间委员会的常任观察员，并得到了赞助商的自愿捐款支持，这些赞助商包括蓝色起源、联合发射联盟、德州仪器、Firefly Aerospace、L3 Harris、BAE Systems、Black Sky、空客、未来俱乐部、Cesium Astro、太空基金会、Gaia Horizo​​ns 和 Space News。该协会成立于 1982 年，是世界上历史最悠久的太空倡导组织之一。

paras.en: Dennis Stone, dstone@worldspaceweek.org (USA)
paras.zh: 丹尼斯·斯通，dstone@worldspaceweek.org（美国）

paras.en: Alma Okpalefe, aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org (Nigeria)
paras.zh: Alma Okpalefe，aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org（尼日利亚）
