articles.title: Energy prices rise after Trump’s ‘energy ceasefire’ fails to move Russia or Ukraine
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: Oil and gas prices rose Monday after an “energy ceasefire” announced by President Donald Trump on Sunday failed to gain traction.
paras.zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普总统周日宣布的“能源停火”未能获得支持后，石油和天然气价格周一上涨。

paras.en: U.S. diesel fuel futures rose slightly in late afternoon trading, while Brent crude oil jumped 2% to almost $108 per barrel and U.S. crude oil rose more than 2% to about $94.
paras.zh: 美国柴油期货在午后交易中小幅上涨，布伦特原油上涨 2%，至每桶近 108 美元，美国原油上涨超过 2%，至每桶约 94 美元。

paras.en: The price pressures continued to mount with just weeks to go before the Nov. 3 midterm elections. Republicans face a steep climb to maintain their majorities in Congress, and voters across the country cite high gas prices as a key issue affecting their votes.
paras.zh: 距离 11 月 3 日中期选举仅剩几周时间，价格压力继续加大。共和党人为了维持在国会的多数席位而面临着大幅攀升，全国各地的选民都将高油价视为影响他们选票的一个关键问题。

paras.en: The average nationwide price of diesel fuel Monday was $6.26 per gallon, nearly 80% higher than it had been at the start of the year, according to AAA data.
paras.zh: 根据 AAA 的数据，周一全国柴油平均价格为每加仑 6.26 美元，比年初上涨近 80%。

paras.en: The rising prices Monday came less than 24 hours after Trump declared that a ceasefire had been agreed to.
paras.zh: 周一价格上涨是在特朗普宣布同意停火后不到 24 小时。

paras.en: “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争已实现能源停火，立即生效。双方都已同意。不要破坏它！”特朗普在《真相社会》上撰文。

paras.en: Shortly after the president’s post, Russia renewed strikes against Ukrainian energy assets.
paras.zh: 总统上任后不久，俄罗斯再次对乌克兰能源资产发动袭击。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine learned about Trump’s ceasefire from media reports and was given no advance warning. He reiterated his position that Ukraine was open to an agreement not to target enemy energy infrastructure as long as Moscow agrees to it, too.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰是从媒体报道中得知特朗普停火的，并且没有收到任何提前警告。他重申了自己的立场，即只要莫斯科也同意，乌克兰就不会以敌方能源基础设施为目标的协议持开放态度。

paras.en: In the meantime, Russia continued with “glide bomb strikes and strikes on our energy infrastructure,” Zelenskyy said Monday, noting that a power plant in Kharkiv had recently been attacked.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯继续“对我们的能源基础设施进行滑翔炸弹袭击”，泽连斯基周一表示，并指出哈尔科夫的一座发电厂最近遭到袭击。

paras.en: “Ukraine has proposed many de-escalatory steps. Putin had one answer to all of them — ‘nyet,’” Zelenskyy said, using the Russian word for “no.”
paras.zh: “乌克兰提出了许多缓和局势的措施。普京对所有这些措施只有一个答案——‘不’，”泽连斯基说，他用的是俄语中的“不”一词。

paras.en: The Kremlin on Monday neither confirmed nor denied having agreed to a deal.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周一既没有证实也没有否认已同意达成协议。

paras.en: Trump’s Sunday announcement closely mirrored a similar post he made in September, when he announced that “Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise!”
paras.zh: 特朗普周日的声明与他九月份发表的类似帖子非常相似，当时他宣布“乌克兰已同意不攻击俄罗斯的能源目标。俄罗斯也同意这样做！”

paras.en: There, too, Zelenskyy said Ukraine’s participation hinged on Russia’s agreement to comply, which never came. Neither Ukrainian nor Russian strikes on the other’s energy assets slowed down in September.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基也表示，乌克兰的参与取决于俄罗斯是否同意遵守，但俄罗斯从未同意遵守。 9月份，乌克兰和俄罗斯对对方能源资产的打击都没有放缓。

paras.en: The dubious ceasefire Trump declared over the weekend followed a stunning announcement Friday in which the president said Russia would supply millions of barrels of diesel “to the American and Global Marketplace.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周末宣布的可疑停火是在周五发布的令人震惊的声明之后宣布的，其中总统表示俄罗斯将“向美国和全球市场”供应数百万桶柴油。

paras.en: The announcement came after a phone call Friday between Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin that reportedly lasted over an hour.
paras.zh: 据报道，周五特朗普与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了长达一个多小时的通话后宣布了这一消息。

paras.en: Trump said the deal with Putin would “immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace.” That would translate into about 2.25 million barrels of diesel, or less diesel than the United States uses in just one day.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，与普京的协议将“立即向美国和全球市场供应超过 30 万吨柴油”。这意味着约 225 万桶柴油，比美国一天使用的柴油还要少。

paras.en: Further details and logistics of Russia’s plan had yet to be announced Monday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯计划的更多细节和后勤工作尚未于周一公布。

paras.en: In addition to the Russia deal, Trump has pressured G7 allies to release more diesel fuel supplies in recent days and lifted domestic restrictions on an off-road variety of diesel.
paras.zh: 除了与俄罗斯的协议外，特朗普最近几天还向七国集团盟友施压，要求释放更多柴油供应，并取消了国内对越野柴油的限制。

paras.en: In order to clear a legal path for the diesel deal, the Treasury Department announced a six-month suspension of the fuel sanctions imposed on the Kremlin in 2022 for its illegal invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 为了为柴油交易扫清法律道路，美国财政部宣布暂停对克里姆林宫2022年因非法入侵乌克兰而实施的燃料制裁六个月。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials, European allies and some U.S. lawmakers were aghast at the deal and the U.S. decision to unilaterally ease Russia sanctions.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员、欧洲盟友和一些美国议员对该协议以及美国单方面放松对俄罗斯制裁的决定感到震惊。

paras.en: Trump defended the deal Monday, calling it “the right choice for the American People.”
paras.zh: 特朗普周一为该协议辩护，称其为“美国人民的正确选择”。

paras.en: Trump also said more diesel fuel would be made available “within a short period of time,” if Russia’s refineries could produce it.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，如果俄罗斯炼油厂能够生产更多柴油，“在短时间内”将提供更多柴油。

paras.en: Yet experts are highly skeptical that there will be any significant resumption of Russian diesel exports in the near term.
paras.zh: 然而，专家们对俄罗斯柴油出口短期内能否大幅恢复持高度怀疑态度。

paras.en: Due to Ukrainian strikes deep inside Russia, refiners that produce oil, gas and diesel have suffered heavy damage.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰对俄罗斯境内的袭击，生产石油、天然气和柴油的炼油厂遭受了严重损失。

paras.en: “Reported gasoline output is down by 20% compared with 2025 levels, while diesel production is estimated to have fallen by nearly 30%, prompting the government to restrict fuel exports to protect domestic supplies,” analysts at the International Energy Agency wrote in a September report.
paras.zh: 国际能源署分析师在 9 月份的一份报告中写道：“与 2025 年水平相比，报告的汽油产量下降了 20%，而柴油产量估计下降了近 30%，促使政府限制燃料出口以保护国内供应。”

paras.en: For weeks, Trump has focused on the price of diesel fuel, which began rising as a result of the Iran war that the U.S. and Israel launched in February.
paras.zh: 几周来，特朗普一直关注柴油价格，由于美国和以色列二月份发动伊朗战争，柴油价格开始上涨。

paras.en: In July, escalations in the Russia-Ukraine war began adding to the pressure on diesel prices.
paras.zh: 7月份，俄罗斯和乌克兰战争的升级开始加大柴油价格的压力。

paras.en: As Ukrainian drones systematically targeted Russian energy assets, the Kremlin responded by restricting diesel exports in order to preserve its supply for domestic use.
paras.zh: 当乌克兰无人机有系统地瞄准俄罗斯能源资产时，克里姆林宫的回应是限制柴油出口，以保留其国内使用的供应。

paras.en: Until then, Russia had been one of the world’s top exporters of refined oil products, which include diesel fuel.
paras.zh: 在此之前，俄罗斯一直是世界上最大的成品油出口国之一，其中包括柴油。

paras.en: Russia said Friday that it would lift some of its export restrictions in order to accommodate the deal with Trump. But it was unclear how fast that would happen.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯周五表示，将取消部分出口限制，以适应与特朗普的协议。但尚不清楚这会发生多快。

articles.title: Rain turns dry paddocks into bumper crops after years of drought
articles.author: Eliza Berlage and Amelia Walters

paras.en: Farmers struggling to keep cashflow coming a year ago are preparing to harvest the best crop in living memory.
paras.zh: 一年前，努力保持现金流的农民正准备收获人们记忆中最好的作物。

paras.en: As long as locusts do not interfere, many say it will be the first time they make a profit in years.
paras.zh: 许多人表示，只要蝗虫不干扰，这将是他们多年来第一次盈利。

paras.en: Grain Producers SA predicts a record-breaking 13 million tonnes of grain will be harvested in 2026.
paras.zh: Grain Producers SA 预计 2026 年粮食产量将达到创纪录的 1300 万吨。

paras.en: This time last year the cropping paddocks at the Fisher's farm were filled with mounds of red sand, as a pregnant Kiara worried about how her family would make ends meet.
paras.zh: 去年的这个时候，费舍尔农场的农作物围场里堆满了红沙堆，怀孕的基拉担心她的家人如何维持生计。

paras.en: Almost 12 months on, the crops are so high her three-year-old daughter Aurora almost disappears when she runs through them.
paras.zh: 近 12 个月过去了，庄稼长得很茂盛，她三岁的女儿奥罗拉 (Aurora) 跑过庄稼时几乎消失了。

paras.en: Above-average rainfall in parts of South Australia has brought relief to families like Ms Fisher's, at Bugle Hut in the Riverland, about 270 kilometres from Adelaide.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚部分地区高于平均水平的降雨量给像费舍尔女士这样的家庭带来了缓解，她住在距离阿德莱德约 270 公里的 Riverland 的 Bugle Hut。

paras.en: Her property has received 330 millimetres of rain this year, well above their average of 250mm.
paras.zh: 她的房产今年降雨量为 330 毫米，远高于平均水平 250 毫米。

paras.en: "Where we sit now, this was entirely dirt and this year my husband's had to slash it three times already," she said.
paras.zh: “我们现在坐的地方，这完全是泥土，今年我丈夫已经不得不把它砍了三刀，”她说。

paras.en: "There were crops out there last year, but they'd be lucky to be grazing the tops of your ankles … [but] this year my three-year-old daughter … you can barely see her in them."
paras.zh: “去年那里有庄稼，但如果它们能擦过你的脚踝就很幸运了……[但是]今年我三岁的女儿……你几乎看不到她穿着它们。”

paras.en: Ms Fisher was optimistic reaping this year's wheat and barley crop will allow them to rebuild.
paras.zh: 费舍尔女士乐观地表示，今年小麦和大麦的收成将使他们能够重建家园。

paras.en: Off-farm work and the federal government's family household allowance have helped them stay afloat amid four years of drought.
paras.zh: 非农工作和联邦政府的家庭补贴帮助他们在四年的干旱中维持生计。

paras.en: "It'll be really nice just to wipe our slates clean and know that for the first time in a few years we've farmed for something," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“如果能把我们的记录擦干净，并知道几年来我们第一次为某种东西而耕种，那就太好了。”

paras.en: Down the road at her farm at Maggea, Louise Smith has received 350mm so far this year, more than double last year's total of 115mm.
paras.zh: 在马吉亚 (Maggea) 农场的路上，Louise Smith 今年迄今已收到 350 毫米的收割量，是去年总收割量 115 毫米的两倍多。

paras.en: "We were like kids in a lolly factory, just running around playing in the mud like wow we are three-year-olds,"
paras.zh: “我们就像棒棒糖工厂里的孩子，在泥巴里跑来跑去玩，就像哇我们三岁的孩子一样，”

paras.en: She hoped to turn a profit for the first time in about seven years, having sown her paddocks with rye, barley, wheat and oats.
paras.zh: 她希望在围场上种植黑麦、大麦、小麦和燕麦，从而实现大约七年来的首次盈利。

paras.en: "You drive into town, there's actually people, they stop and chat. There's happy smiles and it's not everyone thinking, 'Where do we go next?'" she said.
paras.zh: “你开车进城，实际上有人，他们停下来聊天。那里有幸福的微笑，并不是每个人都在想，‘我们下一步去哪里？’”她说。

paras.en: "You talk to your neighbours, everyone's just happy. It's a good feeling."
paras.zh: “你和邻居交谈，每个人都很高兴。这种感觉很好。”

paras.en: The improved conditions have also seen her sheep and cattle, which were hand-fed during the drought, grow fat.
paras.zh: 条件的改善也让她在干旱期间手工喂养的羊和牛都长胖了。

paras.en: Many of Louise Smith's sheep did not survive last year's harsh drought conditions. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 路易丝·史密斯（Louise Smith）的许多羊未能在去年的严酷干旱条件下生存。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: Holding onto starving stock was a difficult decision, but one that has paid off, with other farmers who destocked now unable to afford to buy.
paras.zh: 保留饥饿的库存是一个艰难的决定，但这个决定已经得到了回报，因为其他减少库存的农民现在买不起。

paras.en: "I think looking back now, 12 months on, we made all the right decisions we could have made back then to get us to the best position we could to get into this season," she said.
paras.zh: “我认为现在回想起来，12 个月过去了，我们做出了当时可以做出的所有正确决定，让我们达到了进入本赛季的最佳位置，”她说。

paras.en: Louise Smith has not had to hand-feed her Charolais cattle this year. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 路易丝·史密斯今年不必手工喂养她的夏洛莱牛。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: "We've got control over our own operation again. It's a very good feeling."
paras.zh: “我们再次掌控了自己的运营。这种感觉非常好。”

paras.en: Headers have begun rolling across paddocks in the west of the state, but most farmers are still gearing up to bring in a bumper crop.
paras.zh: 该州西部的围场上已经开始收割，但大多数农民仍在为丰收做好准备。

paras.en: Grain Producers South Australia chief executive Brad Perry said the 2026/27 harvest was expected to break records.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚谷物生产商首席执行官 Brad Perry 表示，2026/27 年收成预计将打破纪录。

paras.en: Brad Perry says this year will be record-breaking as long as harvest goes to plan. (ABC News: Marco Catalano)
paras.zh: 布拉德·佩里表示，只要收成按计划进行，今年的收成将打破纪录。 （美国广播公司新闻：马可·卡塔拉诺）

paras.en: "An average tonnage for harvest in South Australia in the grain sector is about 9 million tonnes," he said.
paras.zh: “南澳大利亚粮食部门的平均收获吨数约为 900 万吨，”他说。

paras.en: "We're looking at eclipsing that from all reports to about 13 million tonnes."
paras.zh: “我们正在考虑将所有报告中的数字增至约 1300 万吨。”

paras.en: There were some difficulties for growers, with frost events and disease pressure also affecting crops in some regions.
paras.zh: 种植者面临一些困难，霜冻事件和疾病压力也影响了一些地区的作物。

paras.en: Louise Smith and Kiara Fisher say they will likely begin harvesting towards the end of November. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: Louise Smith 和 Kiara Fisher 表示，他们可能会在 11 月底开始收获。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

paras.en: The logistics of harvesting a bumper crop will also prove a challenge.
paras.zh: 丰收的后勤工作也将是一个挑战。

paras.en: Back at Bugle Hut, Ms Fisher said while the drought had broken, farmers were not quite out of the woods yet.
paras.zh: 回到号角小屋，费舍尔女士表示，虽然干旱已经结束，但农民还没有完全摆脱困境。

paras.en: The looming challenges were numerous from low grain prices to locusts threatening crops and skyrocketing input costs, with diesel prices adding an extra $200,000 hit to their budget.
paras.zh: 迫在眉睫的挑战有很多，从谷物价格低廉到蝗虫威胁农作物，再到投入成本飙升，柴油价格使他们的预算额外增加了 20 万美元。

paras.en: "We're going to have to sell most of our saleable grain that we're not holding onto to for feed just to pay the bills from the last three years," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们将不得不出售大部分可销售的谷物，而这些谷物不是我们用来做饲料的，只是为了支付过去三年的账单。”

paras.en: "When the universe provides in the ways that it has this year, as far as weather goes, then it's certainly hit you in other areas."
paras.zh: “当宇宙以今年的方式提供时，就天气而言，它肯定会对其他领域产生影响。”

paras.en: Locust nymphs have already been spotted across the Riverland and Mallee ahead of harvest, spiking concern among farmers. (ABC Riverland: Amelia Walters)
paras.zh: 在收获之前，河地和马利地区已经发现了蝗虫若虫，这引起了农民的担忧。 （ABC Riverland：阿米莉亚·沃尔特斯）

articles.title: Breaking: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte dies age 34

paras.en: Breaking Bad star RJ Mitte has died aged 34, international media outlets are reporting.
paras.zh: 据国际媒体报道，《绝命毒师》明星 RJ Mitte 去世，享年 34 岁。

paras.en: Mitte was best known for his role as the son of drug kingpin Walter White in the hit television series.
paras.zh: 米特因在热门电视剧中饰演毒枭沃尔特·怀特的儿子而闻名。

paras.en: "It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte," his representative said in a statement reported by the BBC, Variety and Deadline.
paras.zh: 他的代表在 BBC、Variety 和 Deadline 报道的一份声明中表示：“我们怀着深切的悲痛，分享深受喜爱的演员、慈善家和热情的残疾人权利倡导者 RJ Mitte 的悲惨去世。”

articles.title: Live: Oil prices on the rise as energy supply concerns continue
articles.author: Stephanie Chalmers and Alex Turner-Cohen

paras.en: Markets live updates: Oil prices climb, ASX poised to open higher after mixed lead
paras.zh: 市场实时更新：油价攀升，澳大利亚证券交易所在涨跌互现后准备高开

paras.en: Oil prices continue to climb, with Brent crude approaching $US107 overnight.
paras.zh: 油价继续攀升，布伦特原油隔夜逼近 107 美元。

paras.en: The ASX looks set for another positive start to the session, following a mixed finish on Wall Street.
paras.zh: 继华尔街股市涨跌互现之后，澳大利亚证券交易所看起来将迎来另一个积极的开局。

paras.en: Follow the day's financial news and insights from our specialist business reporters on our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客上关注我们的专业商业记者当天的财经新闻和见解。

paras.en: Disclaimer: this blog is not intended as investment advice.
paras.zh: 免责声明：本博客无意作为投资建议。

paras.en: Choose what information you see below by using filters
paras.zh: 使用过滤器选择您在下面看到的信息

paras.en: Oil rallies, sending dollar higher on expectations of higher US rates
paras.zh: 油价上涨，因美国加息预期推高美元

paras.en: Oil prices climbed overnight as attacks on Saudi Arabia overshadowed hopes for supply improvements, and expectations for higher US interest rates to fight inflation drove the dollar higher on a narrowly mixed day for global stocks.
paras.zh: 由于对沙特阿拉伯的袭击掩盖了供应改善的希望，以及美国加息以对抗通胀的预期推动美元走高，全球股市涨跌互现，油价隔夜攀升。

paras.en: The action came after US President Donald Trump hailed fresh Russian diesel exports and a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire.
paras.zh: 此前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对俄罗斯新的柴油出口和俄罗斯与乌克兰能源停火表示欢迎。

paras.en: The greenback's rise in recent months has been driven in large part by expectations that high prices for energy and other goods will force the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at a time when US growth is stronger than in other rich economies. This could expand the rate differentials that drive currency movements.
paras.zh: 美元近几个月的上涨在很大程度上是由于预期能源和其他商品的高价格将迫使美联储在美国经济增长强于其他富裕经济体之际加息。这可能会扩大推动货币波动的利差。

paras.en: While the US bond market was closed for the Columbus Day holiday, investors were cautiously waiting for September inflation data and the third-quarter earnings season, which begins tomorrow with earnings from major US banks.
paras.zh: 虽然美国债券市场因哥伦布日假期休市，但投资者仍在谨慎等待 9 月份通胀数据和第三季度财报季，该季财报季将于明天开始，美国主要银行将公布财报。

paras.en: "There's a lot to be wary of," said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth Management.
paras.zh: 达科他财富管理公司高级投资组合经理罗伯特·帕夫利克表示：“有很多事情需要警惕。”

paras.en: "You're walking down a train line and you don't know, because it's dark, if a train is coming and so, you know, you're just being real careful right today."
paras.zh: “你沿着火车线路行走，你不知道，因为天黑了，火车是否会来，所以，你知道，你今天要非常小心。”

paras.en: Besides the wait for earnings and economic data, Pavlik noted that stocks were also "being kept in check because of higher oil" and a lack of direction from the bond market, which tends to influence stocks and other assets.
paras.zh: 帕夫利克指出，除了等待盈利和经济数据外，股市也“由于油价上涨而受到抑制”，而且债券市场缺乏方向，这往往会影响股票和其他资产。

paras.en: US Treasury yields hit 24-year highs this month as high energy costs fueled concerns that inflation could stay elevated, keeping policymakers hawkish and pressuring equity valuations.
paras.zh: 由于高能源成本引发了人们对通胀可能保持高位的担忧，美国国债收益率本月触及24年来的新高，使政策制定者保持鹰派态度，并对股市估值构成压力。

paras.en: In currencies, the US dollar held near an 18-month high, supported by safe-haven demand as an escalating Middle East conflict kept investors cautious ahead of the inflation data.
paras.zh: 货币方面，由于中东冲突不断升级，投资者在通胀数据公布前保持谨慎，因此受到避险需求的支撑，美元维持在 18 个月高点附近。

paras.en: Markets imply only a 19% chance of a rate increase from the Federal Reserve this month, rising to a roughly 71% chance for a hike of 25 basis points in December, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool.
paras.zh: 根据 CME 集团的 FedWatch 工具，市场暗示美联储本月加息的可能性只有 19%，而 12 月份加息 25 个基点的可能性升至约 71%。

paras.en: Investors are also betting on hikes in the EU, Japan and Britain before the end of the year.
paras.zh: 投资者还押注欧盟、日本和英国将在年底前加息。

paras.en: Welcome to our live coverage of all things business this morning.
paras.zh: 欢迎收看我们今天早上对所有业务的现场报道。

paras.en: Business reporter Alex Turner-Cohen here to take you through all the days highs and lows.
paras.zh: 商业记者亚历克斯·特纳-科恩在这里带您经历所有这些日子的高点和低点。

paras.en: To start, the ASX is set to open higher, off the back of Wall St finishing with mixed results but overall remaining steady and hovering near its all-time high.
paras.zh: 首先，澳大利亚证券交易所将开盘走高，华尔街收盘结果好坏参半，但总体保持稳定，徘徊在历史高点附近。

paras.en: Meanwhile, escalating conflict in the Middle East has bumped up Australia's petrol prices to levels not seen for six months, surging past $2.40 a litre.
paras.zh: 与此同时，中东冲突不断升级，澳大利亚汽油价格升至六个月以来最高水平，飙升至每升 2.40 美元以上。

paras.en: Grab a coffee and stay tuned for the day's updates.
paras.zh: 喝杯咖啡并关注当天的更新。

articles.title: Rescue helicopters race to flood-hit Nepal villages as 5 reported missing

paras.en: Rescue helicopters race to flood-hit Nepal villages as 5 reported missing
paras.zh: 救援直升机火速前往尼泊尔遭受洪水袭击的村庄，据报道有 5 人失踪

paras.en: 95 people, including 9 foreigners, have been taken to nearby towns
paras.zh: 包括9名外国人在内的95人已被带到附近城镇

paras.en: Rescuers from Nepal's military on Monday reached an area hit by a flash flood the previous day.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔军方的救援人员周一抵达前一天遭受山洪袭击的地区。

paras.en: Rescue helicopters and soldiers brought food and other relief materials to the area along the Budhi Gandaki river in north central Nepal and began evacuating residents and tourists from the area.
paras.zh: 救援直升机和士兵将食物和其他救援物资运送到尼泊尔中北部布迪甘达基河沿岸地区，并开始疏散该地区的居民和游客。

paras.en: Five people have been reported missing and no fatalities have been reported so far. The government said that an early warning allowed most people to reach higher ground before the flood hit.
paras.zh: 据报道有五人失踪，目前尚未有人员死亡的报道。政府表示，预警让大多数人在洪水袭来之前到达地势较高的地方。

paras.en: Sunday's flood was caused by a landslide that initially blocked the river near the village of Chumchure. It damaged or destroyed five bridges, the construction sites of three hydropower plants, and dozens of houses and farms.
paras.zh: 周日的洪水是由山体滑坡引起的，山体滑坡最初堵塞了 Chumchure 村附近的河流。它损坏或摧毁了五座桥梁、三个水电站的建筑工地以及数十座房屋和农场。

paras.en: - Villages evacuated as flash flood from Budhi Gandaki river hits northern Nepal
paras.zh: -布迪甘达基河山洪袭击尼泊尔北部，村庄被疏散

paras.en: - B.C. family still looking for answers 1 month after deadly Nepal flood
paras.zh: - BC尼泊尔致命洪水发生一个月后，家人仍在寻找答案

paras.en: Nepal's National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said that so far 95 people, including nine foreigners, have been taken to nearby towns.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔国家减灾和管理局表示，到目前为止，已有95人被送往附近城镇，其中包括9名外国人。

paras.en: The flood area has trekking routes popular with hikers, and October is one of the most busiest times for visitors.
paras.zh: 洪泛区拥有深受徒步旅行者欢迎的徒步路线，十月是游客最繁忙的时期之一。

paras.en: Trucks were taking food, tents, medicine and other supplies to areas that are reachable by road, while army helicopters were taking supplies to remote mountain villages.
paras.zh: 卡车正在将食物、帐篷、药品和其他物资运送到可通过公路到达的地区，而军用直升机则将物资运送到偏远的山村。

paras.en: The Budhi Gandaki River merges into the Trishuli River and is a key waterway near the capital Kathmandu.
paras.zh: 布迪甘达基河汇入特里苏里河，是首都加德满都附近的一条重要水道。

paras.en: Videos on social media show houses and sheds being swept away by the swollen river flowing between tall mountains. It was not immediately clear how many of the mountainous area's small villages were impacted.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上的视频显示，房屋和棚屋被流经高山之间的汹涌河流冲走。目前尚不清楚山区有多少小村庄受到影响。

paras.en: A Nepal Army helicopter rescues people from areas affected by flooding of Budhi Gandaki River. Five people have been reported missing. (Nepal Army/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 一架尼泊尔陆军直升机从受布迪甘达基河洪水影响的地区救援人员。据报道有五人失踪。 （尼泊尔陆军/美联社）

paras.en: Nepal is still recovering from a devastating flood that swept through the mountainous Nepal-China border in August, leaving more than 1,400 people dead and thousands more missing.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔仍在从 8 月份席卷尼泊尔与中国边境山区的毁灭性洪水中恢复，这场洪水造成 1,400 多人死亡，数千人失踪。

paras.en: The office of Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah announced an end to search and rescue operations on Oct. 5 as recovery efforts shift to focus on repairing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿办公室于 10 月 5 日宣布结束搜救行动，恢复工作重点转向修复基础设施。

articles.title: Zelenskyy says Russia violating Trump's 'energy ceasefire' as attacks on Ukraine continue

paras.en: Zelenskyy says Russia violating Trump's 'energy ceasefire' as attacks on Ukraine continue
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称俄罗斯违反了特朗普的“能源停火”协议，乌克兰袭击仍在继续

paras.en: Zelenskyy says 'ceasefire' can help end war 'if Americans truly step in now'
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，“如果美国人现在真正介入”，“停火”有助于结束战争

paras.en: Russia has violated an energy ceasefire announced by U.S. President Donald Trump, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Monday, urging Washington to step in to ensure that Moscow abided by the terms of the putative agreement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基周一表示，俄罗斯违反了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普宣布的能源停火协议，敦促华盛顿介入，以确保莫斯科遵守假定协议的条款。

paras.en: "There were Russian violations of the energy ceasefire announced by President Trump," Zelenskyy told a security conference in Warsaw via video link.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基通过视频连线在华沙举行的安全会议上表示：“俄罗斯违反了特朗普总统宣布的能源停火协议。”

paras.en: "We are waiting for the details of the conditions between the Americans and Russians, and we are waiting to see one specific step the Americans are ready to take," added Zelenskyy, who said he had learned about the ceasefire deal from the media.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基补充道：“我们正在等待美国和俄罗斯之间的具体情况，我们正在等待美国准备采取的具体步骤。”他说，他是从媒体了解到停火协议的。

paras.en: "This energy ceasefire, it can work, and it can become a major step toward ending the war if the Americans truly step in now and make sure Russians respect it."
paras.zh: “这种能源停火是可行的，如果美国人现在真正介入并确保俄罗斯人尊重它，它可以成为结束战争的重要一步。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy later said in a social media post that Russia had attacked six energy facilities across Ukraine on Monday, wounding 33 people.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基后来在社交媒体帖子中表示，俄罗斯周一袭击了乌克兰各地的六处能源设施，造成 33 人受伤。

paras.en: An earlier statement from the Regional Prosecutor's Office of Kharkiv in northeastern Ukraine said Russian forces had attacked an energy facility on the outskirts of the city.
paras.zh: 乌克兰东北部哈尔科夫地区检察官办公室早些时候发表声明称，俄罗斯军队袭击了该市郊区的一处能源设施。

paras.en: - Trump announces Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire,' which Zelenskyy says he hasn't seen but supports
paras.zh: - 特朗普宣布俄罗斯与乌克兰“能源停火”，泽伦斯基表示他还没有看到，但支持

paras.en: - Video Trump claims Ukraine, Russia have agreed to an 'energy ceasefire'
paras.zh: - 视频特朗普声称乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意“能源停火”

paras.en: That came after Zelenskyy said Sunday that while he "welcomed" Trump's announcement, Russia was still hitting energy infrastructure in the capital Kyiv and in Kharkiv.
paras.zh: 此前，泽连斯基周日表示，虽然他“欢迎”特朗普的声明，但俄罗斯仍在打击首都基辅和哈尔科夫的能源基础设施。

paras.en: Trump's brief social media post on Sunday announcing the purported agreement to mutually cease attacks on energy sites said only that the ceasefire took effect immediately, adding: "Do not break it!"
paras.zh: 特朗普周日在社交媒体上发布了简短的帖子，宣布了所谓的相互停止对能源站点袭击的协议，但只表示停火立即生效，并补充道：“不要打破它！”

paras.en: Trump had also claimed in a social media post on Sept. 14 that both countries had agreed "not to hit" each other's energy infrastructure, but offered no details on that proposal either and nothing came of the purported agreement.
paras.zh: 特朗普还在9月14日的社交媒体帖子中声称，两国已同意“不打击”彼此的能源基础设施，但也没有提供该提议的细节，而且所谓的协议也没有任何结果。

paras.en: Russia has used attacks on energy facilities in order to deny Ukrainian civilians power, heat and running water during the war, hoping to wear down public resistance to Moscow's full-scale invasion. Ukrainian officials describe the strategy as "weaponizing winter."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯在战争期间利用对能源设施的袭击来切断乌克兰平民的电力、供暖和自来水，希望削弱公众对莫斯科全面入侵的抵抗。乌克兰官员将该战略描述为“将冬季武器化”。

paras.en: Ukraine, meanwhile, has levelled strikes against Russian energy sites like oil refineries, sometimes deep within Russian territory. That's prompted Trump to blame Zelenskyy for high diesel prices in the U.S. only weeks before the country's midterm elections.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰对炼油厂等俄罗斯能源设施发动了袭击，有时甚至深入俄罗斯境内。这促使特朗普在美国中期选举前几周将美国柴油价格居高不下归咎于泽伦斯基。

paras.en: The Kremlin said on Monday that contacts were ongoing about the possible energy ceasefire.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周一表示，正在就可能的能源停火进行接触。

paras.en: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov declined to comment on whether the ceasefire would apply only to oil refineries and said further information would be revealed in due course.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫拒绝就停火是否仅适用于炼油厂发表评论，并表示将在适当时候透露更多信息。

paras.en: Peskov also rejected a 60-day ceasefire idea proposed by Zelenskyy on Sunday to allow Ukraine to hold presidential elections, saying Russia wanted an overall peace deal instead.
paras.zh: 佩斯科夫还拒绝了泽连斯基周日提出的允许乌克兰举行总统选举的 60 天停火想法，称俄罗斯希望达成全面和平协议。

paras.en: "In the Kremlin, both President Putin and officials at other levels have repeatedly stated that we do not want a ceasefire," the spokesman said. "We want long-term peace and are prepared to do everything possible to achieve it."
paras.zh: 这位发言人说：“在克里姆林宫，普京总统和其他级别的官员都多次表示，我们不希望停火。” “我们希望实现长期和平，并准备尽一切努力实现这一目标。”

paras.en: A firefighter puts out a fire following a Russian air attack at a residential building in Kharkiv on Monday. (Andrii Marienko/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周一，一名消防员在俄罗斯空袭哈尔科夫一栋住宅楼后扑灭火灾。 （安德里·马连科/美联社）

paras.en: The European Union's top diplomat on Monday welcomed the prospect of a pause in energy strikes in Ukraine, particularly as winter approaches, but said she sees no sign that Russia would be willing to respect it.
paras.zh: 欧盟最高外交官周一对乌克兰暂停能源罢工的前景表示欢迎，特别是在冬季临近之际，但她表示，没有迹象表明俄罗斯愿意尊重这一决定。

paras.en: "We haven't yet seen that also Russia will stick to it," EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said at a meeting of the bloc's foreign ministers in Luxembourg. "Personally, I would also welcome that the ceasefire would include people not being killed, not only energy."
paras.zh: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡亚·卡拉斯在卢森堡举行的欧盟外长会议上表示：“我们还没有看到俄罗斯也会坚持下去。” “就我个人而言，我也欢迎停火不仅包括能源，还包括人员不被杀害。”

paras.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney spoke with Trump on Sunday and that he told the U.S. president that Ottawa has "strong support" for the energy ceasefire, the Prime Minister's Office said in a statement on Sunday.
paras.zh: 加拿大总理办公室在周日的一份声明中表示，加拿大总理马克·卡尼周日与特朗普进行了交谈，他告诉美国总统，渥太华“强烈支持”能源停火。

paras.en: Kallas also emphasized the need for European countries to continue supporting Ukraine's efforts to defend against Moscow's full-scale invasion, even as Trump struck a deal on Friday with Russian President Vladimir Putin for the U.S. to purchase diesel from Moscow in an attempt to address high fuel prices ahead of U.S. midterm elections.
paras.zh: 卡拉斯还强调，欧洲国家需要继续支持乌克兰抵御莫斯科全面入侵的努力，尽管特朗普周五与俄罗斯总统普京达成协议，要求美国从莫斯科购买柴油，试图在美国中期选举前解决高油价问题。

paras.en: Ukrainian and European officials reacted to the diesel deal with dismay, saying it will help pay for Russia's war effort. On Monday, several EU foreign ministers said the diesel deal is unlikely to bring energy prices down, and appears aimed at helping Republicans win the midterms.
paras.zh: 乌克兰和欧洲官员对柴油交易感到沮丧，称这将有助于支付俄罗斯的战争费用。周一，几位欧盟外长表示，柴油协议不太可能降低能源价格，而且似乎旨在帮助共和党赢得中期选举。

paras.en: In a readout from the PMO on Sunday, Carney also told Zelenskyy that Canada believes the Trump-proposed diesel deal with Russia is "in direct opposition" to the goal of supporting Ukraine and that such a move would enrich the Kremlin and help finance its war effort.
paras.zh: 在周日发布的总理办公室的一份声明中，卡尼还告诉泽连斯基，加拿大认为特朗普提议的与俄罗斯的柴油协议“直接反对”支持乌克兰的目标，而此举将让克里姆林宫变得更富有，并有助于为其战争提供资金。

paras.en: Meanwhile, two people were injured in Russian daytime strikes on Kyiv on Monday, according to the city's military administration, while falling debris from Russian attacks sparked a fire in a private residential building in the capital's Darnytskyi district.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据基辅市军事管理部门称，周一俄罗斯白天对基辅发动的袭击造成两人受伤，俄罗斯袭击造成的碎片掉落，引发首都达尔尼茨基区一栋私人住宅楼起火。

paras.en: Debris also fell in an open area near private residential buildings in the Solomianskyi district, and on a warehouse building in the Darnytskyi district, with emergency services dispatched to the scene.
paras.zh: 索洛米安斯基区私人住宅楼附近的空地和达尔尼茨基区的一座仓库大楼也有碎片掉落，紧急服务人员已派往现场。

paras.en: A Russian drone attack on the village of Pisochyn in the Kharkiv district on Sunday evening killed three people and injured nine others, including children, according to the Kharkiv Regional Prosecutor's Office.
paras.zh: 据哈尔科夫地区检察官办公室称，周日晚上，俄罗斯无人机袭击了哈尔科夫地区皮索钦村，造成三人死亡，九人受伤，其中包括儿童。

paras.en: Investigators said the attack occurred at approximately 7:25 p.m. local time, striking a densely populated area near apartment buildings and grocery stores and sparking a fire.
paras.zh: 调查人员称，袭击发生在晚上 7 点 25 分左右。当地时间，袭击了公寓楼和杂货店附近的人口稠密地区并引发火灾。

paras.en: Ukrainian air defence forces shot down or suppressed 89 of 121 Russian drones overnight Monday, Ukraine's air force said in a Telegram post. The attack involved one Kh-59 guided air-to-surface missile and 121 drones, including 76 jet-powered Shahed-type drones, the statement said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军在 Telegram 帖子中称，乌克兰防空部队周一夜间击落或压制了 121 架俄罗斯无人机中的 89 架。声明称，此次袭击涉及一枚 Kh-59 制导空对地导弹和 121 架无人机，其中包括 76 架喷气式 Shahed 型无人机。

paras.en: Strikes were recorded at 15 locations in Ukraine, while debris from downed drones fell at four locations.
paras.zh: 乌克兰有 15 个地点发生了袭击，四个地点被击落的无人机碎片掉落。

paras.en: Russia also attacked gas production facilities of Ukraine's state oil and gas company Naftogaz in the Kharkiv region overnight, causing a fire, the company said on Monday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家石油天然气公司Naftogaz周一表示，俄罗斯连夜袭击了位于哈尔科夫地区的天然气生产设施，引发火灾。

paras.en: "The attack damaged critical equipment. Our employees are doing everything possible to repair the damage as quickly as possible and prevent risks to the stable operation of the energy system," Naftogaz acting CEO Sergii Fedorenko said on Telegram.
paras.zh: Naftogaz代理首席执行官Sergii Fedorenko在Telegram上表示：“这次袭击损坏了关键设备。我们的员工正在尽一切努力尽快修复损坏，并防止能源系统稳定运行面临风险。”

paras.en: The Russian Defence Ministry on Monday said its air defences overnight intercepted 151 Ukrainian drones over Russian regions as well as the illegally annexed Crimea and the waters of the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周一表示，其防空系统夜间在俄罗斯地区以及非法吞并的克里米亚和黑海水域拦截了 151 架乌克兰无人机。

paras.en: In a separate statement, the ministry said its forces overnight carried out drone strikes on Ukraine's unspecified port infrastructure and a bulk carrier heading to Ukraine's port city of Odesa with military cargo on board.
paras.zh: 该部在另一份声明中表示，其部队连夜对乌克兰未具体说明的港口基础设施和一艘载有军用货物前往乌克兰港口城市敖德萨的散货船进行了无人机袭击。

articles.title: Nobel memorial prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford

paras.en: Nobel memorial prize in economics awarded to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford
paras.zh: 诺贝尔经济学纪念奖授予罗伯特·E·霍尔和迈克尔·伍德福德

paras.en: Economists' work has helped manage economic shocks, Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences says
paras.zh: 瑞典皇家科学院表示，经济学家的工作有助于应对经济冲击

paras.en: American-born economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel memorial prize in economics on Monday for their work on models that have helped governments and central banks manage economic shocks.
paras.zh: 美国出生的经济学家罗伯特·E·霍尔（Robert E. Hall）和迈克尔·伍德福德（Michael Woodford）周一因其在帮助政府和央行应对经济冲击的模型方面的工作而获得诺贝尔经济学奖。

paras.en: The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the winners in Stockholm, saying the two were being honoured for work that has helped policymakers deal with economic fluctuations.
paras.zh: 瑞典皇家科学院在斯德哥尔摩宣布了获奖者，称两人因帮助决策者应对经济波动的工作而受到表彰。

paras.en: "The laureates have helped us smooth out the economy's peaks and troughs," the academy said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该学院在一份声明中表示：“获奖者帮助我们度过了经济的高峰和低谷。”

paras.en: Hall is affiliated with Stanford University in California and Woodford with Columbia University in New York.
paras.zh: 霍尔隶属于加利福尼亚州斯坦福大学，伍德福德隶属于纽约哥伦比亚大学。

paras.en: Woodford spoke to the committee by phone Monday from New York, saying: "It's a tremendous honour, it's a surprise."
paras.zh: 伍德福德周一在纽约通过电话向委员会表示：“这是一项巨大的荣誉，也是一个惊喜。”

paras.en: The Nobel memorial prize in economics is announced in Stockholm on Monday. Hall and Woodford won the prize in for their work on models that have helped governments and central banks manage economic shocks. (Anders Wiklund/TT News Agency/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 诺贝尔经济学纪念奖周一在斯德哥尔摩揭晓。霍尔和伍德福德因其在帮助政府和央行应对经济冲击的模型方面的工作而获奖。 （安德斯·维克伦德/TT 通讯社/美联社）

paras.en: "The laureates' work has provided us with a stable theoretical foundation for the models that are now used by central banks and governments around the world," John Hassler, chair of the Committee for the Prize in Economic Sciences, said in a news release.
paras.zh: 经济科学奖委员会主席约翰·哈斯勒在一份新闻稿中表示：“获奖者的工作为我们为世界各地中央银行和政府目前使用的模型提供了稳定的理论基础。”

paras.en: "With them, we are better equipped to deal with shocks in the economy, such as energy crises or sudden changes in how much households consume."
paras.zh: “有了它们，我们就能更好地应对经济冲击，例如能源危机或家庭消费量的突然变化。”

paras.en: 'New foundation for stabilization policy'
paras.zh: “稳定政策的新基础”

paras.en: For decades, governments responded to economic shocks by following the Depression-era prescriptions of the British economist John Maynard Keynes: intervene in the economy by lowering taxes and hiking government spending, thereby encouraging consumers and businesses to spend and invest themselves and help growth get restarted.
paras.zh: 几十年来，各国政府应对经济冲击的方式都是遵循英国经济学家约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯在大萧条时期的处方：通过降低税收和增加政府支出来干预经济，从而鼓励消费者和企业自行消费和投资，帮助经济重启。

paras.en: "This is the Keynesian recipe and it worked well — until it didn't," said Timo Boppart of the Nobel economics prize committee.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖委员会的蒂莫·博帕特 (Timo Boppart) 表示：“这是凯恩斯主义的秘诀，而且效果很好，直到行不通为止。”

paras.en: - He won the Nobel Prize for his work understanding the brain — and his kids flipped out
paras.zh: - 他因其对大脑的研究而获得诺贝尔奖 - 他的孩子们都兴奋不已

paras.en: - Audio Anne Carson just won the Nobel Prize for Literature. We learn more about her literary legacy
paras.zh: - 音频 安妮·卡森刚刚获得诺贝尔文学奖。我们更多地了解她的文学遗产

paras.en: Policymakers had thought economic management involved simple tradeoffs — unemployment, for instance, would stay low at a time of high inflation and rise when inflation fell.
paras.zh: 政策制定者曾认为经济管理涉及简单的权衡——例如，失业率在高通胀时保持在低水平，而在通胀下降时上升。

paras.en: But the "stagflation" of the 1970s — when the world economy experienced simultaneous high inflation and high unemployment — proved the formula was simplistic.
paras.zh: 但 20 世纪 70 年代的“滞胀”——当时世界经济同时经历了高通胀和高失业率——证明这个公式过于简单化。

paras.en: Hall and Woodford set about coming up with an improved model that took into account how consumers and businesses actually made decisions about whether to invest and spend.
paras.zh: 霍尔和伍德福德着手提出一种改进的模型，该模型考虑了消费者和企业实际上如何做出是否投资和支出的决定。

paras.en: "In separate contributions, Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford helped build this new foundation for stabilization policy," Hassler said.
paras.zh: 哈斯勒说：“罗伯特·E·霍尔和迈克尔·伍德福德分别做出了贡献，帮助建立了稳定政策的新基础。”

paras.en: Last year, three researchers who study business innovation — including Canadian economist Peter Howitt — won for explaining how new products and inventions promote economic growth and human welfare, even as they leave older companies in the dust.
paras.zh: 去年，三名研究商业创新的研究人员——包括加拿大经济学家彼得·霍伊特——因解释新产品和发明如何促进经济增长和人类福祉而获奖，尽管它们让老公司望尘莫及。

paras.en: The economics prize is formally known as the Bank of Sweden Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel.
paras.zh: 该经济学奖的正式名称为纪念阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔的瑞典银行经济科学奖。

paras.en: The central bank established it in 1968 as a memorial to Nobel, the 19th-century Swedish businessman and chemist who invented dynamite and established the five Nobel Prizes.
paras.zh: 中央银行于 1968 年建立了它，以纪念诺贝尔，这位 19 世纪的瑞典商人和化学家发明了炸药并设立了五项诺贝尔奖。

paras.en: Nobel purists stress that the economics prize is technically not a Nobel Prize, but it is always presented together with the others on Dec. 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death in 1896.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔纯粹主义者强调，从技术上讲，经济学奖并不是诺贝尔奖，但它总是在12月10日，即1896年诺贝尔逝世周年纪念日与其他奖项一起颁发。

paras.en: Nobel honours were announced last week in medicine, physics, chemistry, literature and peace.
paras.zh: 上周公布了诺贝尔医学奖、物理学奖、化学奖、文学奖和和平奖。

paras.en: The prize money this year is 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.7 million Cdn), whether for an individual, small group of laureates or organization.
paras.zh: 今年的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 170 万加元），无论是个人、获奖者小组还是组织。

articles.title: Fact check: Viral videos falsely linked to Riyadh airport attacks

paras.en: Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a series of attacks on Saudi Arabia's King Khalid International Airport in recent days. At least 16 people have been killed since last Thursday, according to Saudi authorities.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装声称对最近几天针对沙特阿拉伯哈立德国王国际机场的一系列袭击负责。据沙特当局称，自上周四以来，至少有 16 人死亡。

paras.en: As news of the attacks spreads, social media users have been sharing videos that they claim show the strikes. While some authentic footage of the attacks and their aftermath has circulated online, DW Fact check found that several viral videos are not genuine and show signs of being AI-generated.
paras.zh: 随着袭击消息的传播，社交媒体用户一直在分享他们声称展示袭击事件的视频。虽然一些有关袭击及其后果的真实镜头在网上流传，但德国之声事实调查发现，一些病毒视频并不真实，并且有人工智能生成的迹象。

paras.en: Claim: This post with 1.7 million views on X, claims it shows the moment of an attack on the airport.
paras.zh: 声明：这篇帖子在 X 上有 170 万次浏览，声称它展示了机场遭受袭击的瞬间。

paras.en: The video has been online since March 2026 and could not show the most recent attacks on the airport.
paras.zh: 该视频自 2026 年 3 月以来一直在线，无法显示最近对机场的袭击事件。

paras.en: Hectic camera movements and blurry footage help conceal glitches that often point to AI-generated content. However, our frame-by-frame analysis identified several inconsistencies. That suggests the video was AI-generated.
paras.zh: 频繁的摄像机移动和模糊的镜头有助于隐藏通常指向人工智能生成内容的故障。然而，我们的逐帧分析发现了一些不一致之处。这表明该视频是人工智能生成的。

paras.en: In the video, people run toward an exit as an explosion occurs outside. Despite the apparent danger, they continue moving toward the blast, seemingly through a glass door. This reaction is implausible.
paras.zh: 视频中，当外面发生爆炸时，人们跑向出口。尽管存在明显的危险，他们仍然继续向爆炸处移动，似乎是穿过玻璃门。这种反应令人难以置信。

paras.en: Around 10 seconds into the video, an image of a hand holding a smartphone appears on the side of a man's head.
paras.zh: 视频大约 10 秒后，一名男子的头侧出现了一只手拿着智能手机的图像。

paras.en: At 12 seconds, one man first appears not to have a hand, then miraculously has one.
paras.zh: 第 12 秒时，一个人首先看起来没有手，然后奇迹般地有了一只手。

paras.en: Meta's AI identification tool finds AI signatures in the video and concludes it was created using generative AI.
paras.zh: Meta 的人工智能识别工具可以在视频中找到人工智能签名，并得出结论，该视频是使用生成式人工智能创建的。

paras.en: Many shared the video as authentic, including the Times of Israel– its post had more than 256,000 views at the time of writing.
paras.zh: 许多人都认为该视频是真实的，其中包括《以色列时报》——在撰写本文时，其帖子的观看次数已超过 256,000 次。

paras.en: The video has appeared in many languages, including Arabic, English, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, Nepali, and it has been shared on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebookand other platforms.
paras.zh: 该视频以多种语言出现，包括阿拉伯语、英语、俄语、西班牙语、土耳其语、尼泊尔语，并在 YouTube、Instagram、TikTok、Facebook 等平台上分享。

paras.en: Claim: In this post on X with 2.9 million views, a user claims it shows "new video footage of the moment King Khalid International Airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh was targeted."
paras.zh: 声明：在 X 上这篇拥有 290 万次观看次数的帖子中，一名用户声称该帖子显示了“沙特首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场遭到攻击时的新视频片段”。

paras.en: The video is AI-generated and contains several inconsistencies when compared with the real airport. Using a reverse image search, we found the photograph used to generate the fake video.
paras.zh: 该视频是人工智能生成的，与真实机场相比存在一些不一致之处。通过反向图像搜索，我们找到了用于生成假视频的照片。

paras.en: The original image was uploaded to stock photo database Shutterstockin 2016. Although it was taken from a slightly different angle it shows many visual cues that overlap with the video, including the white triangular geometric patterns of the airport building roof, the dome to the left, the luggage transport vehicles and the open and closed doors of the plane.
paras.zh: 原始图像于2016年上传到库存照片数据库Shutterstock。虽然拍摄角度略有不同，但它显示了许多与视频重叠的视觉线索，包括机场建筑屋顶的白色三角形几何图案、左侧的圆顶、行李运输车辆以及打开和关闭的飞机门。

paras.en: Other elements are missing. In the video, the light pole to the left of the aircraft appears without any lamps attached. The video is grainy and contains some visual glitches where parts of the image suddenly become blurry.
paras.zh: 其他元素缺失。在视频中，飞机左侧的灯杆没有安装任何灯。该视频有颗粒感，并且包含一些视觉故障，图像的某些部分突然变得模糊。

paras.en: When the supposed missile strikes the plane, a nearby vehicle significantly changes its shape as it is thrown into the air. Another inconsistency is that, despite the missile's massive explosion and a resulting fireball, nearby objects do not cast corresponding shadows.
paras.zh: 当所谓的导弹击中飞机时，附近的一辆车辆在被抛向空中时会显着改变其形状。另一个不一致之处是，尽管导弹发生了大规模爆炸并产生了火球，但附近的物体并没有投射出相应的阴影。

paras.en: The account that shared the video has repeatedly posted AI-generated content in the past.
paras.zh: 分享该视频的帐户过去曾多次发布人工智能生成的内容。

paras.en: Whereas the October 8 attack at King Khalid International Airport did reportedly badly damage a plane, this video does not show the moment of attack.
paras.zh: 据报道，10 月 8 日哈立德国王国际机场的袭击确实严重损坏了一架飞机，但该视频并未显示袭击时刻。

paras.en: Video predates attack and shows people move through objects
paras.zh: 视频发生在袭击发生之前，显示人们在物体中移动

paras.en: Claim: This TikTok postwith more than 301,000 views claims that the footage was recorded "just now from the heart of Riyadh Airport."
paras.zh: 声明：这篇 TikTok 帖子的观看次数超过 301,000 次，声称这段视频是“刚刚在利雅得机场中心”录制的。

paras.en: This video had already circulated online in March 2026, months before the attack. We found the video was shared in Greek, Albanian, Turkish and Russian.
paras.zh: 该视频已于 2026 年 3 月（即袭击发生前几个月）在网上流传。我们发现该视频以希腊语、阿尔巴尼亚语、土耳其语和俄语分享。

paras.en: The footage contains several visual anomalies. Parts of the image appear blurry, and some people seem to merge into one another. In addition, a row of red lights in the terminal switches on one second before the supposed explosion becomes visible through the window.
paras.zh: 这段视频包含一些视觉异常现象。图像的某些部分显得模糊，有些人似乎彼此融合在一起。此外，在通过窗户看到所谓的爆炸之前一秒钟，航站楼内的一排红灯亮起。

paras.en: The clearest indication that the video is AI-generated is the way people move through the queue barriers. At the beginning of the video, several people appear to walk directly through them. After the supposed explosion, some individuals run straight through barriers that appear to end mid-air and are connected on only one side.
paras.zh: 该视频是人工智能生成的最明显迹象是人们穿过队列障碍的方式。视频一开始，有几个人似乎直接从其中走过。在所谓的爆炸之后，一些人径直穿过障碍物，这些障碍物似乎在半空中结束，并且仅在一侧连接。

paras.en: Claim: This TikTok post, which has garnered more than 500,000 views, reports on the attacks on the airports in Riyadh and Abha and includes a compilation of videos. We examined the first video.
paras.zh: 声明：这篇 TikTok 帖子已获得超过 50 万次观看，报道了利雅得和艾卜哈机场遭受的袭击，并包含视频汇编。我们检查了第一个视频。

paras.en: Analysis using Google Gemini detected that the video was generated, at least in part, with Google AI tools. The clip contains a SynthID watermark in both the images and the audio.
paras.zh: 使用 Google Gemini 进行的分析发现，该视频至少部分是使用 Google AI 工具生成的。该剪辑的图像和音频中均包含 SynthID 水印。

paras.en: The same video also circulated on Facebook, where it has received more than 157,000 views. On Facebook it has been posted by an account that only shares AI-generated videos, and it is clearly labeled as "AI-content."
paras.zh: 该视频还在 Facebook 上流传，观看次数超过 157,000 次。在 Facebook 上，它是由一个只分享人工智能生成的视频的帐户发布的，并且它被明确标记为“人工智能内容”。

paras.en: All four videos examined by DW Fact check are very short. Two are between six and ten seconds long, while the other two last 13 and 15 seconds, respectively. Such brief videos are easier to create with AI and often contain very little visual information, making it difficult for viewers to verify their authenticity.
paras.zh: DW Fact check 检查的所有四个视频都非常短。其中两个时长在 6 到 10 秒之间，另外两个则分别持续 13 和 15 秒。此类简短视频更容易用人工智能制作，并且通常包含很少的视觉信息，使观看者很难验证其真实性。

paras.en: Daniel Ebertz contributed to this research.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·埃伯茨对这项研究做出了贡献。

articles.title: Poland reports arrests of 2 Turkish citizens in Germany in connection with Starlink station fire last month

paras.en: Polish officials on Monday said that two Turkish citizens have been detained in Germany in connection with a fire last month at a Starlink station in Poland.
paras.zh: 波兰官员周一表示，两名土耳其公民因上个月波兰星链站发生火灾而在德国被拘留。

paras.en: The satellite-based Starlink internet service is widely used by the military of Poland's neighbor Ukraine amid the Russian invasion.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯入侵期间，波兰邻国乌克兰的军队广泛使用基于卫星的星链互联网服务。

paras.en: Officials from several EU countries have been warning of mounting Russian sabotage, cyber and hybrid attacks across Europe aiming either to erode support for Ukraine or to impact Ukraine directly.
paras.zh: 多个欧盟国家的官员一直警告俄罗斯在欧洲各地进行越来越多的破坏、网络和混合攻击，其目的要么是削弱对乌克兰的支持，要么是直接影响乌克兰。

paras.en: Polish officials did not specify exactly where or when the two men were allegedly detained in Germany.
paras.zh: 波兰官员没有具体说明这两人据称在德国被拘留的地点或时间。

paras.en: What did Poland say about the arrests and the case?
paras.zh: 波兰对逮捕和案件有何评论？

paras.en: Polish Interior Minister Marcin Kierwinski reported the arrests on Monday, with Prime Minister Donald Tusk following soon after.
paras.zh: 波兰内政部长马尔钦·基尔温斯基周一报告了逮捕情况，总理唐纳德·图斯克随后也报告了这一情况。

paras.en: "On behalf of Polish services, German police detained two Turkish citizens suspected of setting fire to a Starlink station in Masovia," he said on social media. "This is another act of hybrid warfare. The perpetrators of the sabotage will answer before the Polish justice system."
paras.zh: 他在社交媒体上表示：“德国警方代表波兰部门拘留了两名涉嫌纵火马佐夫舍星链站的土耳其公民。” “这是又一种混合战争行为。破坏活动的肇事者将在波兰司法系统面前接受审判。”

paras.en: Masovia is the province that includes the Polish capital Warsaw, not that far from Poland's eastern borders to Belarus and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 马佐夫舍是包括波兰首都华沙在内的一个省份，距离波兰东部与白俄罗斯和乌克兰的边界不远。

paras.en: Poland's Special Services Minister Tomasz Siemoniak alleged that Russia was behind the incident.
paras.zh: 波兰特别服务部长托马斯·西蒙尼亚克声称俄罗斯是这起事件的幕后黑手。

paras.en: He also told a press conference that, "it is worth adding that Russian services are increasingly turning to individuals linked to the criminal underworld" for such attacks.
paras.zh: 他还在新闻发布会上表示，“值得补充的是，俄罗斯服务机构越来越多地向与黑社会有联系的个人寻求帮助”进行此类袭击。

paras.en: Russia typically dismisses European claims of hybrid warfare or systemic sabotage as either anti-Russian hysteria or disinformation.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯通常将欧洲关于混合战争或系统性破坏的主张视为反俄歇斯底里或虚假信息。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: UK: Iran 'highly likely' to be behind RAF Fairford incident

paras.en: The British government has accused Iran of involvement in a security alert outside a UK/US airbase in southern England last month, summoning the ambassador and announcing sanctions against two individuals.
paras.zh: 英国政府指责伊朗上个月参与了英格兰南部英美空军基地外的安全警报，召见了伊朗大使并宣布对两人实施制裁。

paras.en: Five British nationals were arrested in the vicinity of the RAF Fairford airbase on September 27 on suspicion of terrorism and explosives offenses. They were later released on bail under strict conditions, and another arrest followed days later.
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日，五名英国国民因涉嫌恐怖主义和爆炸罪在英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地附近被捕。他们后来在严格条件下获得保释，几天后又被捕。

paras.en: Police had already said they were considering the possibility of a foreign state actor's involvement, not least given RAF Fairford's importance to the US Air Force as one of the European bases that handles heavy bombers like B-1's and B-52's, with ample range to reach Iran.
paras.zh: 警方已经表示，他们正在考虑外国行为者参与的可能性，尤其是考虑到英国皇家空军费尔福德基地作为欧洲基地之一对美国空军的重要性，该基地负责处理 B-1 和 B-52 等重型轰炸机，并且航程足以到达伊朗。

paras.en: What did Prime Minister Andy Burnham tell parliament?
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆总理对议会说了什么？

paras.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told lawmakers in the House of Commons on Monday that the UK might yet put further sanctions on Iran in response.
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆周一在下议院告诉议员，作为回应，英国可能会对伊朗实施进一步制裁。

paras.en: He said there were indications of Iran coordinating the potential plot.
paras.zh: 他表示，有迹象表明伊朗正在协调这一潜在阴谋。

paras.en: "I can confirm our assessment that it is highly likely to have been coordinated in Iran, almost certainly directed by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard (IRGC)," he said. "We will not tolerate these threats on our soil."
paras.zh: 他说：“我可以证实我们的评估，即这起事件很可能是在伊朗境内协调的，几乎可以肯定是由伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）指挥的。” “我们不会容忍我们土地上的这些威胁。”

paras.en: The degree of competence exhibited and the threat posed by the group of young British nationals from London is not entirely clear but seems potentially limited.
paras.zh: 来自伦敦的年轻英国公民所表现出的能力程度以及所构成的威胁尚不完全清楚，但似乎可能有限。

paras.en: Preliminary reports suggest that despite a widespread security alert and bomb squad deployment, investigators ultimately did not find viable explosives in the vans. They did, however, find accelerants like petroleum.
paras.zh: 初步报告表明，尽管存在广泛的安全警报并部署了拆弹小组，但调查人员最终没有在货车中发现可行的爆炸物。然而，他们确实找到了像石油这样的促进剂。

paras.en: "We will crack down on Iran's use of criminal networks, using our full range of powers to target them and their funding streams, and we will bring further sanctions to restrict the capacity of Iran and the IRGC to do us harm," Burnham said.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆说：“我们将打击伊朗利用犯罪网络的行为，利用我们的全部权力来打击他们及其资金流，我们将采取进一步的制裁措施，限制伊朗和伊斯兰革命卫队对我们造成伤害的能力。”

paras.en: Foreign Secretary Miliband says Iranian ambassador summoned
paras.zh: 外交大臣米利班德称已召见伊朗大使

paras.en: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said on Monday that his department had summoned Iran's ambassador to "reiterate" the message that Britain "will not tolerate attacks on our soil."
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德周一表示，他的部门已召见伊朗大使，“重申”英国“不会容忍对我们领土的袭击”。

paras.en: Iran's state news agency IRNA reported Ambassador Ali Moussavi as "categorically rejecting the accusations" and calling on the British government "to present evidence supporting its allegations if it possesses any."
paras.zh: 伊朗国家通讯社伊斯兰通讯社报道称，阿里·穆萨维大使“断然拒绝这些指控”，并呼吁英国政府“如果拥有任何指控，就提供支持其指控的证据”。

paras.en: Miliband said that two individuals would be subject to an immediate asset freeze, travel ban and director disqualification.
paras.zh: 米利班德表示，两人将受到立即资产冻结、旅行禁令和取消董事资格的处罚。

paras.en: He named Ruhollah Bazghandi, head of counterespionage operations in the IRGC and Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki, an alleged facilitator for the Zindashti criminal network.
paras.zh: 他点名了伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队反间谍行动负责人鲁霍拉·巴兹甘迪 (Ruhollah Bazghandi) 和据称是辛达什提 (Zindashti) 犯罪网络的协助者沙赫拉姆·阿里·礼萨·塔玛扎德·贾基 (Shahram Ali Reza Tamarzadeh Jakki)。

paras.en: Miliband said they were being sanctioned for "their role in facilitating or engaging in hostile activity on behalf of the Iranian regime, with the clear intent of threatening, planning or conducting attacks overseas."
paras.zh: 米利班德表示，他们因“代表伊朗政权协助或参与敌对活动，并明显意图威胁、策划或实施海外袭击”而受到制裁。

paras.en: Joint statement from 29 countries condemns 'Iran's use of violent attacks'
paras.zh: 29个国家联合声明谴责“伊朗使用暴力袭击”

paras.en: Shortly afterwards, a total of 29 countries issued a joint statement denouncing "in the strongest terms Iran's use of violent attacks."
paras.zh: 不久之后，共有29个国家发表联合声明，“以最强烈的措辞谴责伊朗使用暴力袭击”。

paras.en: It said these included "the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners."
paras.zh: 声明称，这些行为包括“针对我们和我们的合作伙伴的致命策划、纵火、破坏、网络攻击和其他混合活动”。

paras.en: All of the so-called "Five Eyes" alliance and most European NATO members were listed among the signatories, including but not limited to the US, Britain, Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain and Ireland.
paras.zh: 所有所谓“五眼联盟”和大多数欧洲北约成员国都在签署国之列，包括但不限于美国、英国、澳大利亚、加拿大、法国、德国、西班牙和爱尔兰。

paras.en: In the aftermath of the September 27 incident at Fairford, the high-tech US B-1 bombers left the airbase. The older and larger contingent of B-52's remained there.
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日费尔福德事件发生后，美国高科技 B-1 轰炸机离开了空军基地。较老、规模较大的 B-52 机队仍留在那里。

paras.en: RAF Fairford is one of several airbases in southern England with a large US usage footprint. It's located around two hours' drive west of London, in a rural area north of Swindon.
paras.zh: 英国皇家空军费尔福德空军基地是英格兰南部几个空军基地之一，在美国有大量使用足迹。它位于伦敦以西约两小时车程处，位于斯温顿北部的乡村地区。

paras.en: As with most such bases, it can trace its roots back to the second World War when Nazi Germany occupied most of mainland Europe and Allied powers were operating air raids and preparing for the D-Day landings out of Britain.
paras.zh: 与大多数此类基地一样，它的根源可以追溯到第二次世界大战，当时纳粹德国占领了欧洲大陆的大部分地区，盟军正在进行空袭，并为诺曼底登陆做准备。

paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: NATO says will do ‘anything and everything’ if alliance is attacked

paras.en: NATO’s top commander has warned that his forces would destroy “anything and everything” if someone was “foolish enough” to attack the alliance, as European concerns have mounted over a potential Russian attack on its territory amid the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 北约最高指挥官警告说，如果有人“愚蠢”地攻击北约，他的部队将摧毁“一切”，因为欧洲对俄罗斯在乌克兰战争期间可能袭击其领土的担忧日益加剧。

paras.en: “We will block the initial attack. If the attack persists, we will blunt it and prevent any enemy advance. And if required, we will break the enemy’s forces and the operational war-fighting system arrayed against us,” US Air Force General Alexus Grynkewich told the Warsaw Security Forum on Monday, without mentioning Russia by name.
paras.zh: 美国空军上将亚历克苏斯·格林克维奇周一在华沙安全论坛上表示：“我们将阻止最初的攻击。如果攻击持续下去，我们将削弱它并阻止敌人的任何进展。如果需要，我们将摧毁敌方的部队和针对我们的作战作战系统。”但他没有提及俄罗斯的名字。

paras.en: Grynkewich stressed that NATO is a defensive alliance and that he does not believe that a conflict is imminent or inevitable. The most effective way to preserve peace is to prepare for war and to maintain open lines of communication to “resolve misunderstandings”, he added.
paras.zh: 格林克维奇强调，北约是一个防御性联盟，他不认为冲突迫在眉睫或不可避免。他补充说，维护和平最有效的方法是为战争做好准备，并保持开放的沟通渠道以“解决误解”。

paras.en: European governments have accused Moscow of stepping up a campaign of sabotage, drone incursions and cyberattacks against them, while Russia warned last month it could use nuclear weapons if NATO attempted to cut off its Baltic Kaliningrad exclave where it has a major military outpost.
paras.zh: 欧洲各国政府指责莫斯科加大对他们的破坏、无人机入侵和网络攻击力度，而俄罗斯上个月警告说，如果北约试图切断其拥有主要军事前哨的波罗的海加里宁格勒飞地，俄罗斯可能会使用核武器。

paras.en: NATO’s 10-year strategy, created in 2022, described Russia as the alliance’s most significant security threat.
paras.zh: 北约 2022 年制定的十年战略将俄罗斯描述为该联盟最重大的安全威胁。

paras.en: “We will, in short, ensure any attack, against any ally, proves utterly futile,” Grynkewich said.
paras.zh: 格林克维奇说：“简而言之，我们将确保针对任何盟友的任何攻击都是完全徒劳的。”

paras.en: Attacking anything that ‘supports, sustains and controls that force’
paras.zh: 攻击任何“支持、维持和控制该力量”的事物

paras.en: Grynkewich added that NATO’s response would not be limited to forces involved in an initial attack.
paras.zh: 格林克维奇补充说，北约的反应将不仅限于参与最初袭击的部队。

paras.en: “Should the adversary choose to press the attack or commit his reserves, we will break the warfighting system engaged against us,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果对手选择发动攻击或投入后备力量，我们将破坏针对我们的作战系统。”

paras.en: “This includes not just the attacking force itself, but anything and everything that supports, sustains and controls that force.”
paras.zh: “这不仅包括攻击力量本身，还包括支持、维持和控制该力量的任何事物。”

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin said this month that Russia had no plans to attack any European country and wanted to coexist peacefully. Such declarations have not reassured European leaders, who cite similar statements by Russia before its 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统普京本月表示，俄罗斯没有攻击任何欧洲国家的计划，并希望和平共处。这样的声明并没有让欧洲领导人放心，他们引用了俄罗斯在 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰之前的类似声明。

paras.en: Moscow has also repeatedly denied involvement in sabotage and other hybrid operations.
paras.zh: 莫斯科还一再否认参与破坏和其他混合行动。

paras.en: Grynkewich said he had decided to talk publicly about NATO’s plans because recent acts of sabotage and arson had made people around the alliance nervous.
paras.zh: 格林克维奇表示，他决定公开谈论北约的计划，因为最近发生的破坏和纵火行为让北约周围的人感到紧张。

paras.en: “What I want to do is assure the one billion citizens of our alliance that we’ve got this. We know what we need to do. We know how we would do it,” he said.
paras.zh: “我想做的是向我们联盟的十亿公民保证我们已经做到了。我们知道我们需要做什么。我们知道如何做到这一点，”他说。

paras.en: Grynkewich sought to downplay concerns about Washington’s commitment to the alliance, citing President Donald Trump’s reception at a NATO summit in Ankara in July.
paras.zh: 格林克维奇试图淡化人们对华盛顿对联盟承诺的担忧，并引用了唐纳德·特朗普总统7月份在安卡拉举行的北约峰会上的招待会。

paras.en: “I was in the room and I felt the love,” he said.
paras.zh: “我在房间里，感受到了爱，”他说。

articles.title: Elon Musk spends $366m to bolster Republican Party in US midterm elections

paras.en: Elon Musk, the trillionaire tech mogul and backer of far-right causes, has reportedly spent $366m since last year to buoy the Republican Party in the United States midterm elections.
paras.zh: 据报道，亿万富翁科技大亨和极右翼事业的支持者埃隆·马斯克自去年以来已花费 3.66 亿美元来支持共和党在美国中期选举中的表现。

paras.en: The New York Times first reported on Monday that Musk has spent $276m since July alone, including $158m for a super PAC focused on Republican Senate candidates, making him the largest single donor this year.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》周一首次报道称，仅 7 月份以来，马斯克就花费了 2.76 亿美元，其中包括 1.58 亿美元用于专门针对共和党参议院候选人的超级政治行动委员会，这使他成为今年最大的单一捐助者。

paras.en: Musk is considered a close ally of President Donald Trump, the leader of the Republican Party, and was a special government adviser to the White House last year.
paras.zh: 马斯克被认为是共和党领袖唐纳德·特朗普总统的亲密盟友，去年曾担任白宫特别政府顾问。

paras.en: Musk’s political action committee, America PAC, has confirmed the spending totals. In a statement to The New York Times, a spokesperson framed the record amount as necessary to defend Congress from a Democratic takeover during the midterm races.
paras.zh: 马斯克的政治行动委员会美国 PAC 已确认支出总额。在给《纽约时报》的一份声明中，一位发言人表示，这一创纪录的金额是为了在中期选举期间捍卫国会免受民主党接管所必需的。

paras.en: “These robust investments have allowed the GOP apparatus to get its message out so Republicans can have a fighting chance to defy history,” America PAC spokesman Andrew Romeo told the Times.
paras.zh: 美国政治行动委员会发言人安德鲁·罗密欧对《泰晤士报》表示：“这些强劲的投资让共和党机构能够传达自己的信息，这样共和党人就有机会挑战历史。”

paras.en: The barrage of spending by Musk comes as Republican candidates are fighting to overcome Trump’s low popularity and rising concerns about the cost of living among US voters.
paras.zh: 马斯克大举支出之际，共和党候选人正在努力克服特朗普的低支持率以及美国选民对生活成本日益增长的担忧。

paras.en: Democrats are hoping to capitalise on voter dissatisfaction with Trump’s tenure to seize control of Congress, where Republicans currently hold majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate.
paras.zh: 民主党希望利用选民对特朗普任期的不满来夺取国会的控制权，目前共和党在众议院和参议院均占据多数席位。

paras.en: The influence of wealthy donors and PACs has long been the subject of criticism. Opponents argue that such spending distorts US politics in favour of powerful interests.
paras.zh: 富有的捐助者和政治行动委员会的影响力长期以来一直受到批评。反对者认为，这种支出扭曲了美国政治，有利于强大的利益集团。

paras.en: Musk became the world’s first trillionaire in June, when his aerospace company SpaceX made its initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
paras.zh: 今年 6 月，马斯克的航空航天公司 SpaceX 在纳斯达克证券交易所进行首次公开​​募股 (IPO)，成为世界上第一位万亿富翁。

paras.en: The tech entrepreneur had previously said that he planned to step back from his involvement in US politics, stating in May that he had “done enough” and did not have plans for large spending efforts.
paras.zh: 这位科技企业家此前曾表示，他计划退出美国政治，并在 5 月份表示，他已经“做得足够多”，没有计划进行大规模支出。

paras.en: Still, Musk has leveraged his tech holdings and wealth to support right-wing groups around the world.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，马斯克还是利用他的科技资产和财富来支持世界各地的右翼团体。

paras.en: Last year, for instance, politicians in Germany accused Musk of trying to meddle in the national election. Musk has been a vocal backer of the Alternative for Germany (AfD) party, which has been accused of adopting a discriminatory stance on immigration and other issues.
paras.zh: 例如，去年德国政界人士指责马斯克试图干预全国选举。马斯克一直是德国另类选择党（AfD）的直言不讳的支持者，该党被指控在移民和其他问题上采取歧视性立场。

paras.en: Voters in the US will head to the polls on November 3 to cast their ballots in the midterms, which will decide key state and local races, as well as congressional majorities.
paras.zh: 美国选民将于 11 月 3 日前往投票站为中期选举投票，这将决定关键的州和地方选举以及国会多数席位。

paras.en: The Republican Party is considered to have a sizeable financial advantage over the Democrats ahead of the race, with heavy spending from groups such as MAGA Inc, a pro-Trump super PAC named for the president’s “Make America Great Again” movement.
paras.zh: 共和党在竞选前被认为比民主党拥有相当大的财务优势，MAGA Inc 等团体的巨额支出是支持特朗普的超级政治行动委员会，以总统的“让美国再次伟大”运动命名。

paras.en: As of August, MAGA Inc reportedly had $416m in its coffers. The tracking site AdImpact found that it had spent $22m over the past month alone on the tight race unfolding for the open Senate seat in Texas.
paras.zh: 据报道，截至 8 月，MAGA Inc 的金库有 4.16 亿美元。追踪网站 AdImpact 发现，仅在过去一个月，该公司就在德克萨斯州参议院空缺席位的激烈竞争中花费了 2200 万美元。

paras.en: Trump has also increased his campaign activities, hosting a string of rallies in the final weeks before the election to help Republicans push their message.
paras.zh: 特朗普还增加了竞选活动，在大选前的最后几周举办了一系列集会，以帮助共和党人宣传他们的信息。

paras.en: But Democrats appear confident that the Republicans’ spending advantage will not be enough to counter the effects of growing dissatisfaction with Trump.
paras.zh: 但民主党人似乎相信，共和党的支出优势不足以抵消对特朗普日益增长的不满情绪的影响。

paras.en: “Republicans are hoping to buy these elections, injecting tens of millions into races to try and outrun their unpopular candidates, unpopular president and unpopular economy,” said Lauren French, a spokesperson for Democrats’ Senate Majority PAC.
paras.zh: 民主党参议院多数派政治行动委员会发言人劳伦·弗伦奇(Lauren French)表示，“共和党人希望收买这些选举，向竞选注入数千万美元，试图超越他们不受欢迎的候选人、不受欢迎的总统和不受欢迎的经济。”

articles.title: South Africa deputy police chief resigns amid sex offence charges

paras.en: The deputy head of South Africa’s police has resigned amid allegations of corruption and rape, which he denies.
paras.zh: 南非警察局副局长因腐败和强奸指控而辞职，但他否认了这一指控。

paras.en: Shadrack Sibiya was set to face a disciplinary hearing on Monday, but his lawyers tendered his resignation at the start of proceedings.
paras.zh: 沙德拉克·西比亚定于周一接受纪律听证会，但他的律师在诉讼开始时就向他提出了辞职。

paras.en: In a post on social media platform X, a spokesperson said that Sibiya’s departure was regarded as a “dishonourable discharge” due to the ongoing disciplinary case against him.
paras.zh: 在社交媒体平台 X 上的一篇帖子中，一位发言人表示，由于针对西比亚的纪律案件正在进行中，西比亚的离职被视为“不光彩解雇”。

paras.en: He had been suspended since September last year.
paras.zh: 自去年9月起，他就被停职。

paras.en: Sibiya is currently in prison after he was arrested for the alleged rape and grooming of a minor last month. His application to be released on bail has been postponed to October 13.
paras.zh: 西比亚上个月因涉嫌强奸和诱骗未成年人而被捕，目前正在监狱服刑。他的保释申请已推迟至10月13日。

paras.en: The former deputy police chief has been the subject of a judicial commission of inquiry investigating allegations of corruption within the South African police and alleged ties to organised crime.
paras.zh: 前副警察局长已成为司法调查委员会的调查对象，该委员会正在调查南非警察内部腐败指控以及与有组织犯罪的联系。

paras.en: At the commission, Sibiya has been accused of receiving large sums of cash and gifts from alleged criminals, which he denied during his testimony.
paras.zh: 在委员会中，西比亚被指控从犯罪嫌疑人那里收受大量现金和礼物，但他在作证时否认了这一点。

articles.title: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
articles.author: Brian Mann

paras.en: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
paras.zh: 特朗普声称“能源停火”后，俄罗斯袭击了乌克兰天然气设施

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Monday that Russia continued missile and drone attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, hours after President Trump claimed that Moscow had agreed to an "energy ceasefire" designed to spare energy-related infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基周一表示，在特朗普总统声称莫斯科已同意旨在保护俄罗斯和乌克兰能源相关基础设施的“能源停火”几小时后，俄罗斯继续对乌克兰能源基础设施进行导弹和无人机袭击。

paras.en: "We did not attack, while Russia attacked our gas stations, energy infrastructure, and other facilities," Zelenskyy said on the social media platform X. "I think it was Putin's answer to President Trump. And the message from Russia was very clear — they don't know anything about the energy ceasefire."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在社交媒体平台X上表示：“我们没有发动攻击，而俄罗斯却攻击了我们的加油站、能源基础设施和其他设施。我认为这是普京对特朗普总统的回应。俄罗斯发出的信息非常明确——他们对能源停火一无所知。”

paras.en: According to Zelenskyy, a jet-powered Iranian "shahed" drone fired from Russia struck a gas production facility around midnight, while other drones struck at least five other energy-related targets. He said 33 people were reported wounded across the country.
paras.zh: 据泽伦斯基称，午夜时分，一架从俄罗斯发射的喷气式伊朗“shashed”无人机袭击了一个天然气生产设施，而其他无人机则袭击了至少五个其他能源相关目标。他说，据报道全国有 33 人受伤。

paras.en: Later on Monday, Zelenskyy said Ukraine supported the concept of an energy ceasefire, but he called for more pressure on Russia "for de-escalation to actually succeed."
paras.zh: 周一晚些时候，泽连斯基表示乌克兰支持能源停火的概念，但他呼吁对俄罗斯施加更大压力，“以使局势缓和真正取得成功”。

paras.en: "Russia must take corresponding steps. As of now, there is no indication that Russia is complying with the conditions outlined by the American President," Zelenskyy wrote in a social media post.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯必须采取相应措施。截至目前，没有迹象表明俄罗斯正在遵守美国总统提出的条件，”泽伦斯基在社交媒体帖子中写道。

paras.en: On Sunday, Trump said on his social media platform that "both parties" had agreed to the partial ceasefire, adding, "Do not break it!" He offered no details about the arrangement. But officials in Moscow appeared to show little willingness to limit strikes.
paras.zh: 周日，特朗普在其社交媒体平台上表示，“双方”已同意部分停火，并补充说，“不要打破它！”他没有提供有关安排的细节。但莫斯科官员似乎并没有表现出限制罢工的意愿。

paras.en: Asked about the energy ceasefire on Monday, Russian foreign minister Sergey Lavrov rejected the idea as another attempt by Zelenskyy to exploit a proposed pause in the fighting to regroup and rearm. "I do not think [Zelenskyy] deserves a respite," he said.
paras.zh: 周一被问及能源停火问题时，俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫拒绝了这一想法，认为这是泽连斯基利用拟议的战斗暂停来重新集结和重新武装的又一次尝试。 “我认为[泽伦斯基]不值得喘息，”他说。

paras.en: NPR asked the White House for comment on Russia's overnight strikes and what they mean for Trump's proposed ceasefire. Administration officials have yet to respond. Since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Moscow has often targeted civilian infrastructure, including gas and electric systems.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 要求白宫就俄罗斯隔夜袭击及其对特朗普提议的停火意味着什么发表评论。政府官员尚未做出回应。自俄罗斯于 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰以来，莫斯科经常以民用基础设施为目标，包括天然气和电力系统。

paras.en: Trump's efforts to broker a deal protecting energy infrastructure in the warring nations comes amid rising fuel prices in the U.S., following Trump's decision to go to war with Iran. Gas prices have emerged as a major challenge for Trump and his Republican allies ahead of next month's midterm election.
paras.zh: 在特朗普决定与伊朗开战后，美国燃油价格不断上涨，特朗普努力促成一项保护交战国家能源基础设施的协议。在下个月的中期选举之前，天然气价格已成为特朗普及其共和党盟友面临的主要挑战。

paras.en: Last week, Trump announced a controversial plan to reduce diesel prices by reviving imports from Russia. On Sunday, however, a bipartisan group of U.S. senators released a statement calling Trump's proposal unlawful.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普宣布了一项有争议的计划，通过恢复从俄罗斯的进口来降低柴油价格。然而，周日，美国参议员两党团体发表声明，称特朗普的提议非法。

paras.en: "Congress explicitly banned Russian energy imports in 2022 to prevent American dollars from financing Putin's brutal war against Ukraine," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“国会明确禁止在 2022 年进口俄罗斯能源，以防止美元资助普京对乌克兰的残酷战争。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy and many U.S. allies have supported the idea of an energy ceasefire, while condemning Trump's plan to import Russian diesel. Zelenskyy called Trump's move a "weak decision," while Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said on Sunday the move is "in direct opposition" to international peace efforts.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基和许多美国盟友支持能源停火的想法，同时谴责特朗普进口俄罗斯柴油的计划。泽伦斯基称特朗普的举动是一个“软弱的决定”，而加拿大总理马克·卡尼周日表示，此举“直接反对”国际和平努力。

paras.en: In a statement Monday, Trump described his effort to partner with Russia to lower U.S. energy prices as a part of his "America First" strategy, prioritizing U.S. interests over concerns about Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周一的一份声明中称，他与俄罗斯合作降低美国能源价格的努力是其“美国优先”战略的一部分，将美国利益置于对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的担忧之上。

paras.en: "The European Union paid Russia $250 Billion Dollars for Energy, and the Fake News Media doesn't want to get near that story. I made the right choice for the American People," Trump wrote.
paras.zh: “欧盟向俄罗斯支付了 2500 亿美元的能源费用，假新闻媒体不想报道这个故事。我为美国人民做出了正确的选择，”特朗普写道。

paras.en: Russia's official news agency TASS confirmed Monday that Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak has agreed to supply 300,000 tons of diesel to the U.S. in October, with monthly supplies increasing in the months ahead.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官方通讯社塔斯社周一证实，俄罗斯副总理亚历山大·诺瓦克已同意10月份向美国供应30万吨柴油，未来几个月每月供应量将增加。

paras.en: "The US administration, in turn, issued a general license authorizing Russian diesel supplies to the global market until April 7, 2027," TASS reported.
paras.zh: 塔斯社报道称：“美国政府反过来颁发了通用许可证，授权俄罗斯向全球市场供应柴油，直至 2027 年 4 月 7 日。”

paras.en: While Ukrainian officials say they have so far respected Trump's call for an energy ceasefire, they did strike large data centers inside Russia operated by Yandex, a company often described as Russia's version of Google. The strike led to service outages in parts of Russia.
paras.zh: 虽然乌克兰官员表示，到目前为止，他们尊重特朗普关于能源停火的呼吁，但他们确实袭击了俄罗斯境内由 Yandex 公司运营的大型数据中心，该公司通常被称为俄罗斯版谷歌。此次罢工导致俄罗斯部分地区服务中断。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Monday that the strikes on Yandex have also led to a drop in the number of Russian propaganda bots appearing on social media. "A lot of people noticed it. There was less hate, less division, and fewer provocations," he said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周一表示，对 Yandex 的攻击还导致社交媒体上出现的俄罗斯宣传机器人数量下降。 “很多人注意到了这一点。仇恨、分裂和挑衅都减少了，”他说。

articles.title: DOJ launches antitrust probe of TV networks. And, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: DOJ launches antitrust probe of TV networks. And, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader
paras.zh: 美国司法部对电视网络发起反垄断调查。而且，特朗普表示乌克兰需要新领导人

paras.en: President Trump is urging Ukrainians to hold wartime elections and replace President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, as he blames him for not ending the war. He accuses Zelenskyy of causing rising global fuel prices due to Ukraine's long-range drone strikes on Russian oil refineries. Trump lifted sanctions on Russian diesel on Friday temporarily, and stated both sides agreed to an "energy ceasefire."
paras.zh: 特朗普总统敦促乌克兰举行战时选举并取代总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基，因为他指责泽连斯基没有结束战争。他指责泽伦斯基因乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的远程无人机袭击而导致全球燃油价格上涨。特朗普周五暂时解除了对俄罗斯柴油的制裁，并表示双方同意“能源停火”。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump has urged Ukrainians to elect a new leader before, but each time he does that, Zelenskyy's popularity rises, NPR's Joanna Kakissis tells Up First. She adds that, through conversations with Ukrainians in Kyiv, a common sentiment emerges: while they see Zelenskyy as imperfect, they believe outsiders shouldn't dictate their electoral process or leadership changes. Most Ukrainians acknowledge that holding elections now would be risky, given the ongoing conflict, with Russia bombing their cities daily. Meanwhile, Zelenskyy said yesterday that he was unaware of any plans for a ceasefire, which would require both sides to stop attacking energy facilities.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普之前曾敦促乌克兰人选举一位新领导人，但每次他这样做，泽伦斯基的支持率都会上升，NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 告诉 Up First。她补充说，通过在基辅与乌克兰人的对话，出现了一种共同的情绪：虽然他们认为泽伦斯基不完美，但他们认为局外人不应该决定他们的选举程序或领导层变动。大多数乌克兰人承认，鉴于冲突持续不断，而且俄罗斯每天都在轰炸他们的城市，现在举行选举会有风险。与此同时，泽伦斯基昨天表示，他不知道有任何停火计划，这将要求双方停止攻击能源设施。

paras.en: The Justice Department has opened a formal antitrust investigation into five major U.S. television networks — ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox News — for their actions during a legal battle over access to the White House. Press rights groups have denounced the move, which comes after Trump barred CNN, MSNOW and Politico from the White House, citing unfair negative coverage. The administration revoked White House press passes for more than 70 journalists. The affected news organizations have sued to restore their access. The Justice Department is citing national security grounds for its actions, while a federal judge has temporarily ordered the restoration of their passes, with a final decision expected by Tuesday evening.
paras.zh: 美国司法部已对美国五家主要电视网络——美国广播公司 (ABC)、哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS)、美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN)、全国广播公司 (NBC) 和福克斯新闻频道 (Fox News) 启动正式反垄断调查，原因是它们在争夺入主白宫的法律斗争中的行为。在特朗普以不公平的负面报道为由禁止 CNN、MSNOW 和 Politico 进入白宫后，新闻权利组织谴责了这一举措。政府吊销了 70 多名记者的白宫记者通行证。受影响的新闻机构已提起诉讼以恢复其访问权限。司法部以国家安全为由采取行动，而一名联邦法官已暂时下令恢复他们的通行证，预计将于周二晚上做出最终决定。

paras.en: NPR confirms that at least four people died from storm-related incidents after Hurricane Isaias struck the Gulf Coast as a Category 2 storm on Friday night. Emergency crews in Florida and Alabama are assessing the damage and power outages caused by the storm. Isaias brought 105-mph winds, snapping trees and knocking out power, while officials warn of ongoing flash-flood threats farther inland.
paras.zh: NPR 证实，周五晚上，飓风伊萨亚斯以 2 级风暴袭击墨西哥湾沿岸后，至少有四人死于与风暴相关的事件。佛罗里达州和阿拉巴马州的应急人员正在评估风暴造成的损失和停电。伊萨亚斯带来了时速 105 英里的大风，吹断了树木并导致电力中断，同时官员们警告说，内陆地区持续存在山洪威胁。

paras.en: Houthi forces in Yemen are attacking Saudi airports, including a deadly strike on a passenger terminal in the capital, Riyadh. Saudi Arabia says at least 20 people have died from these recent attacks in the last week.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装正在袭击沙特机场，其中包括对首都利雅得的一个客运大楼发动致命袭击。沙特阿拉伯表示，上周发生的这些袭击事件已造成至少 20 人死亡。

paras.en: - 🎧 Global condemnations have followed these attacks, but the spotlight is on Trump, NPR's Aya Batrawy says. The Saudis have requested U.S. refueling support for their fighter jet strikes on Yemen's Houthis, but Trump has yet to agree. While the U.S. provides intel on the Houthis, Trump remains hesitant to get involved in another Gulf war, especially with ongoing Iranian attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. Since 2015, Saudi Arabia has fought the Houthis, backed by Iran, in an unsuccessful attempt to reinstate the Yemeni government. These latest attacks challenge Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's efforts to secure the country and implement reforms to attract foreign investors and tourists, Batrawy says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的阿雅·巴特威 (Aya Batrawy) 表示，这些袭击事件引发了全球谴责，但焦点集中在特朗普身上。沙特已请求美国为其战斗机打击也门胡塞武装提供加油支持，但特朗普尚未同意。尽管美国提供了有关胡塞武装的情报，但特朗普仍然对卷入另一场海湾战争犹豫不决，特别是在伊朗持续袭击霍尔木兹海峡油轮的情况下。自2015年以来，沙特阿拉伯一直在伊朗支持下与胡塞武装作战，试图恢复也门政府的权力，但没有成功。巴特维说，这些最新的袭击事件对王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼保护国家安全和实施改革以吸引外国投资者和游客的努力提出了挑战。

paras.en: Suicide is a growing public health crisis in the U.S., especially within the Black community, where rates have increased more than 50% in the last decade, according to CDC data. Black youth suicides by firearms surpassed those of white youth in 2022. As public health initiatives increasingly pull away from issues that affect different communities, Morning Edition's Michel Martin wanted to address this issue with care and honesty. Martin led a live event titled Going There: A Matter of Life and Death, uniting clinicians, lawmakers, and individuals affected by this epidemic to try and find out why this crisis is happening, how it affects us and how we can take action. The speakers included influential voices like CEO emerita of BET Debra Lee, Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman, D-NJ, psychiatrist Dr. Paul Nestadt, retired NFL champion Vernon Davis, WWE superstar Ettore "Big E" Ewen and Rev. Johnny Parker, who is both a pastor and a counselor. Watch and listen to the event here.
paras.zh: 自杀是美国日益严重的公共卫生危机，尤其是在黑人社区，根据疾病预防控制中心的数据，过去十年自杀率增加了 50% 以上。 2022 年，黑人青少年持枪自杀人数超过了白人青少年。随着公共卫生举措越来越远离影响不同社区的问题，《晨报》的米歇尔·马丁希望谨慎和诚实地解决这个问题。马丁主持了一场题为“去那里：生死攸关”的现场活动，将临床医生、立法者和受这一流行病影响的个人联合起来，试图找出这场危机发生的原因、它如何影响我们以及我们如何采取行动。演讲者包括 BET 名誉首席执行官黛布拉·李 (Debra Lee)、新泽西州民主党众议员邦妮·沃森·科尔曼 (Bonnie Watson Coleman)、精神病学家保罗·内斯塔特 (Paul Nestadt) 博士、退役 NFL 冠军弗农·戴维斯 (Vernon Davis)、WWE 巨星埃托雷·“大 E”·埃文 (Ettore "Big E" Ewen) 和牧师兼辅导员约翰尼·帕克牧师 (Rev. Johnny Parker)。在这里观看和收听活动。

paras.en: If you or someone you know is in crisis, call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. You can reach someone 24 hours a day, just to talk or to help get access to care.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人处于危机之中，请致电或发短信 988 联系自杀和危机生命热线。您可以每天 24 小时与某人联系，只是为了交谈或帮助获得护理。

paras.en: BTS frontman RM is showcasing art from his personal collection for the first time in a collaboration with the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art. The K-pop idol's real name, Kim Nam-joon, has prompted the group's fanbase, known as ARMY, to coin the term "Namjooning" to describe the star's interests. RM collaborated with two of the museum's curators for the exhibit RM x SFMOMA: Between You and Me. The works on display feature mostly RM's own art collection alongside works from SFMOMA, like a Mark Rothko painting, shown side by side with one by Yun. The museum's director of retail Shane Salvata says, "This is hands down the most inventory that we've ever front-loaded for an exhibition." If you can't visit the exhibit in person, check out some photos of what's on display.
paras.zh: BTS 主唱 RM 首次与旧金山现代艺术博物馆合作展示他个人收藏的艺术品。这位韩国流行偶像的真名金南俊 (Kim Nam-joon) 促使该团体的粉丝群（称为 ARMY）创造了“南俊宁”一词来描述这位明星的兴趣。 RM 与博物馆的两位策展人合作举办了展览《RM x SFMOMA：你和我之间》。展出的作品主要是 RM 自己的艺术收藏，以及 SFMOMA 的作品，例如马克·罗斯科 (Mark Rothko) 的画作，与 Yun 的一幅作品并排展示。博物馆零售总监谢恩·萨尔瓦塔 (Shane Salvata) 表示：“这无疑是我们为展览预先装载的库存最多的一次。”如果您无法亲自参观展览，请查看一些展出内容的照片。

paras.en: - Pope Leo XIV announced Sunday that he will undergo surgery this week to remove a "localized nodule" in his lung, which doctors found at a "very early stage."
paras.zh: - 教皇利奥十四世周日宣布，他将于本周接受手术，切除肺部的“局部结节”，医生在“非常早期的阶段”发现了这个结节。

paras.en: - The Kennedy Center has appointed Rick Canny, a talent manager known for working with acts like ZZ Top and Tommy Lee, as its new artistic director.
paras.zh: - 肯尼迪中心任命里克·坎尼 (Rick Canny) 为新任艺术总监，他是一位因与 ZZ Top 和 Tommy Lee 等艺人合作而闻名的人才经理。

paras.en: - In today's economy, many job seekers are facing longer periods of unemployment, with nearly 40% exhausting their benefits before finding new work.
paras.zh: - 在当今的经济中，许多求职者面临着更长的失业期，近 40% 的人在找到新工作之前就已经用尽了自己的福利。
